firmwares.firmwareName: Ultrasonic Wind Sensor - ULSA M5B (Demo Firmware)
firmwares.firmwareDescription:
This firmware is a demonstration firmware for the ULSA M5B, an ultrasonic anemometer that can stack with the M5Stack Core2.
It provides a wind speed and direction gauge, as well as a wind direction correction feature using the Bosch 9-axis sensor BNO055 built into the ULSA.
This firmware is compatible with Core2, Core2 for AWS, and Core2 V1.1.

[Version 2.4 - 2026/04/21]
 - Display Change: Sonic Temperature → Wind Direction
    Tap the wind direction value to switch back to the sonic temperature.

[Version 2.3 - 2026/03/14]
 - Added BLE ON/OFF function
 - Added RTC Time on the display
 - Added NodeID on the display

[Version 2.2 - 2025/10/21]
 - Added support for FAT16 file count limitation
 - Fixed BLE device name bug
 - Improved stability for long-term operation

[Version 2.1 - 2025/09/28]
 - Fixed a bug where, depending on SD card compatibility, log files could suffer data loss or be created as empty files.

 - Changed the logging method to output in 15-minute segments instead of a single file.

 - Implemented an external-power-only mode (“EXT”). When the ULSA is powered via the device’s micro-B port, charging of the internal battery is disabled. This prevents unexpected reboots caused by conflicts between charging and discharging of the internal battery. Tap the battery icon to switch to EXT mode.

[Version 2.0 - 2024/08/04]

 - Supports BLE wireless connection
 - Supports automatic time synchronization via BLE (syncs with the built-in RTC)
 - Supports CSV data logging to an SD card

By accessing the ULSA BLE site using the Web Bluetooth API (https://strvsn.net/P5/ULSA_BLE/), wireless measurement and wireless logging via the browser are possible.

Supported browsers:
PC: Chrome, Edge
Android: Chrome
iOS: Bluefy (logging function not supported)

Bitcoin Card Wallet allows you to generate seeds, addresses, and sign transactions. The seed is never stored on the device itself, and to sign a transaction, you must enter the seed words or use an RFID tag to store it.

- Manage Wallets: create seeds, public key, mnemonic words, balance

- Transaction Signing: Sign Bitcoin transactions directly on the device using your seed or RFID tag.

- Seed Storage on RFID Tags: Store your seed securely on an RFID MIFARE 1K tag (optionnal).

- Encrypted Seed Backup: Encrypt and store your seed on RFID tags for enhanced protection.

- Seed Restoration: restore your seed from RFID tags,or by manually entering mnemonic words.

- Transaction File Handling: Sign and export PSBT transaction files directly on the device.

- QR Code: Generate and display QR codes for easy sharing of Bitcoin and balance addresses.

- USB Typing: Emulate a USB keyboard to type out Bitcoin addresses.

- SD Card: Support for SD card storage to save and retrieve wallet data and saving PSBT file.

- Passphrase: Generate and use seeds with an optional passphrase for enhanced security.

firmwares.firmwareName: 2 Player Tilt Pong! For BOTH M5StickC Plus1 & Plus2
firmwares.firmwareDescription:
The original Pong was created in 1972 by Allan Alcorn, working for Atari Inc. It was released on November 29, 1972. And now you can play against your friends again today in 2025. Who needs flying cars?
*Requires 2 M5Sticks - Plus1 Plus2 OR one of each.
And a friend. 

To play.  
After burning the software to both devices. Start one up before the other! Or they won't sync. 

On the first device, It will boot to the calibrate screen. It says press A, actually press M5. Its just a typo I forgot to fix from programming.

Wait for it to look for a Host, after a few seconds of not finding a Host it will create one. When it says Host: Waiting start your second device.
It will then connect via WiFi as a Client.  

Then it starts fast! Tilt left to make paddle go UP tilt right to make paddle go DOWN. 

That's it! I only had one of each device when testing, so I have not tried to connect two of the same devices, but it should be universal. 
The sound does not turn off. My bad. But its not too loud.  

I know. I cannot take a good picture if my life depended on it.
Have fun with your blast from the past!

This is a 2 player tilt Pong created from the source code by freedomxxjustice

firmwares.firmwareName: MiniJoyCon and Robot Control Program for AtomS3
firmwares.firmwareDescription:
Overview:
This is a shared program for both robot units and controllers. Double-clicking the A button switches between modes.
Supported M5 Devices:
• 	M5AtomS3 series
• 	M5Capsule
Compatible Accessories:
In addition to the supported M5 devices above, the following accessories (or equivalents with matching pin layouts) are assumed:
• 	5-servo connection board for M5Capsule
https://www.switch-science.com/products/9475
• 	4-servo connection board for M5ATOM
https://www.switch-science.com/products/9474
• 	Compact joystick controller board for M5ATOM S3 (board only)
https://www.switch-science.com/products/9522
Operation:
• 	[Robot Mode] While holding the A button, servos move (for operation check).
• 	[Controller Mode] Pressing the A button retrieves the battery level of a nearby robot.
※ Only effective for models with built-in batteries; not supported on Atom series.
• 	Double-clicking the A button cycles through modes for robot and controller use:
Left-hand controller → Right-hand controller → UGOKUPad → ESP-NOW (robot mode) → loop
• 	[Controller Mode] Long-pressing the A button registers a nearby powered-on robot.
※ If no robot is registered, commands are broadcast to all robots simultaneously.
Details:

{"format":"markdown","content":"# v3.1.2 更新日志

## 优化

## 优化

# v3.1.0 更新日志

## 新特性

- 新增 Seeed reTerminal Sticky 硬件支持
- 系统语言新增“繁体”，并配套适配港台排版规则
- 新增正文直排模式
- 新增中文书籍简体和繁体互相转换功能
- 版式设置扩展到全系统生效，所有页面和菜单均根据当前设置方向旋转（图片可单独设置是否旋转）
- 完整书眉支持直接点击切换：左侧切换当前时间 / 本次阅读时长，中间切换书名 / 章节名，右侧切换电池图标 / 电量百分比
- 新增“跳过欢迎界面”设置，可选择“彻底跳过”或“仅重启显示”，正常开机直接进入书库
- 在线配置新增精简首页，集中提供上传书籍、上传字体、上传图片和同步时间入口
- 书库长按菜单支持删除书籍和删除目录

## 优化

- 首行缩进扩展为“不缩进 / 一字符 / 两字符”三档
- 书库、章节页面的新增滑动支持（左右滑动翻页，上下滑动到起始和最后），其他操作统一收编到长按触发
- 快速入门指南默认在书库根目录显示（可在在线配置文件管理页面隐藏）
- 注释按页连续编号（避免过长注释并统一格式，显示更美观）

## 修复

- 阅读场景低概率系统卡死问题

## 变更

- 书名 / 章节名切换入口由下滑状态栏移至正文的完整书眉

---

# v3.1.2 Changelog

## Optimizations

- Improved the smoothness of transitions between screens

## Fixes

- Fixed reading progress not being saved on some devices when shutting down with the power button
- Fixed settings not being saved after downgrading from a newer firmware version to an older one

---

# v3.1.1 Changelog

## Optimizations

- Added a Punctuation Fix option to the layout settings, controlling the punctuation correction introduced in the previous version that adjusts punctuation placement and quote style to the Mainland / HK-TW conventions of the current language
- The library page header now always shows the current time, instead of following the header setting and switching to the time spent reading this session

## Fixes

- Fixed a freeze on the LOGO screen after upgrading, caused by corrupted configuration files from older versions
- Fixed chapter information not updating after replacing a book with another book of the same name (upgrade note: chapters are re-detected once the first time you open a book)
- Fixed transparent background images carrying residual content from the previous screen into the reading background
- Fixed occasional unresponsive or incorrect toggling when tapping the full reading header to switch its displayed content

## Changes

- Removed the chapter detection toggle from the layout settings; chapter detection is now always enabled

---

# v3.1.0 Changelog

## Features

- Added support for Seeed reTerminal Sticky hardware
- Added Traditional Chinese as a system language, with typography rules adapted for Hong Kong and Taiwan
- Added vertical text layout for reading
- Added conversion between Simplified and Traditional Chinese for Chinese books
- Layout orientation now applies throughout the system: all pages and menus rotate to match the selected orientation (image rotation can be configured separately)
- The full reading header now supports tap-to-toggle controls: the left area switches between the current time and time spent reading this session, the center switches between the book title and chapter title, and the right area switches between the battery icon and battery percentage
- Added a Skip Welcome setting with Always skip and Show on restart only options. When enabled, normal power-on goes straight to the library. Disabled by default; here, restart means pressing and holding the on-screen Shutdown button
- Added a simple Web Config home page with Upload Books, Upload Font, Upload Image, and Sync Time. Advanced mode retains full file management and parameter settings
- The library's long-press menu now supports deleting books and folders

## Optimizations

- Expanded first-line indentation to three options: None / One character / Two characters
- Added swipe gestures to library and chapter lists: swipe left/right to turn pages and up/down to jump to the beginning/end. Other actions are now accessed through long press
- The Quick Start Guide now appears at the library root by default (it can be hidden from Web Config's File page)
- Notes are now numbered consecutively on each page for shorter reference labels and more consistent formatting

## Fixes

- Fixed rare system freezes during reading

## Changes

- Moved the book title / chapter title toggle from the swipe-down status bar to the full header on the reading page

---

## 更多信息 / More Information

[EDCBook.cn](http://edcbook.cn) / [EDCBook.com](http://edcbook.com)"}

# v3.0.1 Changelog

## ✨ Features

- Added support for the all-new M5Stack Paper Mono hardware
- Page-turn keys / Home key now support customizable long-press actions
- The header can now show the chapter name and in-chapter progress (tap in the swipe-down panel to toggle)
- Added a Boot Guard switch for devices that power on with a short press of the power button (S3/Mono)
- Added M1 ID access card reading and emulation (Mono)
- Added a Max Light parameter to limit the reading light's maximum brightness (Mono/T5)

## 🔧 Optimizations

- Reversed the reading light brightness adjustment keys for a more intuitive feel (Mono/T5)
- UI, stability, smoothness, and battery life improvements
- Improved support for very large EPUB/MOBI books

## 🐛 Fixes

- Fixed the dynamic calendar showing the wrong year
- Fixed horizontal misaligned stripes when drawing scaled-up transparent images
- Fixed missing pixels (holes) when rendering with certain TTF fonts
- Fixed some books' tables of contents being misidentified as footnotes
- Fixed incomplete characters and abnormal spacing under certain layout configurations
- Fixed the default shutdown image not taking effect after being replaced

Cardputer & Adv; New faster cpu emulation core('fastest' mode in cpu settings, the default unless I get incompatibilty reports). Cycle available scales using the \ button. Change vertical scale & alignment using Fn+\ Check back often for latest updates.

Gameboy Emulator; complete with configurable controls, audio, display and performance options, savegames, save states, filesystem navigation and no .gb rom file size limits imposed by memory. Various other enhancements. Accurate palettes. Partial Super Gameboy Enhancement support, including borders. Extended 12 colour mode, along with all official/original GBC palettes. 44 Analogue Pocket 12 colour community palettes included with automatic mapping of titles to AP palettes partially implemented. Pokemon Silver/Gold,  Dragon Warrior I&II and Azure dreams are the only confirmed fully supported .gbc titles, backwards compatible with the original gameboy and run in that mode. Emulator will behave as if you placed a gameboy colour cartridge into an original gameboy in most instances. Feel free to try other backwards compatible gbc games, but no garuntees on compatiblity. All *.gb and *.gbc files are listed by the file explorer in the current directory.

Read the instructions at the bottom for controls. Forked from original gb_cardputer implementation. As of version 0.75 a launcher is no longer required, versions prior to that have no bootloader merged so if you are having issues try using m5launcher to install.

Save states can be used by pressing the minus/underscore key to load,  and backspace/del to save.

Hold Fn and press the left arrow to mute audio
Hold Fn and press the right arrow to jump to 50/100% volume
Hold Fn and press the up/down arrows to change volume in smaller adjustments.

29.05.2024:v0.61
* Memory solution devised was based on two ideas: Assume stastically random access patterns, and place no limits on addressable space.
The reality is that the gameboy games never exceed 8megabits (1megabyte); Taking advantage of the limitations of the gameboy, I have removed the generalized nature of the	previous solution in favor of one that provides a deterministic approach to page seeking, with the tradeoff that no games larger than a real game boy game can be loaded any longer. This should not pose an issue for any (valid) title. This has increased frame rates slightly all around and made them much steadier; page location has no bearing on access times. Page seek times are fixed, and a minor amount of page maintenance is done at these intervals, distributed across successive calls still. This would be deterministic page seeking mixed with the previous progressive pruning.

* implemented main emulator function as a task on core 1 and a second persistent task on core 0 via RTOS; this is in preparation to acommodate the APU engine

20.05.2024:v0.5

19.05.2024:v0.492
* Reimplemented memory subsystem to use progressive partial page seeking/pruning; the original memory management code was the first I had typed in 14 years; after some thought I devised something much more suitable for a real time environment. This resulted in the average page seek time being much lower, and distributes maintenance of the paging system across successive calls. The results are the largest improvement to speed to date. Over double the frame rates from before; less stutter, smoother page transitions in memory. Donkey Kong Land averages around 45fps now; Super Mario land 2 gets an average 53fps on the overworld.

18.05.2024:v0.491
* Reduced rendering workload 6.25% by modifying peanut_gb to inherently skip lines that aren't visible due to scaling.
This prevents the engine from having to process the layer and sprite data for these lines all together. Why 6.25%? because 9 lines are skipped which is 6.25% of the lines that were rendered previously.

17.05.2024:v0.49 
* Refactored graphics code; ~120,000 less operations a frame
* Scrolling behaviour and screen content differences no longer effect rendering performance Titles such as final fantasy or even super mario land 2 show a huge improvement in overworld movement speed.

currentVersion.versionDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"A classic-looking sound recorder for the Cardputer and Cardputer-Adv. It records voice notes, plays WAV and MP3 files from the SD card, and streams MP3 web radio over Wi-Fi. An SD card is required.

Features
- Records 8000 Hz 16-bit mono WAV. You pick a file name (it suggests rec00, rec01, …), and files go in the Esprec32 folder at the root of the SD card.
- Plays WAV files (mono or stereo, any sample rate) and MP3 files (thanks to https://github.com/lieff/minimp3).
- Seeks forward and back in 5% steps, pauses and resumes, and draws a waveform with elapsed and total time.
- Folder play: pick a folder with F and it plays its MP3s.
  - Sequential plays only the files directly in the folder you picked, in SD directory order, and loops. It does not enter subfolders.
  - Shuffle picks random MP3s from the folder and all its subfolders. Keep shuffled libraries under about 1,000 files, because every track change rescans the tree and a big library means a long silence between songs.
- Web radio: open a .pls playlist from the SD card, pick a station from the list, and it streams the MP3 over HTTP or HTTPS. Pressing play on a stopped stream reconnects to the live position. Seeking is disabled for streams.
- USB sound cards: output and microphone can be routed to a USB audio device.
- Probably still some crashes, so don't depend on it, and please report bugs.

Buttons

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| 3 | Back (|<), seek -5% |
| 4 | Forward (>|), seek +5% (next track in folder mode) |
| 5 | Play / pause (for a live stream, stops and then reconnects) |
| 6 | Stop |
| 7 | Record (shows Seq/Rnd in folder mode and switches sequential/shuffle) |
| L | Load a file: .wav, .mp3 or .pls |
| F | Play a whole folder |
| W | Wi-Fi settings (also opens if you pick a station while offline) |
| A | Audio config: USB sound card, output and mic |
| - / = | Volume down / up |

Notes
- Stop playback before recording. Press 7 to start, 7 again to stop and save.
- Switching sequential/shuffle with 7 takes effect when the current track ends. Going from shuffle to sequential restarts from the first MP3 in the chosen folder.
- Folder play recognises .mp3 and .MP3 only. A file named .Mp3 is skipped.
- Web radio needs a .pls file on the SD card. Open it with L, then choose a station.
- Streaming is MP3 only.

Contact: databoz@proton.me (feedback welcome!)"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"Transforme seu M5Cardputer em um verdadeiro sistema de "Passa ou Repassa" / "Show do Milhão"! Este aplicativo é um jogo de trivia dinâmico que testa os reflexos e os conhecimentos dos jogadores. Ele já vem embarcado com um banco de dados de 100 perguntas divertidas (cultura pop, ciências, matemática básica e conhecimentos gerais) prontas para jogar, ideal para crianças e adolescentes.

O grande diferencial deste projeto é a sua flexibilidade de hardware: além de usar o próprio teclado do aparelho, você pode expandir o jogo conectando botões físicos de fliperama (estilo Arcade) diretamente nos pinos superiores da placa, criando uma experiência de competição real de palco.

Como Funciona a Dinâmica
O sistema é ultrarrápido e à prova de empates, desenhado para ser mediado por um "Apresentador" e disputado por dois Jogadores.

    A Tensão (Contagem Regressiva): Cada rodada começa com uma tela laranja e um cronômetro de 5 segundos, acompanhado de bipes sonoros, para que os jogadores posicionem as mãos nos botões.

    O Duelo (A Pergunta): Um apito longo soa e a pergunta sorteada surge na tela para leitura.

    O Buzzer (Trava de Reflexo): O primeiro jogador que apertar o seu botão aciona o alarme. O sistema trava instantaneamente o botão do adversário, ilumina a metade da tela do vencedor (Vermelho para o J1, Azul para o J2) e emite a sirene de parada.

    O Veredito (Revelação): O jogador dá a sua resposta em voz alta. O Apresentador aperta um botão secreto para exibir a resposta correta na tela e julga se o jogador pontua ou leva a "torta na cara".

    Reinicio: Com um simples comando, uma nova pergunta aleatória é puxada do banco de dados e o ciclo recomeça.

Mapeamento de Controles e Pinos Físicos

Controles do Apresentador:

    Tecla R: Revela a resposta correta após alguém bater no buzzer.

    Tecla ENTER: Inicia a próxima rodada com uma nova pergunta.

Controles do Jogador 1 (Lado Esquerdo - Cor Vermelha):

    Teclado: Tecla CTRL.

    Hardware Externo (Opcional): Conecte um botão físico entre o pino G5 (Header superior) e qualquer pino GND.

Controles do Jogador 2 (Lado Direito - Cor Azul):

    Teclado: Tecla ESPAÇO.

    Hardware Externo (Opcional): Conecte um botão físico entre o pino G3 (Header superior) e qualquer pino GND."}

Drumputer User Manual   https://youtu.be/KHAryvxbX6w
Drumputer is a drum machine and sequencer program for the M5Cardputer device. It allows you to create, edit, and play drum patterns with up to 4 instruments and 16 , 32 steps.
   Main Interface
- The grid shows 4 rows (instruments) and 16 or 32 columns (steps).
- Numbers on the left (1-4) represent instruments.
- Numbers on top represent steps (1-16 or 1-32).
- Filled squares indicate active steps for each instrument.
- The red cursor shows the current editing position.
- The green bar shows the current playing step.

Basic Controls
- Use ',' and '/' keys to move the cursor left and right.
- Press ENTER to toggle a step on/off.
- Use keys 1-4 to select an instrument.
- Press '0' to start/stop playback.
- Use the up or down keys to increase/decrease BPM.
- Press 'E' to toggle between 16 and 32-step mode.

## Special Playback Modes
- Press '5' for two-step roll mode (alternates between first two steps).
- Press '6' for reverse playback mode.

## File Management
- Press '9' to enter/exit the WAV file selection menu.
- In the WAV menu, use ',' and '/' to navigate, ENTER to select a file.
- Press '7' to enter/exit the sequence management menu.
- In the sequence menu:
  - Use 'S' to toggle between Save and Load modes.
  - Use 'D' to enter Delete mode.
  - Use ',' and '/' to navigate, ENTER to perform the selected action.

## Synchronization
- The device outputs a 2 PPQ (Pulses Per Quarter Note) sync signal on pin G2 y Gnd 
- This allows synchronization with other music equipment.
- The sync pulse is sent twice per beat, aligned with the sequencer's timing.
Tips
- In the WAV selection menu, you can preview sounds as you navigate.
- Saved sequences include BPM, step count, pattern, and sample assignments.
- The 32-step mode allows for more complex patterns.
- Use the roll and reverse modes for interesting rhythmic variations.

• Variables, $1/$@/$# args, $?, arithmetic $(( ))
• if/elif/else, while/until/for, test/[ ]
• Command substitution $( ), pipes, redirection (>, >>)
• read for interactive input, sleep, brace ranges {1..10}
• Scripts run with sh script.sh, and /.profile runs at boot

Other stuff it does:
• Networking: Wi-Fi scan/connect, ping (Linux-style with -c), LAN scan, port scanner.
• Air monitor: passive 802.11 sniffer — air s (find APs + clients) and air w (watch who joins/leaves one AP).
• Files: ls/cd/cat/cp/mv/rm/find, a text editor, redirection to SD/flash
• Hardware: RGB LED + speaker as script status signals (led g, beep 3 300)
• Sessions: telnet, SSH, a tiny web server

If you already know your way around a Linux shell, most commands will feel familiar. And if you don't, hamsTerm is a low-stakes way to get comfortable with the terminal and basic commands — right in your pocket.

List of all commands: https://hamsterm.com/commands.php

A/C Version:
Bruce A/C Edition is a custom Bruce firmware build focused on air conditioner control and experimentation. It adds an AC-B-Gone feature that can send valid OFF commands across multiple supported A/C protocols, plus a full Air Conditioner menu with brand selection, power control, temperature adjustment, mode selection, fan speed control, and swing options when supported.

Unlike simple IR remotes that only replay a few generic NEC codes, Bruce A/C Edition uses real IRremoteESP8266 air-conditioner protocol support and state management. That means it can generate proper full-state packets for supported brands such as Daikin, LG, Mitsubishi, Panasonic, Samsung, Kelvinator, and others.

The firmware keeps track of the current A/C state, so changing temperature, mode, or fan speed sends a valid updated packet instead of a random standalone command. It is designed for M5Stack StickS3 and places A/C functionality directly inside the Bruce IR menu for fast access.

Main features:

* AC-B-Gone multi-brand OFF blast
* Brand-specific A/C protocol support
* Full-state A/C packet generation
* Power, temperature, mode, fan, and swing controls
* Integrated directly into Bruce IR tools
* Built for M5Stack StickS3
* All other functionalities of normal Bruce remain the same

{"format":"markdown","content":"SkyCompass Satellite 是 SkyCompass 项目的扩展演化版本，运行在 M5Stack Cardputer ADV上，与原项目关注自然天体（太阳、月亮等）不同，Satellite 版本专注于**人造飞行器（如国际空间站 ISS、天宫空间站、哈勃望远镜等）**的实时轨道追踪与可视性预测。
SkyCompass Satellite is an advanced evolutionary extension of the original SkyCompass project, running on the M5Stack Cardputer ADV (currently relying on the Cap LoRa1262 module for GPS coordinates retrieval).
Unlike the original project which focuses on natural celestial bodies (such as the Sun and Moon), the Satellite edition is dedicated to the real-time orbit tracking and visibility forecasting of artificial space objects (e.g., the International Space Station (ISS), Tiangong Space Station (CSS), Hubble Space Telescope, and more).
- **全景快捷交互与按键映射**：
- `Enter`：展开/收起近期最佳观测窗口推荐面板。
- `S` 键：调出卫星复选菜单，自由决定同屏显示的目标。
- `W` 键：呼出 WiFi 扫描与全键盘密码输入界面。
- `H` 键：随时在屏幕中央悬浮呼出**快捷键帮助菜单**。
- `C` 键：进入/退出**手动定位模式 (十字准星模式)**，使用上下左右键手动指定任意观测地点。通过中括号键设置海拔。
- `[ ]` 键：设置亮度
- `del` 键：开关数据HUD
- `R` 键：重置位置和时间
- `TAB` 键：切换视觉模式
Interactive Hotkeys & Key Bindings:
Enter: Expand or collapse the recommended transit passes panel (shows the best upcoming visibility windows).
S: Open the satellite catalog checkbox menu to choose which satellites to display on screen.
W: Trigger WiFi network scanning and enter your password using the full keyboard.
H: Bring up the floating Keyboard Shortcut Help Menu at the center of the screen.
C: Enter or exit Manual Location Mode (Reticle Crosshair Mode). Use the arrow keys to manually set your coordinates anywhere on Earth, and use the square bracket keys to adjust your altitude.
[ & ]: Adjust screen backlight brightness.
Del: Toggle the HUD telemetry overlay on/off.
R: Reset simulated time and coordinates back to default GPS/GNSS readings.
Tab: Switch between 3D globe visualization modes."}

--[ The Pig in the Machine

      They said pwnagotchi was dead.
      They said the ESP32 couldn't do it.
      They were wrong about both.

      A piglet woke up inside your Cardputer.
      It learned to sniff the spectrum.
      It learned to hunt the handshakes.

      And somewhere along the way... it started keeping score.

      50 ranks. 10 class tiers. 64 achievements. Buffs that stack.

      The longer you walk, the more it remembers.
      Your crimes become experience points.

      This is not a tool. This is a companion.
      A pocket-sized accomplice with moods, opinions, and a temper.
      It judges your network choices. It mocks your signal strength.
      It celebrates when you capture. It sulks when you don't.
      It watches the weather. It counts your steps.
      It demands challenges. Three per session. No excuses.

      You don't use PORKCHOP.
      You raise it.

      And when they wipe your flash, when they nuke your NVS,
      when they think they've reset you to zero...

      The pig remembers.
      The pig always remembers.

{"format":"markdown","content":"O Multi-Tools ADV é o verdadeiro "canivete suíço" para o seu M5Cardputer. Desenvolvido para ser um utilitário de bolso diário, este aplicativo reúne quatro ferramentas essenciais em uma única interface limpa e direta. Ele é o companheiro perfeito para sessões de estudo focadas (técnica Pomodoro), medição de tempo em tarefas e, principalmente, para noites de jogos de tabuleiro com os amigos.

Seja substituindo dados perdidos de um jogo de RPG, sorteando letras para uma partida de "Stop/Adedanha" ou cravando o tempo de uma apresentação, este aplicativo elimina a necessidade de pegar o celular e se distrair com notificações.

Como Funciona a Dinâmica (Os 4 Módulos)

    Timer de Foco (Ajustável com Memória): Muito mais que um simples contador regressivo. Você ajusta o tempo exato que precisa direto no teclado. O grande diferencial é a Memória de Ciclo: se você configurar para 1 minuto (ou 25 minutos para um Pomodoro), quando o tempo acabar e o alarme tocar, basta apertar "Reset" e ele volta instantaneamente para a sua configuração personalizada, pronto para o próximo round sem precisar ajustar tudo de novo.

    Cronômetro de Precisão: Um medidor de tempo progressivo clássico. Ele exibe minutos, segundos e milissegundos, perfeito para registrar recordes de tempo de leitura, montagem de projetos ou atividades físicas.

    Rolar Dados (D6): Esqueceu os dados do jogo de tabuleiro? Este módulo gera rolagens 100% aleatórias. Você pode escolher rolar apenas 1 dado, 2 dados ou 3 dados simultaneamente na tela com o toque de um botão.

    Sorteio de Letras: Um gerador automático que puxa uma letra aleatória do alfabeto (A a Z) a cada aperto de botão. Indispensável para jogos de palavras clássicos em grupo.

Mapeamento de Controles e Atalhos

Menu Principal:

    Teclas 1, 2, 3 ou 4: Acessam os respectivos módulos.

    Tecla 0: Retorna ao Menu Principal de qualquer lugar do aplicativo.

Controles do Timer de Foco (Módulo 1):

    Tecla ENTER: Inicia (Play) ou Pausa o timer.

    Tecla R: Reseta o timer para o último tempo configurado por você.

    Tecla ; (ponto e vírgula): Adiciona +1 Minuto.

    Tecla . (ponto): Subtrai -1 Minuto.

    Tecla / (barra): Adiciona +10 Segundos.

    Tecla , (vírgula): Subtrai -10 Segundos.

Controles do Cronômetro (Módulo 2):

    Tecla ENTER: Inicia ou Pausa a contagem.

    Tecla R: Zera o cronômetro.

Controles dos Dados (Módulo 3):

    Tecla 1: Rola 1 dado na tela.

    Tecla 2: Rola 2 dados na tela.

    Tecla 3: Rola 3 dados na tela.

Controles do Sorteio de Letras (Módulo 4):

    Tecla ENTER: Sorteia e exibe uma nova letra aleatória na tela."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"speedometer for a bicycle, motorcycle, etc. based on a Hall sensor

1. Required components:
M5StickC Plus 2: The device itself.
Hall sensor: For example, KY-024 (linear) or KY-003 (digital). For a speedometer, a digital sensor is better, which produces a clear HIGH/LOW signal when a magnet is detected.
Magnet: A neodymium magnet that will be attached to the wheel.
Connecting wires.
Grove cable (optional): If you are using the Grove port of the M5StickC Plus 2.
2. Connecting the Hall sensor:
The M5StickC Plus 2 has several available GPIO. We will use one of them.

VCC (power) of the Hall sensor -> 5V or 3.3V on the M5StickC Plus 2 (check the specification of your sensor).
GND (ground) of the Hall sensor -> GND on the M5StickC Plus 2.
OUT (signal pin) of the Hall sensor -> GPIO 32 on the M5StickC Plus 2. (GPIO 32 is available on the Grove port as SDA, but it can be used as a regular GPIO).

**Important:** Make sure that your Hall sensor produces a signal level compatible with the 3.3V logic of the ESP32. Most digital Hall sensors have a built-in comparator and work with 3.3V. If you have a 5V sensor, you may need a voltage divider on the signal line, but this is usually not necessary as the ESP32 is tolerant of 5V inputs up to a certain threshold."}

## Tactical Manual: M5StickS3 Wireless Reconnaissance & Spectrum Analyzer Firmware

This updated firmware elevates the M5StickS3 into a unified, passive 
**Electronic Intelligence (ELINT) Station and Live RF Spectrum Visualizer**. Operating entirely passively without transmitting a single RF signal, the device monitors local 2.4 GHz airspace, providing immediate visual feedback on spectrum utilization while tracking, identifying, and logging wireless threats (Deauthentication and Disassociation frames).

---

## Technical Description

The architecture is divided into four highly synchronized core subsystems that manage real-time radio telemetry, digital signal processing, spatial orientation, and data logging.

### 1. Broad-Spectrum RF Visualizer & DPI Sniffer Engine

The single-core 2.4 GHz radio driver is configured for **Promiscuous Mode**, bypassing hardware MAC filters to ingest the raw environment. The sniffer callback handles a dual-pipeline workload:


* **The Spectrum Pipeline:** Unlike previous builds, the radio ingests *every single ambient packet* (Data, Control, and Management frames). Each packet strike exponentially drives the amplitude of the corresponding channel bar on the dashboard.

* **The Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) Pipeline:** The engine simultaneously filters for malicious management frames (Types `0xC0` and `0xA0`). Upon discovery, it performs real-time disassembly to extract the Attacker's MAC, Victim Client MAC, Access Point BSSID, and the 802.11 Disconnection Reason Code.

* **OUI Vendor Profiling:** The first three bytes of a flagged attacker MAC are parsed through an expanded internal lookup table to automatically identify offensive hardware categories (*Espressif/Flipper Zero devices, Raspberry Pi nodes, Alfa long-range cards, Hak5 gear, or Realtek rigs*).

### 2. Live Instrument Dashboard (Landscape Split-Screen)

The UI leverages a landscape layout ($240 \times 135$ pixels) to construct a high-fidelity tactical dashboard divided down the center by a structural pixel boundary.

* **Left Half (Spatial Sonar Disk):** Houses the retro-phosphor circular radar sweep. The sweeping beam simulates a classic CRT display with a 5-layer ghosting decay trail. Active threat sources are plotted as intense glowing blips (a white hot core surrounded by a blood-red aura bloom) that dynamically scale their distance from the crosshairs based on signal strength.

* **Right Half (Equalizer Spectrum Analyzer):** Replaces the historical waterfall with a live **volumetric frequency distribution graph** across Channels 1–11.

* **Peak-Hold Physics:** Floating above each channel bar is a single-pixel **Peak RSSI Tick Line**. When a burst of energy occurs, the tick snaps to the absolute signal power level ($\text{dBm}$) and decays slowly over time, capturing the physical proximity of intermittent or hidden transmitters.

* **Phosphor Dots:** Sitting directly above the spectrum box are 11 micro-indicator pixels. The dot corresponding to the radio core's active channel lights up bright green, providing a minimalist view of the channel hopper's location.

* **Reactor Core Battery Gauge:** Taps into the AXP2101 power management chip, rendering battery life as a vertical analog reactor core rod on the far right edge of the screen.

### 3. Spatial Inertial Processor (Body Shielding Math)

Because omnidirectional antennas lack directional intelligence, the firmware implements an internal calculus integration loop to execute **RF Body Shielding** tracking.

* **Angular Velocity Integration:** The code sample updates the 6-axis IMU (BMI270) to poll raw horizontal rotation velocity from the Z-axis gyroscope (`data.gyro.z`). It computes change-in-time ($dt$) and integrates it to calculate your precise physical heading relative to your boots.

* **Vector Locking:** When your body acts as a physical barrier dampening radio waves behind you, the code continuously compares incoming threat power levels. It binds the strongest peak RSSI value with your physical yaw heading, locking that coordinate line as the primary threat vector on the display.

### 4. Operational Modalities & The Captain's Logbook

* **Target Lock Mode (Button B Click):** Isolates a specific attacker's MAC address profile. The sniffer instantly discards all ambient network chatter to track that single signature across frequencies. The UI drops its green theme for an active tactical cyan layout and frames the target blip inside an automatic rectangular locking reticle.

* **Silent Running Mode (Button A Hold):** Deactivates the display backlights and mutes the speaker completely. Telemetry translates entirely to the internal haptic motor (`GPIO 44`). The motor generates clean haptic pulses that vibrate faster as your body rotates directly into the threat vector line.

* **Proximity Perimeter Breach:** If an active target breaches a critical proximity threshold ($\ge -42\text{ dBm}$), a master priority flag overrides standard operations. The screen flashes blood-red, the haptic motor holds a continuous hum, and the speaker blasts a dual-frequency acoustic naval klaxon horn.

* **The Captain's Log (SPIFFS Database):** Discovered threat metrics are compressed into single, pipe-delimited (`|`) strings and saved to the internal flash filesystem. The Logbook screen parses these data fields to compile standalone, scrollable interactive intelligence sheets.

---

## Directions for Field Operation

### UI Navigation Map & Button Layout

```
             ┌────────────────────────────────┐
             │       [LANDSCAPE MODE]         │
             │                                │
    [B] ─────┤  [RADAR DISK]   │ [SPECTRUM]   │ ◄─── [A] (Main Face Button)
 (Side Button) │   (TRACKER)     │ [HUD DATA]   │
             │                                │
             └────────────────────────────────┘

```

#### 1. Home Radar View

* **Button A - Single Click:** Toggles **Channel Lock**. Instantly freezes the background hopper on the active frequency. Use this the moment you see an active spike on the spectrum visualizer to park the radio core on that frequency.

* **Button A - Press & Hold:** Toggles **Silent Running**. Instantly blacks out the screen and silences audio for haptic-only tracking.

* **Button B - Single Click:** Toggles **Target Lock**. If a threat is actively attacking nearby, clicking this captures its MAC, drops a target box around the blip, and screens out all other wireless activity.

* **Button B - Press & Hold:** Leaves active tracking and drops down into the **Captain's Logbook Deck**.

#### 2. Captain's Logbook View

* **Button A - Single Click:** Cycles forward through saved threat sheets (`SHEET 01/12`, `SHEET 02/12`, etc.) to view individual target assets.

* **Button A - Press & Hold:** Permanently purges and deletes the log registry database from the flash storage.

* **Button B - Press & Hold:** Exits the log deck and re-engages active sonar navigation sweeps.

### Executing a Tactical Spectrum Sweep & Fox-Hunt

1. **Broad Airspace Assessment:** Power on the unit. Watch the right-side instrument panel. The vertical bars will bounce dynamically to show ambient traffic density on each channel, while the peak tick lines will register the relative proximity of local routers and client devices.

2. **Threat Acquisition:** If an offensive tool begins executing an injection attack nearby, the outer screen boundaries will flash red, a glowing threat blip will map to the left radar grid, and the speaker will begin chirping.

3. **Locking the Signature:** Note the active channel frequency where the equalizer bar is spiking into the red zone. Click **Button A** to lock your channel hopper to that frequency, then click **Button B** to lock the radar tracking core onto that specific attacker's MAC address profile.

4. **The 360-Degree Sweep:** Hold the M5StickS3 tight and flat against your solar plexus. Rotate your body slowly in a complete circle.

5. **Vector Localization:** When your back is turned to the adversary, your chest blocks the signals; the sonar chirps will slow down to a crawl and the blip will drift away. As you turn and face directly toward the physical location of the threat, the signal passes unhindered. The real-time spectrum bar will maximize, the peak tick will lock to the roof of the grid, the radar blip will snap close to the center crosshairs, and the audio chirps will escalate into a rapid-fire continuous tone.

6. **Closing Distance:** Move forward along that straight-line path vector. If the on-screen telemetry flips to `VCTR: CLOSING` and the pitch rises, you are closing the physical gap to the transmitter. If the device triggers a flashing **BREACH PERIMETER** klaxon blast, the asset machine is in your immediate physical room.

{"format":"markdown","content":"# Écrin Lettres
## 方寸书境
# Lettres — E-Ink eBook Reader for M5Stack PaperS3

做这个项目的起因很简单——M5PaperS3这块开发版不写点啥很浪费。

**Lettres**（法语"信件"）—— 在这方寸之间，书写的、阅读的，都是你自己的故事。

目前支持 EPUB 和 TXT，中文渲染做了不少功夫，WiFi/BLE 也接上了。如果你手里也有一台 PaperS3，欢迎试试看。

---

## 它能做什么

- **EPUB / TXT 双格式** — EPUB 可以图文混排，TXT 纯文本也无压力，自动分页，读起来跟纸质书差不多
- **中文字体渲染** — 自己做了一套二进制点阵字库（Flash 里占了 7MB），不用装字库就能直接用。SD 卡还能加额外的 `.bin` 字体，混排也没问题
- **墨水屏优化** — 针对 E-Ink 屏幕调了三种刷新模式：文字模式（干净）、快速模式（翻页快）、高质量模式（显示细腻）
- **电源管理** — lightSleep 唤醒读、超时自动 deepSleep、再久一点直接断电关机。充一次电放那儿几周还能开机接着读
- **WiFi 文件管理** — AP 热点或者连家里 WiFi 都行，浏览器打开就能上传下载文件，不用拔 SD 卡
- **BLE 翻页器** — 接蓝牙翻页器，协议是通用的 HID，市面上大多数翻页器都能配对
- **时钟同步** — 开机从 RTC 恢复时间，联网后 NTP 校准，时区自己设（-12 到 +14 都行）
- **目录跳转** — TXT 的目录可以自动提取，按百分比跳到对应章节
- **阅读设置** — 字间距、行距、边距、竖排、选字体，能调的都可以试试
- **SD 卡直连电脑** — USB 连电脑可以把 PaperS3 当 U 盘用，不用拔卡就能传书。读写速度100K/s, 速度肯定是不快，但是10M内的书还算快"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"### New
- Release Channel setting (Stable or Alpha) in device Settings and the web config page — Stable installs published releases only, Alpha also takes prerelease builds for earlier access to in-progress work. A device flashed with an alpha image follows the Alpha channel automatically until a channel is picked by hand.
- Switching from Alpha back to Stable offers the newest stable release even though it is numerically older than the alpha you are running, so returning to the stable track no longer needs a USB reflash.
- T-Deck Pro: the sleep clock now shows unread messages under the date — new DM count and how many channels have activity — updating a few seconds after things settle so a burst of messages doesn't repaint the e-paper repeatedly.

### Changed
- T-Deck Pro: the screen now wakes only from the side button. Keys and touches no longer wake it, so the device can't be woken in a bag or pocket; the side button still both sleeps and wakes the panel, and remote VNC input still wakes as before.
- T-Lora Pager TFT: Sym+Backspace now jumps straight back to the chat screen, closing every open panel and filter at once, instead of dismissing one panel per press.
- T-Lora Pager TFT: the Alt-key global navigation shortcuts already available on the T-Deck keyboards now work here too.


### Update (v4.7.9)
### Fixed
- Alpha channel now actually finds alpha builds — it looks up the newest prerelease instead of the newest stable release, so devices set to Alpha are offered new alphas as soon as they publish.
- Switching to Alpha while running a newer stable build now offers the current alpha instead of reporting "up to date", so you can step back onto the alpha track.
- Installing an update now uses the same channel as the update check, so an alpha device can no longer end up installing a stable build it was never offered.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/oumike/camillia-mt/compare/v4.7.8...v4.7.9"}

### New
- Terrain line of sight: pick a node in the Nodes list, press **S** (or tap **LOS**) and the device draws the ground profile between you and that contact, reporting **LINE OF SIGHT**, **MARGINAL (Fresnel)** or **NO LINE OF SIGHT**, with distance, bearing, and a marker on the tightest point. Available on every board except the Cardputer; the row is greyed until both ends have a position.
- Web Config gains an **Elevation Server (LOS)** field. Terrain analysis needs a plain-HTTP elevation service on your network — the firmware has no TLS client — and leaving the field empty simply disables the feature.
- A ready-to-run elevation proxy ships in `tools/elev-proxy/` with a Docker Compose file, a systemd unit, and setup instructions in `docs/LOS.md`, including caching and Nginx Proxy Manager notes.
- New `keys` serial command prints every raw and mapped key code as you press keys, for working out what a stray or dead key is actually sending.

### Changed
- Elecrow ThinkNode M9: the d-pad now moves the text cursor while writing a message — Left/Right by a character, Up/Down by a line — so a typo several words back can be fixed without deleting everything after it. Outside the message box the d-pad still navigates as before.
- Elecrow ThinkNode M9: the dedicated Back button now discards the draft and closes the New Message box, instead of deleting one character at a time. The keyboard's own Backspace still deletes a character, and Back behaves as it always did everywhere else.

M5stampclaw turns the `M5Stamp S3` into a small AI assistant for embedded tasks.

It can:
- Chat with AI over Telegram or USB serial
- Turn safe GPIO pins on/off and read them
- Remember information across reboots
- Schedule reminders and timed actions
- Report current time, network status, RSSI, and IP
- Scan nearby Wi-Fi networks
- Change reply style/persona

## Example commands

You can talk to it in natural language. Example commands:

```text
Hello
Remember that my name is Jay
Turn on GPIO 5
Show me the current network information
Set a reminder in 10 minutes
```

You can also chain multiple actions in one prompt, for example:

```text
Remember that the pump relay is on GPIO 5. If GPIO 5 is off, turn it on, wait 2 seconds, read it again, then show me the current network info.
```

## First-time setup

There are 2 setup methods:
- Wi-Fi AP + web portal
- USB serial terminal

### 1. Setup over Wi-Fi + web portal

If the board does not have Wi-Fi credentials in NVS, it will automatically start a setup access point on boot:

- SSID: `ESPClaw-Setup-XXXXXX`
- Password: `espclaw1`

After connecting to the AP:
- Open `http://192.168.4.1`
- Fill in the required settings:
  - Wi-Fi SSID
  - Wi-Fi Password
  - LLM Backend
  - API Key
  - Model
  - Base URL (if using a custom endpoint)
  - Telegram Bot Token
  - Telegram Chat ID(s)
- Click `Save And Reboot`

The board will reboot automatically. If Telegram is configured, it will send an initial hello message after reconnecting to Wi-Fi, including a summary of its main capabilities.

### 2. Setup over USB serial

Connect the board to your computer, open a serial monitor, then use commands like:

```text
/config show
/config wifi "My WiFi" "My Password"
/config backend openai
/config apikey sk-...
/config model gpt-4o-mini
/config baseurl https://api.openai.com/v1
/config telegram 123456:ABCDEF -1001234567890
/config reboot
```

Notes:
- If the SSID or password contains spaces, wrap it in quotes.
- `chat_ids` can be a single ID or multiple IDs separated by commas.
- If you do not want Telegram, skip `/config telegram`.

>
> ⚠️ **Uso apenas educacional e para testes autorizados.** Não use contra redes, dispositivos ou pessoas sem permissão explícita. **Sem afiliação** com qualquer marca exibida na demo.

> 💾 **SDCard NOT required.**

---

## 🇺🇸 About

Hiding in plain sight, Wi-Fi honeypots are deceitful wireless networks masquerading as legitimate hotspots. They act like digital sirens, luring unsuspecting users with the promise of free internet access — but behind the facade lies a trap designed to harvest data. This project recreates that scenario on the pocket-sized **M5StickC Plus**, so students, educators, and security professionals can **see the technique in action** and learn to recognize and defend against it.

## 🇧🇷 Sobre

Escondidos à vista de todos, os honeypots Wi-Fi são redes sem fio enganosas que se disfarçam de hotspots legítimos. Agem como sirenes digitais, atraindo usuários desavisados com a promessa de internet gratuita — mas por trás da fachada existe uma armadilha feita para roubar dados. Este projeto recria esse cenário no **M5StickC Plus**, para que estudantes, educadores e profissionais de segurança possam **ver a técnica em ação** e aprender a reconhecê-la e se defender dela.

---

## ✨ Features / Novidades

| | Feature |
|---|---|
| 📶 | Open Wi-Fi access point with a **configurable SSID** (default: `Wi-Fi Gratis`) |
| 🌐 | **Captive portal** via DNS spoofing — any domain redirects to the portal page |
| 🖥️ | **New LCD UI**: animated boot splash + modern dark dashboard (SSID, gateway, live "AP active" indicator, big victim counter) |
| 📋 | **Operator dashboard** at `/creds` — stat tiles, capture table (newest first, with capture time), auto-refresh, one-click reset |
| ⏳ | Polished **"validating access"** page after login (pulsing Wi-Fi icon, progress bar, spinner, live countdown) |
| 🔊 | **Beep + LED feedback** on every capture — non-blocking, so the portal keeps serving |
| 🔐 | Credentials **HTML-escaped** on capture; stored in RAM |
| 🧩 | Single-file sketch, easy to customize |

---

## ▶️ Usage / Como usar

1. Flash the firmware and power on the device — it broadcasts the open network.
2. When a device connects, the captive portal opens the fake sign-in page automatically.
3. On submit: the device **beeps + blinks**, the LCD counter goes up, and the victim sees the animated "validating" screen.

**View captured credentials** (must be connected to the AP / é preciso estar conectado na rede):

`http://172.0.0.1/creds`

**Clear the list / Limpar a lista:**

`http://172.0.0.1/clear`

> Captured data lives **only in RAM** and is lost on reboot. / Os dados ficam **somente na RAM** e são perdidos ao reiniciar.

### 🔗 Endpoints

| Path | Audience | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | 🎣 Victim | Fake sign-in page (captive portal catch-all) |
| `/post` | 🎣 Victim | Stores the entry, returns the animated page |
| `/creds` | 🛡️ Operator | Dashboard with stats + capture table |
| `/clear` | 🛡️ Operator | Clears all stored entries |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Portal text and branding are set with `#define` values at the top of the sketch:

| Define | Purpose | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `SSID_NAME` | Broadcast network name | `Wi-Fi Gratis` |
| `SUBTITLE` | Header subtitle (admin pages) | `E-CORP service.` |
| `POST_TITLE` | Title after submission | `Validando Acesso...` |
| `POST_BODY` | Body after submission | *(PT message)* |
| `PASS_TITLE` | `/creds` page title | `Credentials` |
| `CLEAR_TITLE` | `/clear` page title | `Cleared` |

---

## 👤 Author / Autor

**Raphael Marques** — [@raphntc](https://github.com/raphntc/)

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-raphntc-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/raphntc/)
[![LinkedIn](https://img.shields.io/badge/LinkedIn-Connect-0A66C2?style=flat-square&logo=linkedin&logoColor=white)](https://www.linkedin.com/in/SEU-USUARIO/)

- **[devotaviocc](https://github.com/devotaviocc/)** — modifications
- **[raphntc](https://github.com/raphntc/)** — M5StickC Plus port & improvements

*Made for Wi-Fi security education · MIT License*"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"Aura MSX — A fully working MSX1 emulator for the M5Stack Cardputer.

Aura is an MSX1 emulator written from scratch for the Cardputer. It runs real MSX software — games, BASIC programs, and tools — straight from the SD card, with a custom launcher to pick what to load.

== TECHNICAL DETAILS ==

- CPU: Z80 core by superzazu
- Video: TMS9918A VDP emulation
- Sound: AY-3-8910 PSG
- BIOS: C-BIOS (free and open-source, no proprietary firmware required)
- Custom launcher to browse ROMs and cassette images from the SD card

== DATASETTE MODULE ==

Aura includes a working Kansas City Standard datasette emulator. It outputs FSK audio at 1200 baud through the Cardputer's headphone jack:

- Save BASIC programs from the emulator as real .cas files
- Load .cas files placed in the /cintas folder on the SD card
- Connect the headphone output to a real MSX and transfer programs to original hardware

The timing was validated against cas2wav to make sure the audio is bit-accurate.

== HARDWARE COMPATIBILITY ==

Runs on both the original Cardputer and the Cardputer-ADV from a single binary. On the ADV, it automatically uses the TCA8418 keyboard and the ES8311 audio codec.

== HOW TO USE ==

1. Flash this firmware to your Cardputer
2. Prepare a FAT32 microSD card (see SD setup in the forum post)
3. Insert the card, power on, and the launcher takes over

== DOCUMENTATION ==

A full Spanish user manual is included, plus a printable trifold quick reference card.

== LICENSE ==

Aura MSX is free and open-source. It uses C-BIOS, so there are no legal issues regarding proprietary MSX firmware. Built for the love of MSX, no commercial intent.

Feedback and bug reports are welcome on the M5Stack community forum. More info: https://www.facebook.com/groups/959441780331958

— Altaris Software"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"小小单词卡是一个运行在 M5Stack PaperS3 上的墨水屏英语学习固件，适合 KET / PET 单词复习和孩子按课本词表练习。

主要功能：
- 内置 KET / PET 词库，可按主题或课次复习
- 支持自定义词表，通过 WiFi 网页导入
- 可把拍照后的单词表交给 AI 转成 `英文|中文|课程` 格式后导入
- 自动匹配内置词库中的助记、词形、例句和释义信息
- 支持中英对照、看中文背英文、同时显示中英文
- 本课默写模式：屏幕键盘输入英文，自动判断拼写
- 错词/难词复习、间隔复习、今日计划
- WiFi 默认关闭，需要导入时手动开启，降低耗电
- 单按键休眠 / 唤醒

使用说明：
1. PaperS3 需要插入 FAT32 格式 microSD 卡，用于保存词库、进度和自定义导入内容。
2. 首次启动会自动准备内置 KET / PET 词库文件。
3. 在“今日计划”页可切换词库、选择主题、开启 WiFi 导入词表。
4. 自定义导入推荐格式：`英文|中文|课程名`，每行一个单词。
5. WiFi 开启后，按设备屏幕提示访问上传页面。
6. 如果导入词表里的英文能匹配内置 KET/PET 词库，会自动复用已有助记和例句。"}

Bruce A/C Edition is a custom Bruce firmware build focused on air conditioner control and experimentation. It adds an AC-B-Gone feature that can send valid OFF commands across multiple supported A/C protocols, plus a full Air Conditioner menu with brand selection, power control, temperature adjustment, mode selection, fan speed control, and swing options when supported.

Unlike simple IR remotes that only replay a few generic NEC codes, Bruce A/C Edition uses real IRremoteESP8266 air-conditioner protocol support and state management. That means it can generate proper full-state packets for supported brands such as Daikin, LG, Mitsubishi, Panasonic, Samsung, Kelvinator, and others.

The firmware keeps track of the current A/C state, so changing temperature, mode, or fan speed sends a valid updated packet instead of a random standalone command. It is designed for M5Stack StickS3 and places A/C functionality directly inside the Bruce IR menu for fast access.

Main features:

* AC-B-Gone multi-brand OFF blast
* Brand-specific A/C protocol support
* Full-state A/C packet generation
* Power, temperature, mode, fan, and swing controls
* Integrated directly into Bruce IR tools
* Built for M5Stack StickS3
* All other functionalities of normal Bruce remain the same

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"Tanooki is a handheld games console originally for the S3, now ported to the Cardputer ADV. It currently features:
Maze Mouse! Rogue-lite mouse maze crawling action!
Bad Bug - Bloody arcade maze-muncher
Xenoflux - Plasma routing sim/evolution cycle manager
Bug Hunt - radar-based mutation containment simulator

For this port, buttonA is mapped to Enter/Ok, buttonB is mapped to backspace/delete.

Menu navigation operated with smooth tilt controls! ENJOY!
You'll also find switchable themes, a sound test, stats pages, and more. 
(the heartbeat lets you know it's working!)
***NEW***
Tanooki now supports an optional external ILI9341 2.4" SPI display connected through the Cardputer ADV's EXT 2.54-14P header. 
Pinout:
vcc = 5vin
gnd = gnd
cs = g5
reset = g13
dc = g15     
mosi = g14 
sck = g40
led = 5v out
When enabled, the game canvas is scaled from 240×135 to 320×180 using a fast nearest-neighbor integer scaler running over 40MHz SPI with DMA — filling the larger screen while maintaining crisp pixel art. The display mode is fully automatic: a persistent setting (default ON) controls whether the external screen is used, and a two-second audio-cued boot window lets you switch to the built-in display by pressing any key. The preference is saved to flash and survives reboots!
No hardware modifications are required beyond wiring a standard ILI9341 module to the EXT header with DuPont jumpers or a ribbon cable. The firmware handles SPI bus arbitration, display initialization ordering, and sprite memory management transparently — games don't need to know which display is active. The "Ext Display" toggle in Settings lets you switch modes at any time, with a reboot to apply.

(If you have no display, when loading for the first time you will hear some beeps, you have a few seconds to press any key and it will kill external screen init and pass on to built-in display. Built-in display will then be the default screen unless you enable the external screen again in settings.)"}

Wifi_Rig_CW for M5ATOM Lite  Ver1.43
Wifi リモート CW キーヤー / USB CW 中継
JI1ORE  2026/6/21
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


【概要】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
M5ATOM Lite を使った CW キーヤーシステムです。
2通りの使い方ができます。

  ① Wifi スタンドアロンモード
     M5ATOM Lite 2台（クライアント + サーバー）を使い、
     電鍵の ON/OFF を WiFi 経由でリアルタイムに中継します。
     有線では届かない距離（別室・屋外）の無線機をリモートキーイングできます。

  ② USB 中継モード（Android アプリ Wifi_RIG_CTRL v1.40 との組み合わせ）
     クライアント M5ATOM を Android スマートフォンに USB 接続し、
     Android アプリが Raspberry Pi 経由で無線機に CW 信号を中継します。
     CW モードではキー状態をそのまま中継、FM 等の音声モードでは
     CW 音声トーンをストリーミングして変調できます。
     外出先から VPN 越しの CW 運用も可能です。


【ファームウェアの種類】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  Clie_M5AtomLitev1.40.bin  クライアント用（電鍵を接続する側）
  Serv_M5AtomLitev1.40.bin  サーバー用（無線機のキー端子に接続する側）

  ※ USB 中継モードのみ使用する場合はクライアントのみでも動作しますが、
     Wifi スタンドアロンモードにはクライアントとサーバーの両方が必要です。


【必要なハードウェア】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
共通
  M5ATOM Lite           2台（クライアント用・サーバー用）
  ATOMICプロキット      2台
  MicroSD カード        2枚（WiFi プロファイル書き込み用）

クライアント側
  フォトカプラ H11L1M   1
  丸ピンICソケット(6P)  1
  ステレオジャック MJ-8435  1
  抵抗 100Ω            1
  抵抗 200Ω            1
  フェライトビーズ      3

サーバー側
  フォトカプラ PC817    1
  丸ピンICソケット(4P)  1
  ステレオジャック MJ-8435  1
  抵抗 100Ω            1

USB 中継モードを使う場合
  OTG 対応 USB ケーブル（USB-C ↔ Android スマートフォン）
  Android スマートフォン（Android 5.0 以上）
  Raspberry Pi Zero 2W（Wifi_RIG_CTRL セットアップ済み）

※ 配線図は配線フォルダの JPG ファイルを参照してください。


【モードの切り替え方】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
クライアントファームウェアには WiFi モードと USB モードが内蔵されています。
起動後 10 秒以内にボタン操作でモードを切り替えます。

  LED 表示:
    赤     = USB 中継モード
    色付き = WiFi スタンドアロンモード（プロファイルの色）

  操作:
    短押し      起動後 10 秒以内 → WiFi プロファイルの切り替え
    長押し 1秒  USB / WiFi モードの切り替え（設定は EEPROM に保存）

  → 電源を入れるたびに前回のモード設定が引き継がれます。


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
① WiFi スタンドアロンモードのセットアップ
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

M5Burner でクライアントとサーバーにそれぞれバイナリを書き込んだ後、
WiFi プロファイルファイルを MicroSD カード経由で設定します。

【WiFi プロファイルの設定】
ソースコードフォルダ内のプロファイルテンプレートをテキストエディタで編集し、
MicroSD カードのルートに置いて M5ATOM の TF-CARD スロットに挿入します。

  クライアント用: wifi_client_profile.txt
  サーバー用    : wifi_server_profile.txt

必須項目:
  SSID        自宅 WiFi の SSID
  PASS        WiFi パスワード
  HASIP       DHCP（IPアドレスを自動取得）または IP（固定IP）
  MODE        STA（ステーション=通常モード）
  SERVERHOSTNAME  サーバーのホスト名（クライアント側のみ）

設定例（DHCP モード）:
  [Profile]
  SSID=MyHomeNetwork
  PASS=mypassword
  HOSTNAME=RKCLIENT01
  HASIP=DHCP
  MODE=STA
  COLOR=Cyan
  SERVERHOSTNAME=RKSERVER01

【起動後の LED 表示（WiFi モード）】
  プロファイル色で点灯    WiFi 接続待機中 / サーバー探索中
  緑                      サーバーと接続済み・キー OFF
  プロファイル色（明滅）  サーバーと同期中
  キー ON 中              緑色で点灯


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
② USB 中継モードのセットアップ
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【前提】
  Android スマートフォンに Wifi_RIG_CTRL for Android v1.40 をインストール済み
  Raspberry Pi Zero 2W のセットアップ完了済み
  ※ Wifi_RIG_CTRL の詳細は GitHub の M5CoreHamCAT リポジトリを参照してください。

【接続手順】
  1. クライアント M5ATOM Lite に電鍵を接続（GROVE 端子）
  2. OTG ケーブルで M5ATOM と Android を接続
  3. M5ATOM 起動後、ボタン長押し 1秒 → LED が赤 = USB モード
  4. Android に「USB デバイスへのアクセスを許可しますか？」と表示 → OK
  5. Wifi_RIG_CTRL アプリのメイン画面に「CW relay」または「Audio relay」と表示される

【USB モード時の LED 表示（クライアント）】
  青（薄暗い）     USB モード待機中
  青（明るい）     キー ON 中

【アプリ側の動作モード】
  無線機が CW モードの場合
    → キーの ON/OFF を Raspberry Pi 経由でサーバー M5ATOM の GPIO に中継
       サーバー M5ATOM は無線機のキー端子に接続（フォトカプラ経由）

  無線機が FM/SSB 等の音声モードの場合
    → キーの ON/OFF に応じて 700Hz の CW 音声トーンを生成し
       Raspberry Pi 経由で無線機の音声入力にストリーミング

  ※ USB モードでは M5ATOM サーバーとの WiFi 接続は不要ですが、
     CW モード（GPIO 中継）を使う場合はサーバー M5ATOM が必要です。

【VPN 越しの運用（外出先から）】
  WireGuard VPN を使って外出先から Raspberry Pi に接続できます。
  遅延が発生するため、アプリの CW USB バー長押しで以下を設定:
    CW VPN buffer   : 測定値 + 200ms（推奨値はアプリが自動計算）
    FM-CW PTT delay : 150〜300ms（VPN 遅延に応じて調整）


【組み合わせシステム構成図】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  WiFi スタンドアロンモード:

    [電鍵] → [M5ATOM Lite クライアント] ─── WiFi ───> [M5ATOM Lite サーバー] → [無線機キー端子]


  USB 中継モード（CW モード）:

    [電鍵] → [M5ATOM Lite] ─USB─> [Android] ─── WiFi/VPN ───> [Raspberry Pi] ─── WiFi ───> [M5ATOM Lite サーバー] → [無線機キー端子]

  USB 中継モード（FM-CW / 音声モード）:

    [電鍵] → [M5ATOM Lite] ─USB─> [Android] ─── WiFi/VPN ───> [Raspberry Pi] ─USB音声──> [無線機マイク入力]


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
English Description
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Overview
--------
Wifi_Rig_CW is a CW keyer system using M5ATOM Lite that supports two operation modes:

  Mode 1: WiFi Standalone
    Two M5ATOM Lite units (Client + Server) relay key ON/OFF over WiFi in real time.
    Enables remote CW keying of a radio in another room or location.

  Mode 2: USB Relay (with Android app "Wifi_RIG_CTRL" v1.40)
    Connect the Client M5ATOM to an Android smartphone via USB.
    The Android app relays key signals to a Raspberry Pi, which then controls the radio.
    - CW mode    : Key state is relayed as GPIO via Server M5ATOM → radio key terminal
    - FM/SSB etc : A 700 Hz CW audio tone is streamed to the radio's audio input
    Remote operation over WireGuard VPN (from outside your home network) is also supported.


Firmware Files
--------------
  Clie_M5AtomLitev1.40.bin   Client firmware (connect your key to this unit)
  Serv_M5AtomLitev1.40.bin   Server firmware (connect to radio key terminal via optocoupler)


Switching Between USB and WiFi Modes
-------------------------------------
Within the first 10 seconds after power-on:
  Short press   Switch WiFi profile (LED color changes per profile)
  Long press (1 sec)   Toggle between USB mode (LED = RED) and WiFi mode (LED = profile color)

The selected mode is saved to EEPROM and remembered after power cycling.


Setup — WiFi Standalone Mode
-----------------------------
1. Flash Client firmware to one M5ATOM Lite, Server firmware to the other.
2. Edit the WiFi profile template (wifi_client_profile.txt / wifi_server_profile.txt)
   with your SSID, password, and hostnames.
3. Copy the profile file to the root of a MicroSD card.
4. Insert the MicroSD into the M5ATOM's TF-CARD slot and power on.
5. The M5ATOM reads the profile and connects to WiFi automatically.

LED status (WiFi mode):
  Profile color   Connecting / searching for server
  Green           Connected to server, key OFF
  Key pressed     Green (bright)


Setup — USB Relay Mode
-----------------------
Requirements:
  Android smartphone with Wifi_RIG_CTRL v1.40 installed
  Raspberry Pi Zero 2W (set up with create_api.sh from RaspberryPiSetup folder)

Steps:
  1. Connect the key to the Client M5ATOM (GROVE terminal)
  2. Connect M5ATOM to Android via OTG USB cable
  3. Long press the M5ATOM button for 1 second until LED turns RED (USB mode)
  4. Tap "OK" when Android asks for USB device permission
  5. The Wifi_RIG_CTRL app shows "CW relay" or "Audio relay" on the main screen

LED status (USB mode):
  Dim blue   USB mode, waiting / key OFF
  Bright blue   Key ON

For CW mode (GPIO relay), the Server M5ATOM is also required.
It must be connected to the radio's key terminal via optocoupler circuit.
For FM-CW / audio streaming mode, only the Client M5ATOM is needed.


System Diagrams
---------------
WiFi Standalone:
  [Key] → [M5ATOM Client] ─── WiFi ───> [M5ATOM Server] → [Radio key terminal]

USB Relay (CW mode):
  [Key] → [M5ATOM] ─USB─> [Android] ─── WiFi/VPN ───> [Raspberry Pi] ─── WiFi ───> [M5ATOM Server] → [Radio key terminal]

USB Relay (FM-CW / audio mode):
  [Key] → [M5ATOM] ─USB─> [Android] ─── WiFi/VPN ───> [Raspberry Pi] ─── USB audio ──> [Radio mic input]


Notes
-----
- Wiring diagrams are in the 配線 (wiring) folder.
- Source code is available in the ソースコード/Ver1.40/ folder.
- WiFi profile templates are in ソースコード/Ver1.40/Wifiプロファイル/.
- The Server M5ATOM requires its own WiFi profile (wifi_server_profile.txt)
  with the hostname that the Client or Raspberry Pi will look up.
- Raspberry Pi setup scripts and the Android APK are available at:
  https://github.com/ji1ore/M5CoreHamCAT/tree/main/v1.40/

{"format":"markdown","content":"**v1.3.3 — every settings screen is now drawn from one UI kit.**

The settings screens each drew their own rectangles and hit-tested them with their own hand-written numbers. Every screen is now drawn from `src/ui_kit.h` and hit-tested from the same constants, so a button that moves takes its hit box with it.

- card-style settings menu showing each setting's current value
- title bar + step indicator on every page, back button on its own row
- the boot sync path and the WiFi wizard share one confirmation screen
- WiFi list: 12 rows, signal bars, OPEN tag, Rescan / Cancel action row
- keyboard: kit buttons, masked password, Connect disabled until a key is typed
- timezone grid: 6 columns, 28 zones
- version string from a single source (banner, About page, menu)

Fixed before release (caught by a pre-flash layout check, never seen on a panel): the back button overlapped the first list row, the keyboard's SSID line and the first timezone row; the password field showed the WiFi password in clear text.

Note: flashing the merged image at 0x0 erases the saved WiFi credentials (it spans the NVS partition at 0x9000) — re-enter the password after flashing, or write only the app partition at 0x10000.

中文：设置界面全部改用统一的 UI 元件库（src/ui_kit.h），绘制与触摸判定共用同一批几何常量；菜单改卡片式并显示当前值；新增标题栏与步骤号；两个时间确认页合并为一个；WiFi 列表 12 行带信号条；键盘按键统一、密码改遮罩；时区 6 列网格。刷机前自检修掉三处"返回键压住内容"以及密码明文显示。注意：按 0x0 刷全镜像会清掉已保存的 WiFi 凭据。"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"v1.3.2 · 时间来源与蓝屏修复 / time source + crash fix

- **对时成功后蓝屏重启——根因已修复**：loop 任务卡在 USB-CDC 写出（`cdc0_write_char`），饿死 8 秒任务看门狗 → panic。`Serial.setTxTimeoutMs(0)` 让 CDC 写出永不阻塞（据 flash coredump 定位）。
  *The blue screen after a sync was a task-watchdog panic from a blocking USB-CDC write; every CDC write is now non-blocking.*
- **时间来源重写**：不再用 `getLocalTime()` 判断"已对时"（它只表示系统时钟看起来合理，而 `M5.begin()` 会用硬件 RTC 播种系统时钟），改用 SNTP 回调 + `sntp_get_sync_status()`；时钟从 epoch 算 HH:MM，RTC 仅作**校验过的**兜底种子。
  *Time source rewritten: SNTP callback instead of `getLocalTime()`; the clock derives HH:MM from the epoch and the RX8130CE is only a validated fallback seed.*
- **配网向导不再劫持开机**：已存凭据时，联网/对时失败也照常进时钟。
- **SNTP 等 DHCP 就绪后再查询**，窗口过半重发一次（避免"已关联但无 DNS"把第一查询丢掉）。
- **RTC 写入读回校验**；时区缓存进 RAM，时钟路径不再碰 NVS。

全镜像：bootloader @0x2000 + 分区表 + app（DIO），从 0x0 写入。

{"format":"markdown","content":"本固件为 Cardputer-ADV 定制个人固件，核心功能包含米家设备控制、Cursor 使用信息查看。

应用清单：
1. 米家（Mijia）｜快捷键：m｜设备状态查看、控制
2. 时钟（Time）｜快捷键：t｜开机时长、实时时间、秒表、倒计时
3. Cursor（Cursor Dashboard）｜快捷键：c｜Cursor 信息查看，TOKEN余量，24小时/7天/30天使用概况
4. 红外（Infrared）｜快捷键：x｜电视、空调红外遥控，适配主流品牌
5. 麦克风（Mic）｜快捷键：r｜麦克风测试、波形查看
6. IMU｜快捷键：g｜BMI270 六轴传感器参数查看
7. WiFi｜快捷键：w｜WiFi 设置，支持多组网络配置切换
8. AP/LAN（Config）｜快捷键：u｜Web配置服务，用于修改 config.json
9. 系统配置（Options）｜快捷键：o｜屏幕、音量等偏好设置
10. 图标查看（Icons）｜快捷键：a｜浏览固件内置图标
11. 字体（Font）｜快捷键：f｜预览系统内置字体
12. 休眠（Sleep）｜快捷键：s｜设备不关机，支持浅休眠、深休眠
13. 摩斯密码（Morse）｜快捷键：j｜按键触发摩斯密码音频输出
14. 键盘（HID Keyboard）｜快捷键：k｜蓝牙、USB HID键盘功能
15. LED（RGB LED）｜快捷键：l｜ESP32板载RGB LED测试
16. 蓝牙（BLE）｜快捷键：b｜扫描并查看周边蓝牙设备列表
17. 屏幕（Display）｜快捷键：d｜屏幕测试，支持多背景色、线条、方块测试

-----  English  ---------

This firmware is a custom personal build tailored for Cardputer-ADV, with core functionalities including local control of Mijia devices and statistics viewing for cursor usage.

Smart Home
m - Mijia: Local LAN-based Mijia device control
Additional entry - Get Device Token: Export token & ble.key via cloud tools and output in config.json format
x - Infrared: IR remote control for TV, air conditioner (GPIO44 pin)

Network & Config
u - Config: Edit firmware config.json via AP hotspot or LAN web page
w - WiFi: Scan, connect and switch up to 5 saved WiFi networks
b - BLE: Scan nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices

Time & Power
t - Time: Clock toolkit — uptime, system clock, countdown, stopwatch
p - Battery: Real-time battery level + about 1-hour historical curve chart
s - Sleep: Enter light sleep or deep sleep mode

Productivity
c - Cursor: Cursor usage statistics with daily/weekly/monthly trend charts
k - HID Keyboard: Emulate HID keyboard over USB and BLE
j - Morse: Generate audible Morse code tones

System & Info
o - Options: Global system settings (brightness, sound, time, IR parameters etc.)
i - Info: Overview of memory, chip model, firmware, network and runtime status
v - Version: Firmware version and about page

Hardware Debug & Demos
g - IMU: Attitude visualization for BMI270 inertial measurement unit
l - RGB LED: Onboard RGB LED functional test
r - Mic: Real-time audio waveform, VU meter and gain adjustment
d - Display: Screen test patterns including color blocks, grids and lines
a - Icons: Browse all built-in firmware icons
f - Font: Preview embedded system fonts
n / e - I2C: Scan internal on-board I2C bus and external expanded I2C bus respectively"}

o_OS is a modular embedded runtime and launcher for the M5Stack Cardputer (ESP32-S3 class target), designed to provide a stable system foundation for navigation-driven system apps, hardware services, diagnostics, and future extensible app workflows.

At runtime, mini_OS acts as a persistent launcher environment in the TEST partition, with optional handoff to an installed app image in OTA storage.

## What this project is

- A structured OS-like runtime for Cardputer-class hardware
- A layered architecture (Board Profile -> HAL -> Drivers -> OS Core -> Apps)
- A navigation-first UI framework with shared screen/layout contracts
- A validation-heavy codebase with lint, unit, and runtime smoke gates
- An Arduino-first project (editor workflow in VS Code, deploy workflow in
  Arduino tooling)

## Current status

- v1.0 delivered: bootable runtime core, launcher persistence semantics,
  driver bring-up path, EventBus, app registry, and built-in system apps.
- v1.01 in progress: housekeeping, render pipeline hardening, validation gate
  expansion, and migration guardrails for a clean v1.1 UI framework path.

# RHesus LIFE 1.0

Conway's Game of Life for M5Cardputer with real-time audio synthesis, neon color palettes, zoom camera, and three special modes that modify the cellular automaton rules on the fly.

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| BtnA / G0 | Nuke — reset world, next color |
| = / - | Zoom in / out (1x to 8x) |
| , / / | Camera left / right |
| ; / . | Camera up / down |
| DEL | Next color palette |
| 1-9 | Volume |
| 0 | Cycle sound engine (8 types) |
| S | Mute / unmute |
| P | Toggle PANIC mode |
| G | Invoke GOD mode |
| D | Invoke DEMON mode |
| I | Hold for live info overlay |
| H | Hold for help overlay |
| Z | Zone audio on / off |
| W | Screen brightness |

## Modes

PANIC changes the birth/survival rules to a chaotic ruleset, producing explosive growth and glitch effects on screen.

GOD injects up to 80 long-lived cells into the current viewport. They render brighter and survive under extended conditions.

DEMON injects up to 60 denser cells with even wider survival rules. Both GOD and DEMON cells carry individual life counters and can coexist.

{"format":"markdown","content":"Turns your Cardputer into a smart surface analyzer. It doesn't know materials out of the box - you train it!

Stand the device on its edge (SD slot UP) and let it simply tip over onto the surface. 

Features:
- Train your own database: Record, name, and distinguish your surfaces.
- Surface matching: Drop it to see which saved material matches best.
- Basic physical estimation (e.g., "Hard | Elastic") even for unsaved surfaces.
- Safe to use: Tested with over 1000 edge-drops on hard tiles without any damage.

Full guide on GitHub!"}

A full-featured wireless security research tool ported from CYDWiFiScanner to the M5Stack Core2. Features a green-on-black hacker terminal UI, 6 scanning modes, BLE skimmer detection, threat logging to SD card, and haptic feedback.

Mode	Description

BLE	BLE skimmer hunter — flags suspicious Bluetooth devices by name patterns and OUI prefix
SHADY	Suspicious network analyzer — scores nearby networks for evil twin, PineAP, karma attacks, etc.

Button	Action
Btn A (left)	Previous mode
Btn B (middle)	Clear / reset current mode data
Btn C (right)	Next mode
Other Features
🟢 Green-on-black hacker terminal theme
📳 Haptic vibration feedback on touch events and threat alerts
💾 SD card logging — threats written to /cydscan.txt
📡 BLE scanner runs as a background FreeRTOS task (non-blocking)
🔋 Built on M5Core2 library — AXP192 power management, capacitive touch, built-in SD

SD Card Logging
Insert a FAT32-formatted microSD card. The scanner automatically logs:

Detected deauth attacks
BLE skimmer candidates
Shady/suspicious networks

{"format":"markdown","content":"PaperOS v1.3 - A standalone operating system engineered specifically for the M5Stack Cardputer.

PaperOS turns your Cardputer into a compact workstation and retro-gaming suite, featuring a custom windowless launcher, a full-featured Lua 5.4 environment, an on-device offline LLM, and an ecosystem of native applications.

Key Features:
System & Tools: File Manager with enhanced image viewing (pan/zoom/rotate), Paint, 3D Mesh Editor (.obj), Notes, Calculator, Clock, and Piano.
Connectivity & Web: Tabbed HTML/CSS web browser with file downloading alongside a built-in App Store to fetch Lua apps directly from GitHub over Wi-Fi.
Media & Audio: Folder-agnostic Music Player with WAV and MP3 playback across the entire SD card.
Emulation & AI: Hardware-accelerated NES/GB/GBC and Arduboy game emulation, combined with an on-device offline LLM (myAI).
Developer Environment: Integrated Lua 5.4 console exposing direct hardware controls (GPIO, I2C, Canvas Drawing, Sound, and Timers).

What's New in v1.3:
Rewritten Web Browser: Upgraded to a lightweight HTML/CSS layout engine. Features parsing for style blocks (colors, bold formatting, alignment), headings, lists, tables, dynamic redirects, 3 independent tabs with history, in-page search, and image downloading to SD.
Dynamic Lua Wi-Fi Power Management: Wi-Fi now automatically powers down during Lua execution—reclaiming 40–70 KB of RAM—and seamlessly reconnects only when a script invokes network calls (net.get, net.post, net.connect, net.scan).
Lua Runtime Optimization: Unused standard modules (package, os/io, utf8, debug) have been stripped to permanently reduce memory overhead, and os.stack() has been added for real-time task-stack monitoring.

Requirements:
A FAT32-formatted SD card is required on first boot. Additional assets (PaperEMU.extension for emulation and model.bin for AI chat) as well as the updated API documentation (paperos_lua_reference_v1_3.txt) are available in the project repository."}

为 M5StickS3（ESP32-S3）开发的潮汐/黄历/水位时钟固件，专为水上运动比如皮划艇下水前的综合判断设计。
功能

三屏切换（短按 BtnA）：

屏 1	农历日期、桐洲岛站名、涨潮/落潮状态（大字）、距下次高潮/低潮倒计时
屏 2	当日 4 个潮汐时刻表（2 高潮 + 2 低潮，含水位值）

This app turns the M5 Cardputer (ESP32-S3) into a small heart-rate monitor + logger.

It scans for nearby BLE heart-rate devices and connects to a strap/sensor that supports the standard Heart Rate Service.

After connecting, it shows your current HR (BPM) on the screen, draws a live trend chart, and displays MIN / AVG / MAX values.

It can also connect to Wi-Fi and shows the device IP so you can open the built-in web view from a browser on the same network.

It logs HR data to the SD card as CSV (easy to open in Excel) and saves settings (device + Wi-Fi + display + alarm + language) in a config file.

If the settings were saved before, it auto-reconnects on startup using the config stored on the SD card. An SD card is required for the app to work properly.

The UI is available in two languages: English (default) and Polish.

MARAUDER_CSI_StickC_Plus2 is an enhanced firmware for the M5StickC Plus2 that extends the capabilities of the original MARAUDER project by introducing Wi-Fi CSI (Channel State Information) based motion detection.

What is CSI?
Channel State Information (CSI) is a Wi-Fi physical-layer technology that provides detailed information about how wireless signals change while propagating through the environment. By analyzing variations in CSI data, it is possible to detect human presence and movements without requiring cameras, wearable devices, or additional sensors.

This firmware brings CSI-based sensing capabilities to the M5StickC Plus2 platform, transforming it into a compact Wi-Fi sensing device capable of exploring advanced wireless motion detection techniques.

Based on the MARAUDER project
MURADER_CSI_StickC_Plus2 builds upon the original MARAUDER project, extending its functionality with a new CSI analysis and motion detection feature specifically adapted for the M5StickC Plus2 hardware.

The project combines the flexibility of the M5Stack ecosystem with Wi-Fi sensing research concepts, enabling experimentation with next-generation wireless interaction and environment monitoring technologies.

Features

Wi-Fi CSI data acquisition and analysis
Passive motion detection using wireless signal variations
No camera or additional hardware required
Optimized for M5StickC Plus2
Based on the open-source MARAUDER project

This firmware is intended for educational purposes, research, prototyping, and exploration of Wi-Fi sensing technologies."}

A cosmos in your palm — stars dance, trails fade, the universe breathes. But listen. In the deep silence of the night, when the room is dark and your eyes have grown accustomed to the drifting constellations, a faint signal emerges from the tiny speaker. {"format":"markdown","content":"掌上的一方雨景：两千滴雨，在你手边下着。

举起来，雨幕跟着手腕转——倾斜就是视角，不用按键。风一吹雨就斜着落，落地那一下在屏幕上溅开；远处天光一闪，几秒之后才是雷声滚过来。

最好的部分是声音。雨声和雷声不是录音，是设备现场算出来的：雨下大时声音跟着变亮、变密，雨小了只剩一层细细的沙沙——就像窗外真的在下。

· 两千滴雨的 3D 环绕雨场，倾斜机身自由看
· 雨声与雷声全程现场合成，不占一点存储
· 闪电之后 0.15~0.45 秒雷才炸响，远处的闷雷要等 1.5~3 秒——延迟就是距离
· 雨势、风、闪电每次开机都是新的一段，阵雨说来就来
· B 键双击静音；也可以就让它这么下着，当白噪音

M5Cardputer ADV · 240×135

---

Hold a rainstorm in your hand — two thousand raindrops falling in 3D.

Tilt it and the rain follows your wrist: no buttons for looking around. Wind slants the drops, each one splashes where it lands, and a far-off flash lights the sky seconds before the thunder arrives.

The best part is the sound. The rain and the thunder are synthesized live on the device — nothing is recorded. When the rain comes down harder the hiss brightens and the drops thicken; when it eases off, only a fine patter is left. It sounds like weather outside your window.

· A 3D volume of 2,000 raindrops, steered by tilting the device
· Rain and thunder synthesized live — no audio files at all
· Thunder lands 0.15–0.45 s after a nearby flash, or 1.5–3 s later when it is far away (that delay is the distance)
· Rain intensity, wind and lightning run a different sequence every boot; squalls arrive out of nowhere
· Double-press B to mute — or just leave it raining as white noise

M5Cardputer ADV · 240×135"}
