{"format":"markdown","content":"# 0.6.0-beta — Desk Scout

This beta gives the companion more things to say, adds configurable desktop listening, and improves how repeat observations are saved during a drive. All appearances remain unlocked. Muting, voice-off defaults, existing calibration-preserving web updates, and wardriving-only food stay in place.

## Companion and wardrobe

- Eight rotating affection captions and matching optional speech clips, plus contextual captions for driving, GPS waits, missing SD, busy airwaves, and desk time.
- Spoken family labels and distinct quips for supported device clues. Strong Axon signatures can use the optional spicy phrases; a vendor clue remains explicitly uncertain. Head petting stays quiet, speech defaults off, and deliberate touch speech has a one-minute limit.
- Heart/radar eyes, headphones, wizard hats, a monocle, a satchel, and a signal medal. Nine presets and 9,600 combinations before colors/names across the five shapes. Extended profiles use DCAV3; existing DCAV1/DCAV2 files still work.

## Desktop watch and reaction lights

**Detection → Desk Watch + Lights + SD OUI** selects Balanced, Wi-Fi focus or BLE focus. Every mode keeps both radios active in alternating windows; recording uses a fixed drive schedule regardless of desktop preference. Uploading temporarily pauses scanning, as before.

Side LEDs use alternating red/blue for Axon clues, amber for camera/ALPR clues, cyan for glasses, violet for trackers, green for Remote ID, gold for Biscuit, pink for gadgets, and red for traffic anomalies. Choose Animated, Steady or Off; the master mood-light switch still applies. These patterns convey a classification, not direction or certainty. Physical strip order and brightness need a device check.

The optional [201-rule SD reference](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/OUI-REFERENCE.html) supports up to 2,048 curated public-address prefixes, with labels, conservative confidence and visible rejection counts. It supplements the pinned protocol signatures without SD reads in radio callbacks. Low-confidence clues remain readable in Recent without generating notifications below the selected threshold.

## Recording quality

- Native **WiGLE 1.4 CSV**, 11 columns, UTC times, quoted names/auth, Wi-Fi channel and BLE channel zero. The existing upload tool converts to WiGLE 1.6 when needed.
- First eligible observation is saved immediately. A cached address can be saved again after five seconds if it moves at least 30 m or becomes 10 dB stronger; otherwise after 60 seconds. The 256-contact cache is bounded, so eviction in dense areas can lead to extra samples. This reduces stationary duplicates while retaining useful route samples.
- Recording still requires a fresh usable GPS fix, at least four satellites, HDOP ≤5, valid coordinates/altitude and capture age ≤250 ms. UTC now also checks calendar validity. AccuracyMeters is an estimate of HDOP ×5 m, not a calibrated GPS error bound.
- Wi-Fi uses the advertised channel when valid; malformed MAC/channel/RSSI rows are rejected. BLE random addresses remain valid observations, but are not attributed by OUI. Valid UTF-8 names are preserved; control bytes and invalid encoding are replaced with `?`.
- SD writes are checked, flushed every two seconds and checked again at Stop + Save. Power loss can still lose buffered rows. Food/XP is credited only after a valid Wi-Fi row is written, once per approximate per-drive discovery.

## Validation and limits

See [DEVELOPMENT.md](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/DEVELOPMENT.html) for the exact software checks. This release has not been installed or tested on the physical development K151 yet. New LED patterns, voice intelligibility, field reception, long moving drives and WiGLE/WDGWars server acceptance remain unverified. Historical bench results in that guide refer to earlier firmware. No firmware can guarantee detection of silent, unsupported, out-of-band or spoofed devices.

The web installer is the recommended update path. The separately prepared M5Burner merged image resets NVS/calibration; read [M5BURNER.md](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/M5BURNER.html) first. Source and releases are published to Gitea; the web tools are independently hosted on Cloudflare.


[Web flasher and Avatar Studio](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/) · [Source and attributions](https://git.churchofmalware.org/Valleytech/Dash-Chan/src/tag/v0.6.0-beta/docs/SOURCES.md)

Use the split-image ZIP or web flasher to preserve NVS/calibration. The separate FACTORY-RESET.bin resets both; read M5BURNER-INSTALL.md before using it. No device backup or personal data is included."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"## 0.4.0-beta — GPS setup, Wisp and Ember

- Adds the Wisp black ghost and Ember fire buddy to the firmware and Avatar Studio.

**Factory-reset warning:** this merged image erases NVS/settings/servo calibration. firmwares.firmwareDescription: {"format":"markdown","content":"An advanced, open-source NFC and RFID inspection firmware designed for the M5CoreS3 paired with an external ST25R3916 NFC Unit. No card emulation. This tool allows technicians, developers, and security researchers to inspect contactless cards, analyze protocols, read memory dumps, and manage logs directly from a portable device or via a web interface.   Key FeaturesReal-Time NFC/RFID Inspection: Detects, identifies, and extracts card details (UID, ATQA, SAK, and ISO 14443-4 compliance status).   MIFARE Classic Support: Automatically authenticates sectors using a built-in dictionary of known keys and reads block data.   NTAG & Ultralight Parsing: Reads memory pages and automatically parses NDEF messages (such as URI/URL records and plain text payloads).   MicroSD Card Logging: Automatically saves detailed card data and hex dumps to text files (.TXT) named after the card's UID for easy retrieval.   Embedded Web Server & File Management:Features Wi-Fi connection handling and an Access Point (AP) configuration mode (192.168.4.1) for setup.   Provides a web dashboard accessible via browser to view session statistics, list saved card dumps, download files directly, or delete records from the SD card.   Graphical User Interface (GUI):Live RF/oscillator signal animation on the idle screen.   Real-time battery status monitoring with charging indicators.   NTP network time synchronization displaying UTC timestamps.   Interactive touch controls for clearing session data and safe shutdown confirmation."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"v1.04版固件
把 M5StickS3 变成 WorkBuddy 的物理遥控器。蓝牙直连（sticks3-ctl），不用装驱动，不占 USB 口。


【持握方式】
为了拿稳机身需要反过来拿（按键朝下），屏幕已旋转 180° 适配这个姿势。

【按键】

· 正面键 按住 —— 语音录制（按住 录音，松手结束）

· 正面键 单击 —— 发送消息（Enter）



· 正面键 双击 —— 打开/隐藏左侧栏（Cmd+B）

· 正面键 三击 —— 控制右侧栏（Shift+Cmd+B）


· 侧键 单击 —— 停止生成（Esc）

· 侧键 长按 —— 清除所有输入文字



· 左甩 —— 下一个任务（Cmd+]）

· 右甩 —— 上一个任务（Cmd+[）


甩动不需要按键，直接甩；录音期间甩动会被忽略，说话时手抖不会切栏。

【屏幕】
显示当前任务名和运行状态（生成中 / 空闲 / 已完成），任务切换后自动跟着变。
30 秒无操作自动熄屏，抬手或按键点亮；熄屏前 5 秒会显示 WorkBuddy 图标和逐个冒出的 z。
右上角显示 MAC，表示当前按 macOS 的修饰键（Cmd）发送。

【声音】
按键有区分度的短提示音，任务跑完响一声，不用一直盯屏幕。

【使用前提】
1. 按键绑定对齐的是 WorkBuddy 默认快捷键。如果你改过快捷键，需要改固件 config.h 重新编译。
2. 屏幕上的任务名需要电脑端（macOS）运行配套的状态桥，读取本地任务状态后通过蓝牙推给设备。不运行桥时键盘功能完全正常，屏幕只显示「等待同步」。
3. 首次使用在系统设置 → 蓝牙里配对 StickS3-Ctl。

【烧写】
合并镜像（含 bootloader + 分区表 + 应用），Flash 地址 0x0。

基于 Arduino + M5Unified + NimBLE，8 字节标准 6KRO 键盘报告，兼容 macOS 的 boot 协议解析。"}

{"format":"html","content":"

⚠️ 重要：目标板请插正面 Type-A 或 Type-C 口（两口自动切换，插哪边都行）；底部 Type-C 是连电脑的 console/烧录口，与 S3 的 USB PHY 共享——开启 USB Host 后底部口 console 会断开（预期行为），网页里关闭 Host 即恢复。正面口 5V 供电由固件控制，仅 Host 模式开启时输出。


AirSerial 把 PowerHub 变成 WiFi 无线串口桥，远程烧录/调试 ESP32/ESP8266：


● 正面双 Host 口（Type-A + Type-C）自动切换：目标板插哪边都能用，换插约 5 秒自动识别重连

● esptool 标准握手：rfc2217://<设备IP>:3334，自动复位进下载模式免按键

● Web Portal：配网、USB Host 开关、状态监控、WebSocket 终端 + !airsn 本地命令

● 透明 TCP（3333）+ RFC2217（3334）双端口，pyserial 直接当本地串口用

● WS2812 状态灯：WiFi 状态、电量/充电（橙色呼吸）、设备心跳、USB 路由指示、倒灌红闪报警

● 倒灌保护：检测到外部 5V 倒灌自动切断正面口供电

● 意外重启原因上报（WDT/panic 分类）


首次使用：底部 Type-C 连电脑烧录，开 http://192.168.4.1/ 配网，设备切到 STA 上线后，在网页打开 USB Host 开关，目标板插正面口即用。


文档与源码：https://github.com/zyntraio/AirSerial

"}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"⚡ GeminiPuter v2.0 (Cardputer & Cardputer ADV)

GitHub Release License: MIT PlatformIO Gemini Hardware

An advanced, interactive firmware transforming the M5Stack Cardputer and Cardputer ADV into a full-featured pocket AI assistant powered by Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite with native hardware function calling, bilingual Russian/English keyboard layout, live web remote console, and dynamic RGB lighting effects.

Note

Fork Attribution: This project is an advanced fork of the original GeminiPuter created by nishad2m8. We express our sincere gratitude to the original author for the foundational inspiration!
🚀 Key Improvements & Comparison
Feature 	Original (nishad2m8/GeminiPuter) 	Our Fork (AdvaScript/GeminiPuter v2.0)
Hardware Compatibility 	Standard M5Cardputer only 	M5Stack Cardputer + Cardputer ADV
Gemini AI Model 	Hardcoded gemini-1.5-flash (Deprecated / 404 error) 	gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-2.5-flash, customizable via Web UI
Inference Speed 	Default thinking latency 	Zero-latency thinking mode (thinkingBudget: 0) for near-instant responses
Hardware Function Calling 	❌ None (pure text assistant) 	✅ Full Tool Calling: Screen brightness, WS2812 RGB LED effects, real battery state
RGB LED Integration 	❌ None 	✅ 11 Built-in animations + custom JSON animation patterns + visual web mirror
Language & Keyboard 	English only (QWERTY) 	🇷🇺 Bilingual (English + Russian Cyrillic phonetic layout) with HUD toast notification
Web Console & Telemetry 	Basic Wi-Fi captive setup portal 	🌐 Cyberpunk Live Web HUD: Real-time mirrored transcript, remote keyboard, live telemetry
UI Aesthetics 	Default green text 	🎨 Sleek Dark Theme: Electric blue Gemini responses (#38B6FF), right-aligned user bubbles
Watchdog & Stability 	Watchdog resets on long answers 	🛡️ FreeRTOS thread isolation, mutex guards, feed loops preventing WDT panics
Easter Eggs 	❌ None 	🤢 Built-in IMU Shake / /shake Easter egg
✨ Features Breakdown
🧠 Gemini 3.1 & Hardware Control (Function Calling)

Gemini can directly control your Cardputer hardware using Google Function Declarations:

    Screen Brightness: "Set screen brightness to 20%" or "Dim the display".
    RGB LED Lamp: "Turn the lamp red", "Switch to rainbow effect", "Blink cyan at 50% brightness", "Turn off the LED".
    Custom Patterns: Ask Gemini to generate custom blinking patterns or moods.
    Battery Status: "How much battery is left?" (queries the internal AXP/ADC power sensor).

⌨️ Bilingual Russian & English Keyboard

    Switch layouts instantly by pressing Fn + Backspace or Fn + Enter.
    An on-screen translucent toast indicator [ РУС ] / [ ENG ] displays the active mode.
    Rendered with an embedded high-definition Cyrillic font (rubik_14_cy).

🌐 Cyberpunk Web Interface & Remote Keyboard

Connect to http://<cardputer-ip>/ from any computer, tablet, or smartphone on the same network:

    Live Mirrored Console: Watch conversation turns scroll in real time with custom message bubbles.
    Remote Keyboard: Type questions using your desktop keyboard with command history (Up/Down arrows).
    Quick Action Chips: One-click shortcuts for lighting, brightness, battery, and testing.
    Hardware Telemetry HUD: Live battery indicator, Wi-Fi RSSI signal meter, uptime, free heap memory, and simulated RGB lamp status.
    Web Settings: Change API keys, Wi-Fi credentials, or switch Gemini models on the fly without reflashing.

🎮 Cardputer Controls
Key Combination 	Action
Tab 	Toggle focus between Chat Input and AI Response transcript
Fn + ; / Fn + . 	Scroll transcript Up / Down
Enter 	Send message to Gemini
Fn + Backspace or Fn + Enter 	Toggle Russian / English keyboard layout
Ctrl + L 	Clear transcript
/shake or /puke 	Trigger the accelerometer Easter egg
📥 Installation & Flashing
Option 1: Flashing the Pre-compiled Binary (Recommended)

Download the latest GeminiPuter.bin from GitHub Releases.

Flash using esptool.py:

esptool.py --chip esp32s3 write_flash 0x0 GeminiPuter.bin

Or use M5Burner / ESP Web Flasher.
Option 2: Build from Source with PlatformIO

    Clone this repository:

    git clone https://github.com/AdvaScript/GeminiPuter.git
    cd GeminiPuter/PIO

    Build and upload firmware:

    pio run -t upload

⚙️ Initial Configuration

    On first boot, Cardputer creates or connects to your Wi-Fi network.
    Follow the on-screen instructions or connect to http://<device-ip>/ in your web browser.
    Obtain a free API key from Google AI Studio.
    Enter your API key into the web configuration panel or config.json on the SD card.
    Save and reboot — your GeminiPuter is ready!

🔗 Fork Status & Upstream Link

    Original Project: nishad2m8/GeminiPuter
    Author of Original: Nishad
    Fork Maintainer: AdvaScript

Tip

GitHub Fork Tree Attachment: Because this repository was initially created as a standalone project, it is not attached automatically to the upstream fork tree by GitHub. If you manage this repo and wish it to be visible under upstream's "Forks" tab (https://github.com/nishad2m8/GeminiPuter/network/members), you can request GitHub Support to link this repository as a fork of nishad2m8/GeminiPuter.
📄 License

This project is distributed under the MIT License. See LICENSE for details."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"Critical Boot Fix for M5Burner & Actual Hardware

    Merged Flash Binary (Address 0x0000): The firmware is now packaged as a fully merged flash image containing:
        0x0000: ESP32-S3 Second-Stage Bootloader
        0x8000: Partition Table (NVS, otadata, app0, app1, spiffs, coredump)
        0xe000: Boot App0 OTA sector
        0x10000: Application Firmware
        Previously, flashing only the unmerged app partition directly at 0x0000 via M5Burner caused the ROM bootloader to fail to find the bootloader and partition tables, resulting in a black screen and boot failure.
    Universal Flash Mode (DIO): Switched from QIO to DIO (Dual I/O) mode to ensure 100% hardware compatibility across all flash chip revisions on M5Stack Cardputer and Cardputer ADV.
    Explicit Backlight Initialization: Added M5.Display.setBrightness(currentScreenBrightness) immediately upon startup in setup() to guarantee screen backlight illuminates without delay on fresh boots.
    Automated Merger Tool: Added PIO/merge_firmware.py for reproducible single-binary generation."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"A first-person block survival game for the Cardputer and Cardputer ADV. Dig up the world, build a shelter, and see how many nights you last.

- **Mine.** Every block comes out, and you can place it somewhere else. Dig into a hillside and the rest of it stays up.
- **Build.** A wall two blocks high is taller than you, which makes it the usual first-night shelter.
- **Craft.** Recipes are shapes on a grid, or you pick one from the recipe book. Start with nothing, chop a tree, and work up through stone, iron and diamond.
- **Survive.** Zombies, skeletons and creepers come out at dusk. Zombies wind up before they swing. Creepers blow holes in walls. Torches keep the ground around them clear.

Your score is the number of nights you survive. The device saves it.

Controls: arrows move and turn, W mines and attacks, A builds, E and S look up and down, Enter centres the view, Space jumps, 1 to 9 pick a hotbar slot, Q drops, Tab crafts, Esc goes back. The CONTROLS card on the title screen and in the pause menu lists them."}

firmwares.firmwareName: ESP32 Cleaner - CCleaner for your SD card
firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"CCleaner for your SD card, running on the Cardputer. It finds the hidden files that macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and NAS boxes leave on a card, groups them by pack, and deletes only what you tick.

- Scan the whole card, then review the results by pack or item by item.
- Quick clean scans and deletes in one step. Dry run reports real numbers and deletes nothing.
- The macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and NAS packs are on by default. They match files such as .DS_Store, ._ files, Thumbs.db, $RECYCLE.BIN, LOST.DIR and @eaDir.
- Dev caches, logs and temp files, empty folders and empty files are off by default. When a clean includes a risky pack, the confirm screen names it and asks you to press Enter twice.
- Add your own glob rules on the device or in /sdcleaner.rules on the card.
- The scan writes results to a file on the card and keeps one offset and one bit per item in RAM, so it handles tens of thousands of matches.

One image runs on the Cardputer and the Cardputer ADV."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"## 这是什么
把 M5Stack StopWatch 变成一块挂在胸前的电子名片。展会、活动、技术交流时戴上：别人看一眼就知道你是谁，想加你直接扫码。

## 屏幕上能看到什么
- **名片页**：头像、姓名、职位和公司、几个标签；顶部显示时间、电量和大约还能用多久。
- **扫码页**：大号二维码，亮度自动调到最高，方便别人扫。
- **待机页**：一段时间不操作会自动变暗，只显示时间和名字，更省电。

## 按键怎么用
| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 黄键 短按 | 打开二维码（亮度拉满），到时间自动回到名片，或再按一次返回 |
| 蓝键 短按 | 有多个二维码时切换到下一个；只有一个时返回名片 |
| 蓝键 长按 2 秒 | 进入 / 退出「用手机修改」模式 |
| 待机时按任意键 | 回到名片；按黄键直接打开二维码 |
| 电源键 按一下 / 连按两下 | 开机 / 关机 |

## 用手机改成你自己的名片
1. 第一次开机（或长按蓝键 2 秒），屏幕会显示一个 Wi‑Fi 二维码和密码。
2. 用手机自带的相机扫码，连上胸牌的热点（微信扫一扫不行）。手机会自动打开编辑页面；没弹出来的话，用浏览器打开 192.168.4.1。
3. 填写名字、职位、公司、标签，换头像，最多添加 3 个二维码（可以直接选微信二维码截图，自动识别），再选主题和亮度。
4. 点「发布到胸牌」，看到「已保存」就完成了。热点会自动关闭。整个过程不需要联网，资料只保存在胸牌里。

## 电量小贴士
- 电池图标旁边的「x.xh」是估计还能用几个小时，充电时不显示。
- 满电时停在名片页大约能用 8–9 小时；经常亮二维码、开着热点会更耗电。
- 第一次用建议先充满，再一直用到快没电，胸牌会记住这块电池的实际情况，之后剩余时间会更准。
- 连按两下电源键关机，关机后时间还会继续走。

源码：https://github.com/Ocean-lhy/M5Stopwatch-DIY-Badge"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"# Cardputer Reader v1.0.0

M5Stack Cardputer ADV（ESP32-S3）上的离线 TXT 电子书阅读器。

## 核心功能

- 离线阅读 TXT，自动分页，章节识别（内置规则 + 自定义正则）
- 书架管理：最近阅读排序、重命名、删除、密码保护的隐藏书架
- 阅读辅助：目录跳转、书签、百分比进度、5 种主题、亮度调节、自动休眠
- 中文拼音输入法：6763 单字 + 5000 词组，多音字白名单，100 候选，中英文标点一键切换
- WiFi 传书：浏览器上传 TXT，分块支持大文件；书签导入导出
- 中英双语界面

## 硬件与安装

- 适配 M5Stack Cardputer ADV（ESP32-S3，无 PSRAM）
- SD 卡走 SPI：SCK 40 / MISO 39 / MOSI 14 / CS 12，25MHz
- 分区方案需选 **Huge APP（3MB）**
- 固件大小约 1.5MB，可直接通过 M5Burner 或 esptool 烧录

## 已知限制

- 词组多音字使用首读音，个别词组（如「重庆」）需拆单字输入
- 破折号使用 `－－` 替代标准 U+2014
- 重命名拒绝 `.` 开头的文件名

---

# Cardputer Reader v1.0.0

An offline TXT ebook reader for M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3).

## Features

- Offline TXT reading with auto-pagination and chapter detection (built-in rules + custom regex)
- Bookshelf: recent-read sorting, rename, delete, password-protected hidden shelf
- Reading aids: TOC jump, bookmarks, percentage jump, 5 themes, brightness, auto-sleep
- Chinese Pinyin IME: 6763 single characters + 5000 phrases, polyphone whitelist, 100 candidates, one-key CJK/ASCII punctuation toggle
- WiFi upload: browser-based TXT upload with chunked transfer; bookmark import/export
- Bilingual UI (Chinese / English)

## Hardware & Installation

- Target: M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3, no PSRAM)
- SD card via SPI: SCK 40 / MISO 39 / MOSI 14 / CS 12, 25MHz
- Partition scheme: **Huge APP (3MB)**
- Firmware size: ~1.5MB, flashable via M5Burner or esptool

## Known Limitations

- Polyphonic phrases use the first reading; some phrases (e.g. 重庆) need to be typed character by character
- Dash uses `－－` instead of standard U+2014
- Filenames starting with `.` are rejected on rename"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"# 版本说明（v1.0.0）

**v1.0.0 — 首个发行版本**

## 功能

### 阅读

- 离线 TXT 阅读，自动分页
- 章节识别：内置规则（`前言`、`序言`、`楔子`、`番外`、`序章`、`第X章`）或自定义正则
- 目录跳转、书签管理、百分比进度跳转
- 阅读进度自动保存（每 100 页及退出书籍时）
- 5 种主题：深色 / 浅色 / 护眼 / 夜间 / 高对比
- 亮度调节、自动休眠（10s / 30s / 60s / 永不）
- 中英双语界面，运行时切换

### 书架

- 普通书架 + 隐藏书架（4–6 位数字密码保护）
- 最近阅读排序，书名过长自动横向滚动
- 重命名（支持中文）、移入/移出隐藏书架、删除
- 密码错误 3 次锁定 5 秒，隐藏书架内可修改密码

### 中文输入法

- 拼音全拼，单字 6763 个（GB2312），一级词组 5000 条
- 常用多音字白名单（300+ 字，`行`/`重`/`长`/`乐` 等在两读音下均可打出）
- 候选 100 个，7 个/页，`ctrl` / `tab` 翻页
- 中英文标点一键切换（`. → 。`、`^ → ……`、`_ → －－` 等）
- 中文引号自动配对（`"` 交替出 `“` / `”`）
- 生效场景：重命名、自定义章节正则

### 自定义章节正则

- 支持中文、全角标点，最长 191 字节
- 保存后自动触发目录重建

### WiFi 传书

- 设备开启热点，浏览器上传 TXT
- 分块上传，支持大文件（>256KB）

{"format":"markdown","content":"# v0.0.9 — 漫画体验重做 + WiFi 配网与联网对时

本版重点：把漫画阅读里“卡、崩、读不出来、裁边”四个遗留问题一次解决，
并给设备加上了手机网页配网 + 开机自动联网对时。

## 新功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **WiFi 配网** | 传书网页新增 WiFi 标签：扫描周边网络、输密码连接、保存凭据；热点 APSTA 共存，配网时传书页不掉线 |
| **开机自动对时** | 有保存的 WiFi 就在开机时后台连一次 SNTP，校准后写板载 RTC 并自动断开（不进传书不联网、不耗电） |
| **开机页状态** | 顶部中间显示时钟；「系统加载完成」下新增 WiFi 状态行（连接中 / 时间已校准 / 连接失败），状态变化自动重绘 |
| **漫画整页显示** | 比例由“铺满裁边”改为“等比完整显示、短边留白”，左右不再被切（封面/锁屏仍铺满） |

## 漫画阅读修复

| 问题 | 修复 |
| --- | --- |
| 按键翻页后崩溃重启（回到开机页） | 预读后台任务栈只有 3KB，跑 inflate+JPEG 必然溢出——预读机制整体移除，行为最线性 |
| 单击要等好几秒才响应 | 后台预读被文件锁碎片化后会把主循环卡 4~5 秒；移除预读后按下即解码即刷新 |
| 双击 B 退不出书架 | 双击判定窗口 120ms → 220ms（人手双击间隔 150~250ms，120ms 会把双击拆成两次单击连翻两页） |
| **“这一页读不出来”** | 三层根因逐个解决：① JPEG 解码工作缓冲 65KB 只从内部 RAM 分配，WiFi 栈占用后必然失败 → 内部不足自动退 PSRAM；② 高清大页（1000×1080+）全尺寸解码要 2.9MB RGB，PSRAM 不够 → 设 80 万像素预算 + 分配失败时 1/2→1/4→1/8 逐档降级，宁可稍糊也一定出图；③ 解码缓冲常驻复用但退出漫画不释放，把文字书解析挤死 → 新增 `image_release_caches()` 随退出归还 |
| 翻页 7 秒 | 逐像素铺屏 3~5s → 行内 RLE 合并 writeFillRect；`-Og` → 热点 `-O2`；关闭 ROM 版 TJpgDec 用源码版；灰度转换浮点 → Q16 定点。单页降到约 5~6 秒（SD 读取占 1.2s，SPI 模式不支持 >20MHz 是硬限制） |
| 残影累积 | 自定义 epd_text 波形：12 帧前置 2 帧整屏刷白清底，浅影从源头清零；仍保留每 8 页一次全刷兜底 |
| 漫画页遮挡画面 | 移除左上角电量与顶部时间，只留右下角页码 |

## 其他

- 阅读页底栏“双击A 设置”提示避让左下角页码，不再压字
- 默认屏幕方向改为 180°（倒置拿更顺手，键位已互换）
- 主任务优先级 1 → 3：后台任务只准在主循环间隙干活，测试/排版/刷屏不被抢占
- 内置书库打开书籍、传书、字库、锁屏等原有功能保持
- 关于页 PaperDIY 标题居中修复（自绘文字函数会重置对齐基准，drawString 前需重设）"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"# v0.0.3
本版变化
WiFi 传书
设备自带热点，手机连上去用浏览器就能往 SD 卡里丢书，不用拔卡、不用装驱动、不用数据线。

书库界面双击 B 进入传书模式，屏幕直接显示热点名、密码、访问地址。
热点名 PaperDIY-XXXX（XXXX 是设备 MAC 后 4 位），密码 paperdiy。
手机连上热点后浏览器打开 http://192.168.4.1，选文件上传即可。
支持 .txt 和 .epub，文件落在 SD 卡根目录；上传完成自动重扫书库，屏幕上的"共 N 本"当场更新。
设备端实时反馈：当前连接数、正在传的文件名、已收字节 / 总字节、进度条、成功或失败原因、SD 卡剩余空间。
空间不足会拒收并提示；重名文件自动加后缀，不覆盖已有书。
传书界面 3 分钟无操作自动返回书库，不耽误阅读。
EPUB 阅读
不是"能传进来"，是真能读。

内置 RFC 1951 inflate 解压 + ZIP 解析（stored / deflate），读完 META-INF/container.xml 找到 OPF，再按 spine 顺序抽取章节。
XHTML 去标签、实体解码、块级元素自动分段，最终落成纯文本走原有排版引擎——所以字号、横竖屏、翻页、进度保存这些全部一样好使。
正文抽出后缓存在 /sdcard/.paperdiy/，第二次打开秒开。
书库同时识别 .txt 和 .epub，两种书混排，图标区分。"}

| **ILI9341** | **Cardputer ADV** |

| DC          | G6                |

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"# StickS3 DeepSeek 余额 / 用量显示器

**固件名称**：StickS3 DeepSeek Info  
**当前版本**：v1.0.0  
**适用设备**：M5Stack StickS3（ESP32-S3 / 8MB Flash / 8MB PSRAM / 135×240 屏幕 / BMI270）  
**界面语言**：简体中文  
**联网方式**：2.4GHz Wi-Fi  
**数据服务**：DeepSeek 官方 API + DeepSeek 开放平台账户数据

> **一句话简介**：在 M5Stack StickS3 上实时显示 DeepSeek 余额、今日消费、请求次数与 Tokens，支持网页配网、密钥安全管理与四方向自动旋转。

---

## 一、固件简介

这是一款为 M5Stack StickS3 打造的桌面信息屏固件，用于随时查看 DeepSeek 账户的余额与当日用量。

设备通过 Wi-Fi 连接网络，自动获取并滚动刷新以下数据，显示在 1.14 英寸屏幕上：

- **账户余额**
- **今日消费金额**
- **今日 API 请求次数**
- **今日消耗 Tokens**

固件支持网页配网、自动横竖屏旋转、按键操作、断线重连与异常提示，配置保存在设备本地，断电不丢失。

> 说明：DeepSeek 官方 API Key 只能查询余额；今日消费、请求次数与 Tokens 来自开放平台网页端使用的账户数据接口，因此本固件采用「官方 API Key + 平台登录 Token」双通道设计。

---

## 二、主要功能

### 1. 双通道数据

| 数据项 | 数据来源 | 配置项 |
|---|---|---|
| 余额 | DeepSeek 官方余额接口 | API Key |
| 今日消费 | 开放平台用量接口 | 平台 Token |
| 今日请求次数 | 开放平台用量接口 | 平台 Token |
| 今日 Tokens | 开放平台用量接口 | 平台 Token |

- 两项都配置：余额走官方接口，用量走平台接口，互不影响；
- 只配置平台 Token：余额显示平台钱包汇总；
- 只配置 API Key：仅显示余额，用量项显示 `--`。

### 2. 屏幕显示

竖屏与横屏均提供两页界面：

**页面 1：余额与今日用量**

- 账户余额（人民币显示为 `123.45元`）
- 今日消费金额
- 今日请求次数
- 今日 Tokens
- 赠送余额 / 充值余额（若使用平台 Token）
- 数据更新时间、下次刷新倒计时、当前状态提示

**页面 2：账户与网络**

- 赠送余额、充值余额、平台余额
- API Key / 平台 Token 状态
- Wi-Fi 信号强度、设备 IP
- 刷新间隔、运行时长
- 当前管理 PIN、固件版本

**配网界面**

- 配网热点名称、热点密码
- 配置网址 `192.168.4.1`
- 6 位管理 PIN
- 配置步骤提示

**异常提示**

- Token 失效、API Key 无效、平台限流、网络断开、等待对时等状态会明确显示
- 获取失败时保留上次成功数据并标记「旧数据」，同时显示失败原因
- 「更新」时间始终取最近一次成功时间，不会伪装成当前时间

### 3. 网页配网

- 首次开机自动进入配网模式（SoftAP + Captive Portal）
- 手机或电脑连接热点后，浏览器打开 `192.168.4.1` 即可配置
- 配网页需要输入设备屏幕上的 **6 位管理 PIN**
- 支持 Wi-Fi 扫描并下拉选择
- 支持填写 API Key、平台 Token、时区、刷新间隔、屏幕亮度
- 支持「测试连接」「立即刷新」「恢复出厂」
- 设备联网后，可在同一局域网通过设备 IP 打开配置页
- 支持 mDNS：`http://sticks3-xxxx.local`

### 4. 自动旋转

- 内置 BMI270 六轴传感器，自动识别设备方向
- 支持竖屏、竖屏倒置、横屏、横屏反向四个方向
- 屏幕平放时保持当前方向，避免桌面放置时来回翻转
- 方向稳定约 350ms 后才切换，减少抖动
- 可在配网页关闭自动旋转，或开启「横屏方向反向」校正

### 5. 按键操作

| 按键 | 操作 | 功能 |
|---|---|---|
| BtnA | 短按 | 立即刷新数据 |
| BtnA | 长按约 1.8 秒 | 进入配网模式（重启为热点） |
| BtnB | 短按 | 页面 1 / 页面 2 切换 |
| BtnB | 长按约 1.5 秒 | 屏幕背光开 / 关 |

开机时按住 BtnA，可强制进入配网模式。

### 6. 稳定性设计

- 刷新请求分步执行，避免长时间阻塞界面与配网页
- Wi-Fi 断线自动重连，重连成功后重新对时并刷新
- 使用 NTP 对时；未对时前不发起 HTTPS 请求
- 认证失败自动退避 5 分钟，普通失败 30 秒后重试
- 平台限流（HTTP 429）时给出明确提示
- 配置写入后回读校验，避免「提示保存成功但实际未写入」

---

## 三、首次配置流程

1. 设备首次开机自动进入配网模式；
2. 使用手机/电脑连接屏幕显示的热点 `StickS3-DS-XXXX`，密码显示在设备屏幕上；
3. 浏览器打开 `http://192.168.4.1/`；
4. 输入设备屏幕上的 **6 位管理 PIN** 登录；
5. 填写以下信息：
   - Wi-Fi 名称与密码（仅支持 2.4GHz）；
   - DeepSeek API Key（用于余额）；
   - 平台 Token（用于今日用量）；
   - 时区（默认 GMT+8）；
   - 刷新间隔（默认 60 秒，可调 30–3600 秒）；
   - 屏幕亮度；
   - 是否自动旋转、横屏方向是否反向；
6. 保存并重启，设备连接 Wi-Fi 后开始显示数据。

> 「测试连接」需要设备已经联网。配网模式下设备尚未连接 Wi-Fi，测试按钮会自动禁用；保存重启、设备联网后，可通过设备 IP 打开配置页进行测试。

### 平台 Token 获取方法

1. 电脑浏览器登录 `platform.deepseek.com`；
2. 按 `F12` 打开开发者工具，进入 Console；
3. 执行：

```js
copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('userToken')).value)
```

4. 将剪贴板内容粘贴到配网页的「平台 Token」输入框。

平台 Token 相当于网页登录凭证，请勿分享；平台登出、改密码或 Token 过期后需要重新获取，设备会提示「Token 失效，请更新」。

---

## 四、配置项说明

| 配置项 | 说明 | 默认值 |
|---|---|---|
| Wi-Fi SSID / 密码 | 仅支持 2.4GHz；更换 SSID 后需重新填写密码 | — |
| API Key | 用于官方余额接口 | 空 |
| 平台 Token | 用于今日消费、请求数、Tokens | 空 |
| 时区 | 「今日」按该时区 0 点重置 | GMT+8 |
| 刷新间隔 | 30–3600 秒；过小可能触发平台限流 | 60 秒 |
| 屏幕亮度 | 10–255 | 200 |
| 自动旋转 | 根据设备方向切换横竖屏 | 开启 |
| 横屏方向反向 | 横屏上下颠倒时勾选 | 关闭 |

配置保存在设备本地 NVS，断电不丢失。网页中密钥输入框留空表示保持原值；恢复出厂会同时清除设备保存的 Wi-Fi 凭据。

---

## 五、安全与隐私

- 配网热点使用 WPA2 随机密码，每次启动更新，显示在设备屏幕上；
- 配网页需要每次启动随机生成的 6 位管理 PIN；
- 登录后使用 HttpOnly + SameSite 的会话 Cookie，并对写操作校验请求来源；
- 网页中只显示密钥掩码，不返回完整 API Key 或 Token；
- 所有配置只保存在设备本地，不上传任何第三方服务器；
- 设备网页为局域网 HTTP，请仅在可信网络环境中使用；
- 设备丢失时，请到平台「退出所有会话」并删除对应 API Key。

---

## 六、运行条件

- 硬件：M5Stack StickS3；
- 网络：可访问 `api.deepseek.com` 与 `platform.deepseek.com` 的 2.4GHz Wi-Fi；
- 账号：DeepSeek 账号（API Key 与平台登录 Token）；
- 时间：设备需要联网完成 NTP 对时（HTTPS 证书校验依赖系统时间）。

---

## 七、常见问题

**Q：屏幕显示 `--` / 「需配置平台 Token」？**  
只配置了 API Key。今日消费、请求数、Tokens 需要平台 Token。

**Q：提示「Token 失效，请更新」？**  
平台 Token 已过期或被登出，按上文方法重新获取并保存。

**Q：提示「用量未更新」/ 用量一直是 `--`？**  
说明余额通道正常，但平台用量接口请求失败。可查看设备串口日志或访问设备状态 JSON 中的 `amount_err` / `cost_err` 字段定位原因；常见为 Token 失效、平台限流或网络超时。

**Q：输入管理 PIN 后页面没反应？**  
确认输入的是设备当前屏幕上的 PIN（重启后会变化）；也可以直接访问 `http://192.168.4.1/?pin=屏幕上的PIN`。若使用手机 Captive Portal 小窗，建议改用普通浏览器。

**Q：扫描不到 Wi-Fi？**  
StickS3 仅支持 2.4GHz。扫描完成后，在 Wi-Fi 名称输入框下方的「扫描结果」下拉框中选择；也可以手动输入 SSID。

**Q：自动旋转方向不对？**  
固件已按 StickS3 实际 IMU 轴向校正。若只有横屏上下颠倒，在配网页勾选「横屏方向反向」；不需要自动旋转时可直接关闭。

**Q：刷新失败怎么办？**  
设备会保留上次成功数据并显示失败原因。网络问题检查 Wi-Fi 与对时；认证问题重新配置密钥；平台限流可调大刷新间隔。

**Q：电池续航？**  
Wi-Fi 常连、屏幕常亮时功耗较高，建议 USB 供电；也可通过 BtnB 长按关闭背光省电。

---

## 八、版本记录

### v1.0.0

- 首次发布
- 支持 DeepSeek 余额、今日消费、请求次数、Tokens 显示
- 支持网页配网、Wi-Fi 扫描、密钥测试
- 支持双通道数据与失效提示
- 支持四方向自动旋转
- 支持按键刷新、翻页、背光控制
- 支持断线重连、NTP 对时、错误退避与旧数据标记
- 支持网页管理 PIN、WPA2 配网热点、密钥掩码显示

---

## 九、免责声明

- 本固件为非官方第三方应用，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系；
- 平台用量数据来自其网页端使用的账户接口，并非官方公开 API，平台更新后可能需要适配；
- 请遵守 DeepSeek 服务条款，仅查询本人账户数据，避免高频请求；
- 使用本固件产生的账号、密钥与设备安全风险由使用者自行承担。"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"UNIX V0 is the earliest UNIX system reconstructed for the PDP-7, based on the work done at Bell Labs around 1969–1970.

It predates many things we now take for granted in UNIX: normal pathnames, a modern shell environment, standard C tools, and even some familiar directory conventions. Programs and files are accessed in a much more primitive way, which makes UNIX V0 both unusual and historically interesting to use.

This simhP4 build runs PDP-7 UNIX V0 on RetroP4 using Open SIMH, with local display, keyboard input, persistent disk storage, GRAPHIC-II support, and several original PDP-7 programs such as **Space Travel (`st`)** and **`psych`**.

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"An application for the M5StickS3 that acts as a USB or Bluetooth MIDI mod wheel or pitch wheel.

## USB MIDI

Connect the M5StickS3 with a data-capable cable. The display shows `USB` when connected.

## Bluetooth MIDI

Press the side button to start Bluetooth pairing. The display shows `PAIR`.
Pair with the device named `M5 Mod Wheel`. The display then shows `CONN`.

On macOS, BLE MIDI do not appear in System Settings > Bluetooth like headphones.
See [Set up Bluetooth MIDI devices in Audio MIDI Setup on Mac](https://support.apple.com/en-euro/guide/audio-midi-setup/ams33f013765/mac).

## Controls

- Press the front button to switch between mod-wheel and pitch-bend modes.
  Each press also captures the current orientation as the zero pose.
- Tilt up and down to change the MIDI value.

## MIDI output

- Mod-wheel mode sends Control Change 1 on MIDI channel 1. The zero pose maps to 64; tilting in either direction moves the value toward 0 or 127.
- Pitch-bend mode sends standard 14-bit pitch-bend values on MIDI channel 1, centered at 8192 in the 0–16383 range. The zero pose is the center; tilting reaches the bend limits."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"**たまごっちょ (Tamagotcho)**: a 電子単語帳 (electronic flashcard book) for kanji. Multiple-choice reviews with spaced repetition, fully offline. One image for the **StickS3** and the **Cardputer ADV**: it finds the board at boot.

A new kanji is introduced first: its stroke order, meanings, readings and two example words. Then it is asked: pick its meaning or its reading from four options and answer. Spaced repetition (FSRS) decides when you see it again, and the wrong options are ones you could really confuse. Get one wrong and a card shows its meanings, readings and stroke order.

**Features**

- Kanji → meaning, kanji → reading, meaning → kanji
- Learning mode: each new kanji gets an intro card, then is asked again a few cards later
- Spaced repetition on the device, a daily cap of new cards
- Stroke order animated from KanjiVG on new kanji and after a mistake
- 12 free decks: JLPT N5 to N1 and the 2,136 Jōyō kanji, in English and Spanish, with example words, downloaded over Wi-Fi
- A web portal on your phone: decks, statistics, uploads
- The real date from your phone or NTP; dims and sleeps to save the battery
- Screens in English or Spanish

**First start**

1. Choose the language.
2. Scan the QR code on the screen with your phone to join `Tamagotcho-XXXX`, open the page, enter your home Wi-Fi and press **Switch to my Wi-Fi**.
3. Scan the new QR code and download a deck, e.g. JLPT N5.

**Controls**

- StickS3: tap the front button to move, **hold it to answer**; hold the side button for the settings, tap it to go back. On a new kanji's card, a side tap says you already know it.
- Cardputer ADV: `;` `.` `,` `/` (the arrows) move, **Enter answers**, Tab opens the settings, Esc goes back. On a new kanji's card, ← says you already know it.

Burning erases the settings (home Wi-Fi, preferences). Code MIT; decks CC BY-SA (KANJIDIC2, KanjiVG, JMdict). Source, manual and other boards: https://github.com/dcarnicer/tamagotcho"}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"html","content":"

让 Cardputer ADV 变成你的口袋股票看板。直接连接 Wi-Fi，独立查看美股、港股和沪深股票。
主要功能：

  • 自选列表：中文股票名、三位小数报价、红涨绿跌。
  • 体感卡牌：左右倾斜切换股票，左右键微调，长按快速滑动。
  • 多周期图表：5 日、日 K、周 K、月 K、年 K，支持线图切换和缩放。
  • 美股盘前：同时展示常规收盘价与盘前报价；盘中展示常规报价。
  • 股票搜索：支持代码、名称及常用股票拼音、首字母。
  • 手机管理：扫码打开同一 Wi-Fi 下的网页，批量添加、拖动排序并保存自选。
  • 后台预加载、手动刷新、本地时间、Wi-Fi 状态与电量显示。

快捷键

日常看盘

  • G：普通列表 / 体感卡牌切换。
  • U：刷新当前报价；详情页同时重试图表。首页 / 详情也可按侧键刷新。
  • F：搜索股票，支持代码、名称及常用股票拼音 / 首字母。
  • W：显示二维码，手机在同一 Wi-Fi 下扫码管理自选、拖动排序并保存。
  • B：关屏 / 亮屏；关屏后设备仍工作联网。
  • ESC：返回上一层；卡牌返回普通列表，删除确认页取消删除。

普通列表

  • 上 / 下：切换股票，长按加速；首尾循环并提示边界。
  • 1 / 2 / 3：打开当前屏对应股票详情。
  • Enter：手工编辑自选代码列表。
  • TAB：打开设置，可调整 Wi-Fi、刷新间隔、亮度、时区和体感开关。

体感卡牌

  • 左右倾斜设备：滑动选卡，中央卡牌放大。
  • 左 / 右：微调选卡，长按连续滑动并加速。
  • Enter：查看当前卡牌详情；卡牌不使用 1 / 2 / 3。
  • ESC：退出卡牌，返回普通列表。

股票详情

  • TAB：切换 5 日、日 K、周 K、月 K、年 K。
  • 空格：切换 K 线 / 收盘价折线；5 日保持线图。
  • Z / X：放大 / 缩小图表。
  • ; 或 , / . 或 /：上一只 / 下一只股票。
  • D：申请删除当前股票；再按 Enter 确认，ESC 取消。

搜索、输入与联网

  • TAB（搜索中）：切换 CN 拼音 / EN 英文模式。
  • 1 / 2 / 3（有拼音组合时）：选对应候选；空格选首个候选。
  • Enter（搜索中）：提交候选 / 查询 / 添加选中结果，按当前步骤执行。
  • DEL：删除输入字符，无需 Fn。
  • R（Wi-Fi 扫描页）：重新扫描；断网也能使用。
  • Enter（设置 / Wi-Fi）：选择项目、输入密码或保存连接。

字符方向键、候选翻页、完整输入规则与返回层级见 完整按键表。输入页面里的 B / F / G / U / W 是输入字符，不触发功能。

仅适用于 Cardputer ADV。本包为完整安装包，首次安装写入地址为 0x0，会覆盖原配置。保留配置升级请使用 GitHub 中的应用升级包。

报价依赖第三方数据，可能延迟或中断；不提供夜盘、盘后报价及下单功能。完整说明与全部按键见项目主页。

基于 ansonlianson/cardputer-adv-stock-monitor 开发，采用 MIT 许可。

"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"# CoreInk Humidor & Environmental Monitor - v1.0.0 Release Package

---
【固件名称】
CoreInk Humidor & Environmental Monitor (雪茄箱 / 室内环境监测仪)

【必须外接硬件 / 传感器说明】
⚠️ 运行本固件必须连接以下传感器，否则无法完成环境感知：
• 主控设备：M5Stack CoreInk (ESP32-PICO-D4，1.54 寸 E-Ink 电子墨水屏)
• 必须传感器：M5Stack Unit ENV-Pro (内置 Bosch BME688 传感器，SKU: U170)
• 连接方式：通过 Grove HY2.0-4P 线缆直接插入 CoreInk 机身顶部的 Port A (I2C 端口：SDA=G32, SCL=G33)

【主要特性】
1. 墨水屏全正相白底黑字显示，护眼纸质质感，强光清晰，双批次屏幕 (D67/M09) 动态驱动防冻结。
2. 室内与雪茄养护全维监测：高精度温湿度(0.1分辨率/65%黄金参考线)、气压、换算海拔高度、Bosch BSEC 空气质量(IAQ/Static IAQ/bVOC/eCO2)及气敏电阻原生阻值。
3. 双曲线历史趋势折线图：支持 10m / 1h / 6h / 24h / 2d / 7d 滚轮自由缩放与历史平移回溯。
4. 四档智能功耗架构：Realtime (高频监测 ~10h)、Balanced (日常浅睡 ~6天)、Eco ULP (10分钟周期深睡 ~2个月)、On-Demand (按需唤醒测量 ~4个月+)。
5. 开机可选 Wi-Fi NTP 校时至硬件 RTC，对时完毕彻底断开 Wi-Fi 射频，纯离线零辐射超长续航。

【按键操作】
• G5 (EXT 按键)：短按在【主仪表盘】与【空气质量实验室】之间切换；长按(>=800ms)呼出【功耗模式选单】。
• 顶部三向拨轮：G37(上推放大/向后回溯)、G39(下拉缩小/向前平移)、G38(中键短按切换缩放/平移模式)。
• 电源键 (G27)：单击重启；双击彻底关机断电。


---
[Firmware Name]
CoreInk Humidor & Environmental Monitor (Cigar Humidor & Air Quality Monitor)

[Required Sensor & Hardware Notice]
⚠️ This firmware REQUIRES external sensor hardware to function properly:
• Main Device: M5Stack CoreInk (ESP32-PICO-D4 with 1.54" E-Ink Display)
• Required Sensor: M5Stack Unit ENV-Pro (equipped with Bosch BME688, SKU: U170)
• Connection: Plug into CoreInk Port A (Grove HY2.0-4P connector on the top, I2C: SDA=GPIO32, SCL=GPIO33)

[Key Features]
1. Crisp True Positive E-Ink Display: Paper-like readability in direct sunlight. Universal auto-probe driver supports both D67 and M09 hardware batches without freezing or flashing.
2. Comprehensive Environmental Sensing: High-precision Temp & Humidity (0.1 resolution with 65% RH humidor benchmark), Atmospheric Pressure, Altitude, and Bosch BSEC Air Quality Engine (IAQ, Static IAQ, bVOC, eCO2, raw gas resistance).
3. Dynamic Dual-Curve History Charts: Smooth zoom (5m to 7d) and bidirectional time-travel panning using the dial switch.
4. 4 Intelligent Power Modes: Realtime (~10h), Balanced (~6 days with dynamic light-sleep), Eco ULP (~2 months with 10-min deep-sleep cycle), and On-Demand (~4+ months).
5. Fast Wi-Fi NTP Time Sync: Syncs RTC (BM8563) on boot and shuts off Wi-Fi immediately for ultra-low power offline operation.

[Controls]
• G5 (EXT Button): Short press to toggle Main Dashboard / Air Quality Lab; Long press (>=800ms) to open Power Mode Menu.
• Top Dial Wheel: G37 (Up / Zoom-in / Pan-back), G39 (Down / Zoom-out / Pan-forward), G38 (Mid-click to toggle Zoom/Pan mode).
• Power Button (G27): Click to reboot; Double-click to power off completely."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"A high-precision G-force (acceleration) logger specifically designed for the M5Cardputer ADV. It records and visualizes the waveforms of momentary impacts and recoil in detail.

■ Key Features

1000Hz High-Speed Sampling
The standard sampling rate for the BMI270 sensor in the M5Unified library is typically 100Hz. This application directly controls the sensor to achieve 1000Hz (1ms interval) data acquisition.

Up to 27.7G Measurement Capacity
The sensor range is expanded to ±16G per axis. By calculating the 3-axis resultant vector, it can accurately capture a maximum resultant acceleration of up to 27.7G without clipping.

Records ±0.1 Seconds Around the Peak Impact
The moment of peak impact (maximum G-force) is set as the center point (0ms). The application automatically records acceleration data for 0.1 seconds before and after the event, covering a total window of -100ms to +100ms.

Logarithmic Scale Graph (1 pixel = 0.001 sec)
The captured data is instantly plotted on the screen. The X-axis represents 1 pixel = 0.001 seconds (1ms). The Y-axis utilizes a logarithmic scale, ensuring both small vibrations and massive impacts are clearly visible on the small screen without flattening the waveform.

■ Use Cases

Airsoft: Recoil measurement and custom parts evaluation.
Robotics: Impact testing for small robots and mobility devices.
3D Printing: Drop testing and shock absorption of printed parts.
Education: Visualizing physics phenomena such as free fall and impact force.
Sports: Measuring instantaneous acceleration and impacts during sports activities.
Packaging: Evaluating cushioning and shock resistance for shipping.

■ Instructions

[Enter] Key: Reset the measurement and return to the standby screen."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"## 使用

首次启动未保存 Wi-Fi 时自动进入配网；也可随时单击 **A 键**进入配网。单击 **B 键**退出并回到时钟。

1. 使用手机**系统相机或系统扫一扫**扫描屏幕左侧的 Wi-Fi 二维码，加入设备热点；微信不支持该连接方式。也可在手机 Wi-Fi 设置中手动连接屏幕显示的 `PaperDIY-xxxxxx` 热点，密码为 **`12345678`**。
2. 连接热点后，扫描右侧网址二维码，或在系统浏览器打开 **`http://192.168.4.1/wifi`**。如果系统自动弹出配置页，也可直接使用。
3. 扫描并选择家中 Wi-Fi，或手动填写隐藏网络名称，输入密码并保存。
4. 设备先验证连接，成功后保存配置，并在 5 秒后返回时钟。连接失败或按 B 退出时保留原配置。

## 供电与状态

- Wi-Fi 图标表示最近一次校时成功，不表示无线网络一直保持连接；失败或未校时显示 X。
- 闪电表示检测到外部供电，电量百分比为电压估算值。
- 已有有效时间时，校时失败仍继续离线走时，6 小时后再尝试；没有有效时间时每分钟重试校时。
- 电池模式休眠中插入电源，会在下一次分钟唤醒后识别供电变化。
- 没有有效时间时显示占位符；未配网时按 B 返回时钟，不会在下一次分钟唤醒时强制进入配网。"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"## MIASMORA — Dark Ambient Drone Generator

**Fully synthesised horror ambience for the Cardputer ADV** (no samples, 25 layers)

Firmware that turns the Cardputer ADV into a **dark ambient drone generator**: an endless, uneasy horror-film drone, synthesised in real time. It keeps changing by itself and reacts to the room.

> Earphones are recommended: the built-in speaker barely reproduces the lowest notes.

### Key features

- **25 synthesised layers**: 11 drones, 13 events (knocks, footsteps, drips, insects…) and a reverb
- **24 moods** + random scenes, all from a **6-digit seed** you can share
- **DREAD**: one knob that makes everything more unsettling
- **Drift** and **Arc**: the sound keeps changing by itself, building to a climax

- A microSD card (for settings, scenes and recordings)
- Earphones (recommended)

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"**Turn your Cardputer into a real computer:** a full desktop in your browser, 50+ native apps and games, and an AI assistant that works offline.

Type `nucleo-01.local` in any browser on your Wi-Fi and the Cardputer itself serves you a desktop: files, spreadsheet, paint, terminal, SSH, music and video, 40+ apps. In your hands, a fast launcher with big readable fonts and **ANIMA**, an assistant that answers, calculates, sets timers and opens apps with no cloud at all.

### Highlights
- **ANIMA offline assistant** in English and Italian (it can also use a model on your PC or in the cloud)
- **Web desktop** served by the device: 40+ apps in any browser on your network
- **50+ native apps and games**: Game Boy and Game Gear emulator, Tanks, Pinball, music and video player, voice recorder, IR remote, Wi-Fi and BLE tools
- **One binary for Cardputer and Cardputer ADV**: the board is detected at boot
- **5 languages**: EN, IT, ES, FR, DE
- **Safe A/B updates** with automatic rollback; also runs as a guest under M5Launcher

### Install
1. Burn this image (same file for Cardputer and Cardputer ADV).
2. On first boot the setup wizard joins your Wi-Fi and downloads the SD card content (web desktop, apps) by itself, or copy `nucleoos-0.7.3.0-sd.zip` from the GitHub release to a FAT32 microSD.
3. Open the address shown on the screen in your browser.

Free for noncommercial use (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0); commercial use needs a license. Includes security-testing tools: authorized testing, research and education only.

Source, docs and release notes: https://github.com/indecenti/NucleoOs"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"# Dragon Detector for M5Stack Dial

A compact Wi-Fi and Bluetooth awareness display, tested on M5Stack Dial v1.1.

- Live radar with 32 contact slots, priority labels, device details and signal-strength hunting.
- Turn the ring to browse, press to select, hold to go back. Touchscreen menus and dot actions are also available.
- 40 built-in radar and clock themes, stopwatch and locksport timing. Clock and timer pause scanning.
- Separate Time and Date settings, brightness and buzzer controls. USB clock setup verifies the hardware RTC.

This image is exclusively for M5Stack Dial, with 8 MB flash and no PSRAM. The original K130 has not been physically tested. The compact profile does not include active radio labs, FindMy beeping, badge uploads, saved captures, SD, GPS or RFID operations. Radar positions are visual organization, not measured direction or distance.

## Installation

Flash this complete factory BIN at **0x0**. A fresh installation replaces existing settings. If necessary, hold the rear G0/BOOT button while reconnecting, then release it. After flashing, reconnect normally without holding any buttons. No SD pack is needed.

Set the date, time and timezone using the USB Studio on the project website, or use Menu > Settings > Time and Date on the Dial. RTC retention requires its power supply.

[Web flasher and USB tools](https://valleytech-dragon-detector.pages.dev/#install) · [Dial controls and clock setup](https://valleytech-dragon-detector.pages.dev/guides/M5STACK-DIAL.html)"}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"A fork of [Zimodem](https://github.com/bozimmerman/Zimodem) (Bo Zimmerman's WiFi modem firmware for retro computers) ported to the **M5Stack Cardputer ADV** (ESP32-S3).

The Cardputer becomes a self-contained WiFi modem with its own terminal: the retro computer talks to it through the UART on the Grove port, while the built-in keyboard types AT commands and the display shows everything Zimodem prints, so you can configure WiFi and dial a BBS without a host computer attached.

> **Note:** this port was developed with the help of AI (Claude).

## Features

- Terminal on the 240x135 display: 40x16 window, real-time scrolling, scrollback, status bar (WiFi, baud, call state)
- ANSI colors and basic cursor/erase sequences
- Encodings: **CP437**, **UTF-8** and **PETSCII** (C64 colors, reverse, cursor control, graphic symbols); outside a call PETSCII is shown as plain ASCII so AT commands stay readable
- Optional **80-column** and **25-row** virtual screens, with column-by-column horizontal panning (for C64/BBS screens that draw at absolute positions)
- **Settings menu**: virtual screen, text color, UART RX/TX pins, baud rate, UART input on/off, encoding. Stored in NVS
- **BBS phonebook** with 10 entries (name + `host[:port]`), stored in NVS; selecting an entry types `ATDT host[:port]` for you
- **SSH phonebook** with 10 entries (name, user, password, host, optional port), stored in NVS; selecting an entry types `ATDS"user:password@host[:port]"` for you
- Full-screen text apps over SSH (e.g. `mc`, `nano`, `htop`): the SSH session requests `TERM=xterm` with the size of the virtual screen (enable 80 columns / 25 rows in the settings first), and the terminal supports scroll regions, insert/delete line and character, VT100 line drawing, application cursor keys and the alternate screen

- Changing the baud rate in the menu also sends `AT&W`, so Zimodem keeps it across reboots
- Keyboard, display and UART are handled by a dedicated FreeRTOS task, so the screen stays responsive during long Zimodem operations"}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"**天机 TianJi** —— M5Stack Cardputer ADV 掌上固件，开源（MIT）。
余生倒计时 · 小六壬 · 求签 · 掷筊 · 3D 骰子与硬币 · SD 卡长录音 · 番茄钟 · Kindle 翻页器

源码、截图与技术笔记：https://github.com/Wenston-dev/tianji-cardputer

## 首次使用

1. 首页按 **T** 设置日期时间，按 **S** 进设置填写**生日**。
2. Cardputer 没有断电保持的时钟：不用时请**长按 G0 进入待机**，不要拨开关断电。待机时时钟继续走，按任意键或 G0 唤醒。
3. 真断电后首页会出现「时间待校准」提示，按 **T** 校准；填了 WiFi 的话，断电后开机会自动联网校时（待机唤醒不会联网）。
4. 录音和番茄钟统计需要一张 **FAT32** 格式的 SD 卡。

## 通用按键

- **方向键**：键盘上的 `;`（上）、`.`（下）、`,`（左）、`/`（右）。在输入文字的状态下，需要按住 **Fn** 再按。
- **Esc**：左上角的 `` ` `` 键。**Esc** 或 **退格键（Del）** 都能从任意页面回到首页。
- **Enter** 确认，**空格** 开始或执行。
- 屏幕熄灭时，按第一下只会点亮屏幕，不会触发操作（翻页器页面除外）。

## 全局快捷键（任意页面都有效）

- **短按 G0** 或 **Ctrl+R**：一键开始录音，再按一次停止
- **长按 G0 约 1.5 秒**：进入待机（屏幕中间出现一圈进度，满了即待机）；按任意键或 G0 唤醒；番茄钟计时中不能待机
- **Fn+1 / Fn+2 / Fn+3**：直接用对应预设开始录音（随手录 / 长时录音 / 高保真 44.1kHz）

## 首页 · 余生

- 方向键、Enter、Tab 或空格：打开底部应用栏；←→（或 Tab）切换，Enter 或空格打开，Esc 收起
- 字母键直达：**L** 小六壬　**Q** 求签　**J** 掷筊　**D** 骰子　**C** 硬币　**R** 录音　**F** 录音库　**P** 番茄钟　**K** 翻页器　**S** 设置
- 数字 **1–9**：按应用栏顺序直接打开
- **U**：进入 U 盘模式
- **T**：校准时间（←→ 选择年 / 月 / 日 / 时 / 分，↑↓ 调整，按住 Shift 一次 10，也可以直接输入数字；Enter 确认，**W** 联网校时，Esc 取消）

## 小六壬

- **空格**：时辰起课（自动取当前农历月、日、时辰）
- **Tab**：切换「时辰起课 / 报数起课」
- 报数起课：输入数字后按空格确认，共输入三个数；**退格键** 删除一位，没有可删的位时退回上一个数
- 出结果后按 **Enter** 看竖排诗诀，再按 Enter 或 Esc 返回
- 同一个时辰内，时辰起课的结果不变（传统算法）

## 求签 / 掷筊 / 骰子 / 硬币

- **按住空格（或 Enter）蓄力，松手投出**，蓄得越满投得越猛；轻点一下是轻抛
- 也可以直接**甩动设备**来摇签或投掷
- 求签：签落地后按 **Enter** 看详解（事业、财运、感情、健康、出行），再按 Enter 回到签文；**J** 接着掷筊请示；**空格** 重新求签
- 掷筊：圣杯（一平一凸）、笑杯（两平）、阴杯（两凸）；连得三次圣杯有特效
- 骰子：**1–6** 选择骰子个数，或用 **- / =** 增减
- 硬币：**C** 或 **0** 清零正反面计数

## 录音

- **↑↓** 或 **1–3** 选择预设，**Enter** 或空格开始录音
- 录音中：**空格** 暂停或继续，**M** 打标记，**Enter** 停止并保存
- 录音中按 Esc 回首页不会中断录音：首页会显示录音时长，其它页面右上角有红点提示
- 录音时屏幕自动调暗、熄屏省电（可在设置里调整）；按任意键点亮
- **F**：打开录音库
- 文件保存在 SD 卡 `/REC/`，按录制时间命名；长时间录音会自动分段续写

## 录音库

- **↑↓** 选择，**Enter** 或空格播放
- **D**：删除（连按两次确认，第一次按会出现红色提示）
- **R**：开始新录音，**U**：进入 U 盘模式
- 播放中：**空格 / Enter** 暂停或继续；**←→** 快退或快进 5 秒，按住 **Shift** 一次 30 秒；**- / =** 音量；**N / P** 跳到下一个或上一个标记；**Esc** 回到列表

## 番茄钟

- 列表：**↑↓** 选择，**Enter** 或空格开始
- **E** 编辑当前预设，**N** 新建（也可以选最后一行「+ 新建」），**D** 删除（连按两次确认）
- **Tab**：查看统计（今日分钟数、番茄个数、连续天数、近 7 天），再按 Tab 或 Esc 返回
- 编辑：**↑↓** 选择字段，**←→** 调整数值（按住 Shift 一次 ±5），在「名称」上按 **Enter** 输入名称（支持英文），Enter 或 Esc 保存
- 计时中：**空格 / Enter** 暂停或继续，**S** 跳过当前阶段，**X**（或退格键）连按两次结束
- 计时中按 Esc 回首页，计时继续在后台进行，首页会显示进度
- 专注结束会自动开始休息；休息结束后按空格开始下一轮，在设置里打开「番茄钟自动开始」则会自动开始
- 专注记录保存在 SD 卡 `/POMO/focus.csv`

## Kindle 翻页器（实验性）

- 首次配对：在 Kindle 上打开「设置 › 蓝牙设备」，选择 **TianJi Click**
- **→ ↓ 空格 Enter N**：下一页　**← ↑ B**：上一页
- **- / =**：Kindle 亮度
- **Z**：让 Kindle 休眠
- **F**：清除配对（连按两次确认，Kindle 上也要「忘记设备」）
- 看书时屏幕 20 秒后自动熄灭，熄屏状态下按键照样能翻页
- 蓝牙只在这个页面里开启，离开后自动关闭；录音时不可用
- 尚未在真机 Kindle 上验证，欢迎反馈

## U 盘模式

- 插上电脑会弹出 3 秒倒计时，按任意键取消；倒计时结束后，SD 卡会作为 U 盘出现在电脑上
- 在电脑上推出 U 盘或拔掉数据线，设备会自动回到正常模式
- 想手动退出：连按两次 **Esc**
- 也可以在首页按 **U** 或在设置里手动进入；「插电自动U盘」可以在设置里关闭

## 设置

- **↑↓** 选择，**←→** 调整数值或开关，**Enter** 编辑文字项
- 编辑文字时：直接输入，**退格键** 删除，**Enter** 确认，**Fn+`** 取消
- 「日期时间」按 Enter 打开时间校准界面（操作同首页 T）
- 可设置：生日、预期寿命、日期时间、WiFi、自动校时（关闭 / 断电后 / 每天）、校时后关 WiFi、时区、亮度、音量、音效、录音采样率、录音增益、录音调暗与熄屏、专注熄屏、番茄钟自动开始、蓝牙翻页器开关、插电自动 U 盘、进入待机
- 关闭「蓝牙翻页器」后会重启一次，把蓝牙预留的内存释放给其它功能，也更省电

---

TianJi: life countdown, Chinese divination toys, 3D dice & coin, SD voice recorder, pomodoro timer and a Kindle page turner for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV. Full key reference, source and notes: https://github.com/Wenston-dev/tianji-cardputer (MIT)."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"一台永远停在「无信号」频道的迷你显像管。琥珀磷光雪花缓缓呼吸，偶尔泛起一阵故障 —— 上千种组合里，规则从不重复。

**拍它一下**：一半的机会，从雪花深处锁定出一个真正的频道 —— 极光与雷暴、金字塔与吴哥窟、云龙与巨鲸、独眼巨人与飞碟母舰；另一半机会，两根亮扫描线滚过，表示「我听见了」。每个世界都有自己的声音：稀疏的盖革叮嗒、外星数字语、摩尔斯电码的 SOS —— 画面和声音讲同一个故事。

· 3864 种故障场景随机组合：雪花、文字招牌、行场扭曲
· 拍打解锁「世界频道」：38 个主体 × 背景 × 天体 × 台标
· 稀有事件：测试卡、彩条、TELETEXT、外星字母表、辐射风暴
· 白噪声随画面联动：假关机静音加一声闷响、搜台扫频
· 闲置 5 分钟自己变成时钟，按任意键回到雪花
· 为失眠准备的：低亮度、低音量、可以一直盯着看

操作（M5Cardputer ADV 键盘版）：`,` 静音 · `/` 调亮度（6 档）· 拍一下切台

A miniature CRT stuck forever on a dead channel. Amber phosphor snow breathes slowly; now and then a glitch rolls through. Thousands of combinations, never the same twice.

**Slap it**: half the time a real channel locks in from deep in the static — auroras and thunder plains, pyramids and Angkor Wat, dragons and sky whales, cyclops and mother ships; the other half, two bright scan lines roll down to say "heard you". Every world speaks its own language: sparse geiger ticks, alien dial tones, a Morse SOS.

· 3,864 glitch scenes at random: snow, screen text, warping
· Slap to unlock world channels: 38 subjects x backgrounds x sky bodies x station logos
· Rare events: test cards, colour bars, TELETEXT, alien alphabets, radiation storms
· White noise follows the picture: a fake power-off with a thump, station scanning sweeps
· Idle 5 minutes and it becomes a clock; any key brings the snow back
· Made for sleepless nights: dim, quiet, safe to stare at

Controls (M5Cardputer ADV keyboard): `,` mute · `/` brightness (6 steps) · slap to change channel"}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"Typing Fighter / 打字战神

在 Cardputer ADV 上边打字、边战斗、边练习英文单词。输入屏幕上的英文提示攻击敌人，挑战连击和逐渐增强的波次，也可进入学习与练习模式。

支持 M5Stack Cardputer ADV / K132-ADV（ESP32-S3，8 MB Flash）。Enter 确认，键盘方向标识键移动，p 暂停，r 重开。

SD 语音下载与安装
烧录固件不会自动安装语音。请下载与固件 v0.1.0-rc.2 配套的 Aiden 512 词 SD 资源包：
https://github.com/Alex-Wei-HZ/DistributionResources/tree/main/TypingFighter/v0.1.0-rc.2
点击 TypingFighter-v0.1.0-rc.2-Aiden-SD.zip，再点 GitHub 的 Download raw file 保存并解压。

准备 FAT32、MBR 分区表的 microSD，建议预留至少 32 MB。
1. 新卡或没有 TFVOICE 的卡：将解压后的整个 TFVOICE 文件夹复制到 SD 卡根目录，不要额外套一层压缩包名称目录。
2. 已有 TFVOICE 的卡：不要直接合并覆盖。在解压目录使用 Python 3.10+ 安装，路径替换成自己的 SD 卡位置：
macOS：python3 tools/install_aiden.py /Volumes/CARDPUTER
Windows：py -3 tools/install_aiden.py E:/
安装器会保留旧包并激活 Aiden，重复安装不新增包；在命令末尾加 --verify-only 可检查卡上语音。
3. 安全弹出卡，关闭设备电源，插卡后重新开机。无声音时检查静音、音量和 TFVOICE 是否在卡根目录。

使用语音不需要 TTS 账号、模型或联网；未装语音仍可游玩。模型版本、生成参数和许可保存在资源包中，第三方许可及 LGPL 重链接材料也在上述下载页。

注意：完整烧录会替换原固件、启动器、设置及设备内部存档，SD 卡内容不受影响。仅支持 Cardputer ADV / K132-ADV，未验证原版 Cardputer。

Typing Fighter

Type, battle and practice English vocabulary on Cardputer ADV. Attack enemies by typing the words on screen, build combos and survive increasingly challenging waves. Learning and practice modes are included.

For M5Stack Cardputer ADV / K132-ADV only (ESP32-S3, 8 MB Flash). Enter confirms, the arrow-marked keys navigate, p pauses and r restarts.

SD voice download and installation
Flashing firmware does not install speech. Download the Aiden 512-word SD package matching firmware v0.1.0-rc.2:
https://github.com/Alex-Wei-HZ/DistributionResources/tree/main/TypingFighter/v0.1.0-rc.2
Open TypingFighter-v0.1.0-rc.2-Aiden-SD.zip, click Download raw file on GitHub, then extract it.

Use a FAT32 microSD with an MBR partition table and at least 32 MB free.
1. Fresh card: copy the complete TFVOICE folder to the card root, without an extra enclosing folder.
2. Card with existing TFVOICE: use the included Python 3.10+ installer instead of merging folders. From the extracted directory, run either command with your mounted card path:
macOS: python3 tools/install_aiden.py /Volumes/CARDPUTER
Windows: py -3 tools/install_aiden.py E:/
The installer retains old packages and activates Aiden. Repeat installs do not create duplicates. Append --verify-only to check the installed voice package.
3. Safely eject, power off, insert the card and restart. If silent, check mute/volume and the card-root TFVOICE folder.

No TTS account, model or internet connection is required to play. The game works without speech. Model revision, parameters and licenses remain in the SD package; third-party notices and LGPL relinking materials are on the same download page.

A full flash replaces the existing firmware, launcher, settings and internal saves; SD files are unaffected. Cardputer ADV / K132-ADV only. The original Cardputer has not been validated."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"把 Cardputer 变成一台声呐捕鱼机。

屏幕上是一片抽象的海：黑水、青色波光的声呐回波，鱼是会游动的光点。你坐在海底的炮台上，倾一倾手腕，炮口就跟着转；按空格开火，镜头跟着炮弹推进到鱼身上——抓住了就是金币爆开，抓住大鱼整屏会震，被鱼挣开就是网罩崩碎、它冲出去。

· 体感瞄准：整机怎么倾，炮口就怎么指，比按两个键跟手
· 9 种鱼：从小鱼到鲨鱼，还有一位不该出现在渔场的潜水员
· 三级炮台：35 / 100 / 200，重炮一炮能穿两条
· 声呐海面：鱼群随潮汐涌入，鲨鱼路过时全场小鱼炸开逃
· 鱼获本：按 l 翻看，数量、最高分、最高金币都跨局保存
· 2 分钟不动就熄屏降频，任意键唤醒

M5Stack Cardputer ADV · 240×135 · 不需要联网

---

A sonar fishing machine in your pocket.

The screen is an abstract sea: black water, cyan sonar returns, fish as drifting dots. You sit at a turret on the seabed — tilt the device and the gun follows your wrist. Fire, and the camera rides the shell out to the target: a clean hit bursts into coins, a big one shakes the screen, a break-out snaps the net and the fish bolts.

· Tilt-to-aim: how you hold it is where it points
· 9 species, from minnows to a shark, plus a diver who has no business being there
· Three cannon tiers — the heavy one punches through two fish at once
· Tidal schools, and a shark that scatters everything in its path
· Catch log: per-species counts, best score and peak coins, kept across sessions
· Two minutes idle and it sleeps; any key wakes it

M5Stack Cardputer ADV · 240×135 · no network needed"}

currentVersion.versionDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"这次的鱼，认得打窝的人了。

• 打窝（4 键）：一把饵撒下去，附近的鱼会游过来——但打窝不等于上鱼，大鱼照样难打。抛得出去，也看得见窝料一点点散完。
• 炮台重新分工：1 号只够糊小鱼，2 号是主力营生，3 号威力大但贵，只在有大鱼时才划算。打不动的时候，屏幕会直接告诉你按几号。
• 潮汐有了自己的曲子：涨潮时音乐从小调涌上来，退潮后回到原来的调子。听声音就知道世界变了。
• 鱼开始有脾气：小鱼会装死，怪鱼会盯着你，鲨鱼会吃掉身边的小鱼，鱿鱼被盯久了会喷你一脸墨。
• 开局前一分半海里的小鱼更多，第一竿不会空。

金币重新调过，涨得比以前慢，但不会卡死在某一个数上。

---

The fish know who's been chumming.

• Chumming (key 4): cast a handful of bait and nearby fish drift in — but baiting isn't catching. Watch the groundbait scatter and fade.

{"format":"html","content":"


Module Tester


A menu-driven test bench for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3) that lets you wire up and test M5Stack and third-party modules — radios, displays, GPS, RFID, IR, and audio.


Features


Modules menu — pick a unit and run its dedicated test screen:

  • CC1101 — Waterfall, Detect Freq, raw chip status, pin finder
  • NRF24L01 — chip status, 2.4GHz spectrum scan, pin finder
  • PN532 — NFC/RFID read
  • M5Stack RFID 2 — card read/test
  • GPS — live fix display
  • IR — capture, replay and manage IR signals (Flipper .ir format)
  • M5Stack LoRa Cap — LoRa + onboard GNSS
  • External Display — SPI display pin test, colour fills, Matrix rain and starfield test patterns
  • Speaker — plays RTTTL melodies (preloaded tune + your own .fmf files from SD), tone sweep, volume control, through the Cardputer ADV's onboard ES8311 codec

SD card browser — browse and manage files on the card directly from the device

Find chip pins — scans the shared SPI bus's spare GPIOs to help locate an unlabelled chip's wiring
Screenshot capture — Fn+S from anywhere saves a BMP of the current screen to the SD card
Per-module pin configuration — remembered on the SD card, no recompiling to change wiring


Hardware


M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3)
microSD card (required for file storage, screenshots, and some module features)
Whichever test modules you want to try: CC1101, NRF24L01, PN532, GPS, RFID 2, LoRa Cap, an SPI display, etc. Pins for each are configurable on-device.


Credits

  • Unigeek — CC1101 reference
  • Bruce Firmware
  • Claude Desktop Buddy
  • Flipper-IRDB — IR files
  • UberGuidoZ — Flipper FMF files


Created by Fr4nx40

{"format":"markdown","content":"# NoxPass

An offline password manager for the M5StickS3. Your passwords are encrypted on the stick (AES-256-GCM), protected by your PIN, and never leave it.

Plug it into any computer, enter your PIN with the two buttons, pick an entry, and the stick types it for you like a USB keyboard.

## Features
- Encrypted vault, PIN of 6 to 20 digits, nothing stored in the cloud
- USB keyboard (QWERTY by default, AZERTY in the settings)
- Everything controlled with two buttons, one hand
- Bridge: the stick creates its own Wi-Fi and a web page to manage your entries from a phone or PC
- Username / email presets, 19 two-color themes, auto-lock

## Quick start
Flash, press **A** at the owl, choose a PIN (**don't forget it**, it cannot be recovered).

[Full guide](https://github.com/git-psi/NoxPass/blob/main/START.md) | [Source code](https://github.com/git-psi/NoxPass)"}

firmwares.firmwareDescription: {"format":"markdown","content":"ORBIT DRUM is firmware written from scratch in C++17 on ESP-IDF 5.5.2 and LVGL 9.3 for the 5\" 1280×720 touch screen of the M5Stack Tab5. It has 16 multi-touch pads, a step sequencer, a sample editor, a mixer with effects, scenes and a song arrangement, an acid bass line and a polyphonic synth with chords, both with a live keyboard for several fingers. The engine renders at 48 kHz with about 7 ms of output latency."}

currentVersion.versionDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"Pads: 16 pads; the sound starts on finger-down, several fingers at once (up to 5). MUTE / SOLO pad modes.
Sample editor: the real waveform with START / END handles (double tap snaps to a zero crossing); TRIM, SLICE (auto or grid, slices to pads), ENVELOPE, FILTER, PITCH and LFO pages; 4 layers per pad. Destructive tools (normalize, reverse, trim, fade, mono, crush) with UNDO, and WAV export.
Sequencer: 8 tracks × 16 steps per bar, up to 64 steps. Velocity, probability, ratchet, nudge, pitch and conditions per step. Swing, division, FILL, RANDOM / CLEAR with UNDO, live recording from the pads.
Mixer: 8 buses + master with faders, meters, mute / solo, a limiter and a metronome.
FX: reverb, tempo-synced delay, LO-FI / WIDE / PUMP / SPACE macros, master limiter.
ACID BASS: a 303-style monophonic voice (24 dB resonant ladder filter, accent, slide, saw / square) with one line per scene, from C0 to C5. Edit it on a step keyboard or by drawing notes on the line. KEYS mode: a two-octave live keyboard played with several fingers (OCT ± from C0 up to C7). The newest key sounds, and lifting it returns to the key still held; with SLIDE the notes glide like a 303. Nothing is recorded.
SYNTH (0.4.9): a 4-voice virtual-analog synth in the manner of a SYSTEM-1 (two oscillators with COLOR, sync, ring and cross-mod, sub and noise, -24 / -12 dB filters, two envelopes, LFO, POLY / MONO / UNISON, 8 factory patches). Every scene has a synth note line (chords of up to 4 notes, each with its own length) that plays with the drums and the bass on mixer channel 7. The SYNTH view: a piano roll of the bar over two octaves; pick a step and tap keys to add or remove its chord's notes (LEN, VEL); 48 knobs on six pages (OSC 1, OSC 2, FILTER, ENV, LFO, VOICE) and the factory patches; KEYS: a two-octave live keyboard, every finger sounds (chords), not recorded.
Performance (0.4.9, the sound bit-identical to before): the SYNTH renders on the second CPU core while the drums render; the reverb's delay lines live in internal RAM and the display's draw buffers in PSRAM (the reverb costs half, the UI draws faster); the pads redraw only what changes. The dense demo scene D takes ~48 % of the audio core (72 % before). Big memory work while the audio plays (loading or editing big samples, unpacking a kit) yields to the audio, so it causes no dropouts.
Scenes and song: scenes A–D switch on the bar. A 16-slot song arrangement has an FX-throw row and FOLLOW playback.
Browser: samples and kits on the microSD card, a category list next to the search, search with an on-screen keyboard, waveform preview, LOAD TO pad, LOAD KIT.
Built-in kits: 808-STYLE and 909-STYLE, synthesized from circuit descriptions (no Roland samples). They work without a card.
Demo: every start opens one demo track, our own "ORBIT DRIVE" (0.4.9: 124 BPM, A minor, the chords Am F C G), played by all three instruments: A intro (kick, hats, the SYNTH holding the chords), B groove (+ clap, 16th hats, the acid line, SYNTH stabs), C break (no kick: a tom and snare fill, the acid line held, a SYNTH arpeggio), D drop (everything, the SYNTH hook). Turn on FOLLOW to play the song A A B B C C D D B A. NEW PROJECT starts empty.
M5Burner: tools/make_release.py also writes one whole-flash image to burn at 0x0 (see docs/M5BURNER.md): ORBIT then runs on its own, without a launcher.
Projects on microSD (FAT32 or exFAT) with autosave and JSON export.
USB-MIDI host (USB-A): notes to pads, transport, clock in / out, MIDI learn for 32 controls.
Bluetooth A2DP headphones and speakers through an M5Stamp Pico bridge (see below).
Sharp maximize: any panel can be enlarged. It is rebuilt natively larger, with bigger fonts and icons, not scaled up as a bitmap. The BASS and SYNTH views can take the whole screen. A category of the enlarged BROWSER panel opens its files in the large view at once.
Tab5 Keyboard (the M5Stack keyboard for the Tab5): shortcuts like Ableton Live and a computer MIDI keyboard (see Tab5 Keyboard). It can be plugged in and out while ORBIT runs.
Interface size: Standard, Large or Extra large (Settings → Display) for larger dialogs, lists and touch areas. The settings window itself is drawn larger than the other dialogs.
Colors: 6 base palettes (LIGHT, WARM, SILVER, SLATE, DARK, BLACK), 8 accent colors and a custom accent (hue / saturation).
Outputs: wired headphone detection, and a separate volume for speaker, headphones and Bluetooth"}

· 每只标的都有隐藏性格：抗跌的、上蹿下跳的、财报爱造假的、鲸鱼常来的
· 战绩册：今日权益曲线、跨日与大盘对比、六类异象收集（集齐解锁一只妖股）
· 持仓中关机不丢，开机接着玩；2 分钟不按键自动熄屏，任意键唤醒

按键：B 买入 / S 卖出 / L 战绩册 / H 帮助 / M 静音 / C 红绿互换（默认红涨绿跌）

设备：M5Stack Cardputer ADV"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"把 MTPLX 的加速和「省下的钱」，放到一块 240×135 的桌面小屏上。

MTPLX Mate 是 Apple Silicon 本地推理 MTPLX 的桌面伴侣，专看别处看不到的东西——投机解码到底赚了多少。

· MTP 加速页：今日接受率、每 verify 产出几个 token、各档 depth 的接受概率曲线
· 实时速度页：当前 tok/s、首字延迟、缓存命中、显存占用、最近采样波形
· 省钱页：同一批 token 走云端要多少钱，扣掉本地电费还剩多少
· 用量 / 趋势 / 模型：今日与 7 天 30 天的 token、请求数、缓存命中、逐模型排名
· 一条命令装好 Mac 端后台程序：设备自己显示地址，复制粘贴即可，不用 SSH
· Mac 合盖也照算：设备离线不丢数据，一上线就收到最新
· 按 A/B 翻页；充电只变暗，电池 2 分钟自动熄屏，按任意键唤醒

需要一台 Mac（Apple Silicon）与正在运行的 MTPLX；设备为 M5Stack StickS3。

English: A desk companion for MTPLX on Apple Silicon — acceptance rate, tokens per verify, depth curves, live tok/s, TTFT, cache hit, memory, and what your local tokens would have cost in the cloud. Needs MTPLX running on a Mac; device is M5Stack StickS3."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"把 magpie 的路由情况放到桌面上的一块小屏。

硬件：M5Stack CoreS3。装在 StackChan 机身上时，头部十二颗 RGB 灯也会跟着路由状态呼吸变色：请求发出时是 agent 自己的颜色，应答落地转薄荷绿，某次尝试失败闪红，熄屏后熄灭。

四个页面：路由（谁发问、哪个模型应答、中间的飞行）、上下文窗口、用量、各订阅剩余额度。左右滑动切换，点标签跳转，点太阳或月亮切深浅主题。空闲九十秒变暗、十五分钟熄屏，触摸即回；熄屏期间来了新请求，灯带会闪一下提醒。

首次开机：板子升起一个热点，名字显示在屏幕上。手机连上后配网页自动弹出，选网络、填密码即可。仅支持 2.4 GHz。

换网络：按住屏幕三秒回到配网页，页面顶部能看到当前网络并直接忘掉它，再选一个新的。

需要配合：数据来自运行 magpie 的那台电脑，固件本身不含网络连接的另一端。电脑上需要跑一个配套的小程序，用法见项目 GitHub。

Magpie Buddy

What magpie is doing, on a small screen on your desk.

Hardware: M5Stack CoreS3. On a StackChan body the twelve RGB LEDs under the head follow the routing state too — the agent's own colour while a request is out, mint when an answer lands, a red flash when a try fails, dark when the screen sleeps.

Four pages: Route (who asked, which model answered, the flight between them), Context, Usage, and what is left on each allowance. Swipe to move between them, tap the tabs to jump, tap the sun or moon for dark and light. It dims after ninety seconds and goes dark after fifteen minutes; a touch brings it back, and a request arriving in the dark still flashes the strip.

First boot: the board raises an access point and shows its name on screen. Join it from a phone and the setup page opens by itself — pick your network, type the password. 2.4 GHz only.

Changing networks: hold the screen for three seconds to reach that page again, where the current network can be dropped and another picked.

What it needs: the data comes from the machine running magpie — the firmware is only one end. A small companion program has to run there; see the project's GitHub."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"# CardVault

Offline, encrypted secrets vault for the Cardputer ADV. It keeps your seed phrases, passwords, 2FA codes and private notes on the device, locked with a passphrase only you know. No Wi-Fi, no Bluetooth, no cloud.

![CardVault boot screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Besermenji/cardvault/main/docs/screenshots/splash.png)

## What it stores

| | |
|---|---|
| **Seed phrases** | Type words with autocomplete and checksum validation, or generate new 12/24 word seeds with the hardware RNG |
| **Passwords** | Built-in generator, random characters or word passphrases, with entropy shown |
| **2FA codes** | TOTP (6 or 8 digits) with a live overview of all your codes |
| **Notes** | Private text, encrypted like everything else |

![Home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Besermenji/cardvault/main/docs/screenshots/home.png)
![Password entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Besermenji/cardvault/main/docs/screenshots/entry.png)
![2FA codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Besermenji/cardvault/main/docs/screenshots/totp.png)
![Seed phrase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Besermenji/cardvault/main/docs/screenshots/seed.png)

## Security

- Argon2id key derivation and XChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption
- **10 wrong passphrases in a row erase the vault**
- Secrets stay masked until you hold Space, and hide again after 20 s
- Auto-lock with screen dimming, and the G0 button locks instantly
- Encrypted, verified backups to the microSD card

## Good to know

- Early software (v0.x). Always keep an independent backup of any seed phrase.
- Installing through Launcher gives the vault its own partition. Other firmware you install can still read the encrypted data, so use a strong passphrase.

[Source code and security model on GitHub](https://github.com/Besermenji/cardvault)

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"html","content":"

Squirrel! for Cardputer ADV


An extended notebook and personal assistant, built especially with ADHD in mind. Capture a thought in seconds before it slips away, then turn it into something you can act on.


  • Capture fast: notes, to-do lists with checklists, a mind dump and voice notes (G0 records at once).
  • Stay on track: routines with reminders, a focus timer with daily goals and weekly statistics, Pomodoro and training intervals, an hourglass, a metronome and breathing exercises.
  • Notice your progress: a daily success journal, so the wins don't get lost.Gentle time awareness: a big clock with bars that fill as the hour passes, a cuckoo on the hour and quiet hours for sound and light.
  • Syncs over Bluetooth with a T-Watch 2020 V3 running Squirrel!.
  • Works offline and keeps everything on the SD card as plain text files. 


Available in English, Polish, French and German.


No need to go nuts.


"}

currentVersion.versionDescription:
{"format":"html","content":"

Squirrel! 2.1-dev for Cardputer ADV: release notes



New


  1. Hourglass: a countdown in the Focus tools, with sound and LED alarm.
  2. Success journal: one list per day, counted in the statistics (TAB → J or CTRL+J).
  3. Clock bars: the top bar shows the hour passing (or the hourglass), the bottom one the quarter.
  4. Focus timer: take back 15 minutes or zero the day from Statistics. It now keeps counting after a restart.
  5. Low battery warnings: at 15, 10 and 5 % and right before empty, with optional sound, buzzer and LED.
  6. Metronome: choose a beep or a dry click (S key). Even beats, without an accent, on time to the millisecond.
  7. Optional DS3231 / DS1302 clock module: choose it in Settings → Time.
  8. Charging mark by the battery bar (charge detection is experimental).



Improved


  1. Wi-Fi: time sync tries all your saved networks in range automatically.
  2. Smoother screens: lists redraw only the rows that change, and Statistics no longer flashes every second.
  3. Clock: hours 10–19 are centred properly.
  4. Notifications: long texts no longer overlap.
  5. Translations: French and German reviewed.
  6.  Corrected bin file: previously needed prepping step, now works with sole .bin file and external burners   



Known issue


Light sleep is switched off on the Cardputer ADV: it made the backlight flash and triggered the quick recorder. Screen dimming and the slower CPU still save power.

"}

- AP: `M5STP2-XXXX`
- Default password: `m5stp2demo`

firmwares.firmwareDescription: {"format":"markdown","content":"An **autonomous**, **headless-first** WPA/WPA2 handshake-hunting ESP-32 appliance. It hunts handshakes endlessly, auto-uploads each capture to **wpa-sec.stanev.org**, and once an hour fetches cracked results back and announces any newly recovered passwords. currentVersion.versionDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"### What's in this release

- **Autonomous hunt, upload, and hourly sync** with new-password alerts, fully headless-capable.
- **Smart target selection:** skips already-cracked, already-submitted, and open networks; prioritizes stronger signals; backs off never-productive APs; re-verifies known networks periodically to catch rotated keys.
- **Four surfaces, all optional:** on-device HUD, status LED, a Maintenance results dashboard (entered by a per-board gesture, reachable over its own SoftAP), and an optional push webhook (ntfy or Discord). Recovered plaintext passwords are never sent off-device.
- **Operator-armed deauth** (ADR-0029), off by default, for authorized active capture.
- **Screen dimming** and a battery indicator on boards that support them.
- **Factory images guarded against the `qio` brick:** the release refuses to publish any factory image whose bootloader header is not `dio`."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"# 🔐 CyberKey — Standalone Hardware 2FA & Password Vault for M5Stack Cardputer

A sleek, air-gapped, open-source hardware TOTP authenticator with USB/BLE auto-typing, Google Password Manager MicroSD vault, OTA updates, and zero master-password delays.

--- ## 🌟 Overview **CyberKey** turns your [M5Stack Cardputer](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/core/cardputer) into a dedicated, standalone **Hardware Two-Factor Authenticator (2FA) & Password Autotyper**. No waiting for your phone to unlock, no cloud subscriptions, and no reliance on mobile apps. CyberKey computes standard RFC 6238 TOTP codes locally on the ESP32-S3 microcontroller using hardware-accelerated SHA1 crypto. Whether you're authenticating into GitHub, Google, AWS, or your home server, simply pick your account on the Cardputer screen and let CyberKey do the work. --- ## ✨ Features - ⚡ **Instant Boot & Unlock-Free Access**: Boots directly to your active 2FA codes. No mandatory PINs, biometric scans, or tedious boot delays. - 🏷️ **Dual-Field Account Identification**: - **Line 1 (Large Cyan)**: Primary Service / Site name (e.g. `GitHub`, `Google`, `Proton`, `AWS`). - **Line 2 (Muted Gray)**: Account username or email (e.g. `user@example.com`, `admin`). - ⌨️ **Dual USB HID & Bluetooth BLE Auto-Type ("YubiKey" Mode)**: - Plug your Cardputer into any PC, Mac, Linux machine, or iPad using USB-C, **or** pair it wirelessly over Bluetooth Low Energy (**`CyberKey BLE`**). - Press **`Enter`**: automatically types the active 6-digit TOTP code into your focused cursor and presses return! - Press **`U`**: automatically types your **Username** for the selected account. - Press **`P`**: automatically types your **Password** from the MicroSD password vault. - 🚀 **Dual LAN/WAN Over-The-Air (OTA) Updates**: - Update your firmware wirelessly with a single keypress (O) or via the web portal. - Dual smart routing checks local LAN (`http://192.168.5.55:8099`) when on your home network, falling back seamlessly to secure WAN (`https://cyberkey.sndjy.us`) when traveling. - Low-footprint chunked flash streaming with real-time on-screen progress indicator. - 🔑 **Google Password Manager MicroSD Import & Streaming Vault**: - Drag-and-drop or upload your exported `passwords.csv` in the CyberKey web interface (or drop it onto the root of the MicroSD card). - Automatically parses service names, URLs, usernames, and passwords directly into `/passwords.json` on the MicroSD card. - High-performance, memory-efficient streaming loader ensures zero heap crashes or boot loops even with large password collections. - Smart fuzzy matching automatically links your passwords to your 2FA accounts by service name or username. - 🔍 **First-Letter Quick Search**: - Jump directly to any service across dozens of stored keys by pressing the first letter (`G` for Google/GitHub, `P` for Proton, `A` for AWS). - 🌐 **Web Management & Captive Portal**: - Add, edit, or delete 2FA secrets from any phone or computer browser. - **Smart QR Screenshot Decoder**: Drag-and-drop or upload a 2FA QR code screenshot in the browser; CyberKey decodes the secret, parses the issuer and username, and populates the fields automatically. - **Captive Portal Fallback**: If no saved Wi-Fi is reachable, CyberKey spins up a `CyberKey-Setup` hotspot at `http://192.168.4.1`. - 💾 **MicroSD Vault Backup & Restore**: - Hit **`B`** on the keyboard to save a backup to your MicroSD card (`/cyberkey_backup.json`). - Hit **`R`** to restore all accounts and Wi-Fi credentials onto any new device. - 📶 **Multi-Wi-Fi Profile Manager**: - Stores up to 5 Wi-Fi profiles. - Automatically scans and connects to the strongest available network on boot to synchronize NTP time. - 🔋 **Battery Eco-Mode & Auto-Dim**: - Screen auto-dims from 80% to 15% brightness after 45 seconds of idle inactivity (restores instantly on any keypress). - Press **`W`** to toggle Wi-Fi into sleep mode on-demand to maximize battery life. - 🔔 **Audio Countdown Ticks**: - Optional subtle audio chirp during the final 3 seconds of a TOTP cycle to alert you when a code is about to expire (toggle with `M`). - 🚨 **Emergency Panic Wipe**: - Double-tap `Del` to instantly wipe all keys and Wi-Fi secrets from onboard flash memory. --- ## ⌨️ Cardputer Controls | Key | Function | |:---:|---| | Enter | **Auto-Type TOTP**: Types active 6-digit TOTP code and presses Enter (BLE / USB) | | U | **Auto-Type Username**: Types the account username/email into focused cursor | | P | **Auto-Type Password**: Types the linked password stored on MicroSD | | Space / D / . / / | Next Account | | A / , / ; | Previous Account | | A – Z | **Quick Jump**: Jump directly to first account starting with that letter | | O | **OTA Update**: Check for updates and flash new firmware over Wi-Fi | | W | **Wi-Fi Toggle**: Switch Wi-Fi radio ON / SLEEP (Eco-Mode) | | M | Toggle Expiration Audio Chirp (ON / OFF) | | B | Quick Backup to MicroSD Card (`/cyberkey_backup.json`) | | R | Quick Restore from MicroSD Card | | Del | Emergency Panic Wipe (press twice to wipe flash & SD passwords) | --- ## 🚀 Quick Start / Flashing ### Option A: Over-The-Air (OTA) Update (If already running CyberKey) 1. Ensure your Cardputer is connected to Wi-Fi. 2. Press uppercase O on the Cardputer keyboard (or visit the web portal and click **Check for Updates**). 3. The device will automatically stream the latest firmware and reboot. ### Option B: M5Launcher (MicroSD Card) 1. Download `CyberKey-complete.bin`. 2. Copy it to your Cardputer's MicroSD card. 3. Boot into **M5Launcher**, select `CyberKey-complete.bin`, and flash at offset `0x00000`. ### Option C: Web Flasher / esptool (USB-C) 1. Hold the `G0` (Boot) button on your Cardputer and connect the USB-C cable to your computer. 2. Run: ```bash esptool.py --chip esp32s3 write_flash 0x0000 CyberKey-complete.bin ``` --- ## 🛠️ Building from Source This project is built using [PlatformIO](https://platformio.org/). 1. Clone this repository: ```bash git clone https://github.com/your-username/cardputer-cyberkey.git cd cardputer-cyberkey ``` 2. Build firmware: ```bash pio run ``` 3. Merge complete 8MB flash binary: ```bash esptool.py --chip esp32s3 merge_bin -o CyberKey-complete.bin --flash_mode keep --flash_size 8MB 0x0000 .pio/build/m5stack-cardputer/bootloader.bin 0x8000 .pio/build/m5stack-cardputer/partitions.bin 0x10000 .pio/build/m5stack-cardputer/firmware.bin ``` 4. Flash directly via USB: ```bash pio run -t upload ``` --- ## 🔒 Security Architecture - **Air-Gapped Operation**: After initial NTP time sync, Wi-Fi can be completely shut down (`W` key). The device functions 100% offline. - **On-Chip Hardware Crypto**: TOTP codes are calculated on-the-fly using ESP32-S3's hardware-accelerated `mbedtls` cryptographic engine. - **MicroSD Data Portability**: Backups and passwords remain securely on the removable MicroSD card without risking exposure from internal flash dumps. --- ## 📄 License Distributed under the **MIT License**. {"format":"markdown","content":"✨ Features

🏷️ Dual-Field Account Identification:
Line 1 (Large Cyan): Primary Service / Site name (e.g. GitHub, Google, Proton, AWS).
Line 2 (Muted Gray): Account username or email (e.g. user@example.com, admin).
⌨️ Dual USB HID & Bluetooth BLE Auto-Type ("YubiKey" Mode):
Plug your Cardputer into any PC, Mac, Linux machine, or iPad using USB-C, or pair it wirelessly over Bluetooth Low Energy (CyberKey BLE).
Press Enter: automatically types the active 6-digit TOTP code into your focused cursor and presses return!
Press U: automatically types your Username for the selected account.
Press P: automatically types your Password from the MicroSD password vault.
🚀 Dual LAN/WAN Over-The-Air (OTA) Updates:
Update your firmware wirelessly with a single keypress (O) or via the web portal.
Dual smart routing checks local LAN (http://192.168.5.55:8099) when on your home network, falling back seamlessly to secure WAN (https://cyberkey.sndjy.us) when traveling.
Low-footprint chunked flash streaming with real-time on-screen progress indicator.
🔑 Google Password Manager MicroSD Import & Streaming Vault:
Drag-and-drop or upload your exported passwords.csv in the CyberKey web interface (or drop it onto the root of the MicroSD card).
Automatically parses service names, URLs, usernames, and passwords directly into /passwords.json on the MicroSD card.
High-performance, memory-efficient streaming loader ensures zero heap crashes or boot loops even with large password collections.
Smart fuzzy matching automatically links your passwords to your 2FA accounts by service name or username.
🔍 First-Letter Quick Search:
Jump directly to any service across dozens of stored keys by pressing the first letter (G for Google/GitHub, P for Proton, A for AWS).
🌐 Web Management & Captive Portal:
Add, edit, or delete 2FA secrets from any phone or computer browser.
Smart QR Screenshot Decoder: Drag-and-drop or upload a 2FA QR code screenshot in the browser; CyberKey decodes the secret, parses the issuer and username, and populates the fields automatically.
Captive Portal Fallback: If no saved Wi-Fi is reachable, CyberKey spins up a CyberKey-Setup hotspot at http://192.168.4.1.
💾 MicroSD Vault Backup & Restore:
Hit B on the keyboard to save a backup to your MicroSD card (/cyberkey_backup.json).
Hit R to restore all accounts and Wi-Fi credentials onto any new device.
📶 Multi-Wi-Fi Profile Manager:
Stores up to 5 Wi-Fi profiles.
Automatically scans and connects to the strongest available network on boot to synchronize NTP time.
🔋 Battery Eco-Mode & Auto-Dim:
Screen auto-dims from 80% to 15% brightness after 45 seconds of idle inactivity (restores instantly on any keypress).
Press W to toggle Wi-Fi into sleep mode on-demand to maximize battery life.
🔔 Audio Countdown Ticks:
Optional subtle audio chirp during the final 3 seconds of a TOTP cycle to alert you when a code is about to expire (toggle with M).
🚨 Emergency Panic Wipe:
Double-tap Del to instantly wipe all keys and Wi-Fi secrets from onboard flash memory."}
