{"format":"markdown","content":"The Tithe is a go-outside roguelike for the Cardputer, inspired by Balatro. Every WiFi router around you is a well. You walk up to one, draw its energy and offer it at another, and the relics you collect change what each offering is worth. Each Night has a Tithe to pay, and seven Nights make a week.

It only listens, so it runs passive scans, never sends anything, and hashes network names on the device. You don't need an account or a WiFi password.

**Installing:** the easiest way is M5Launcher. Copy `Tithe-v0.6.1.bin` from the GitHub release to your SD card's `/downloads` folder and pick it in the launcher, so nothing else on your Cardputer is touched. Burning it from M5Burner writes the full image and replaces everything on the device, Launcher included.

Source, releases and the 62-page manual: https://github.com/the-tithe/the-tithe

Website: https://the-tithe-game.vercel.app"}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"A PC-9801 emulator for the M5Stack Tab5. Of the outside sources that its predecessor, np2 TAB5, contained, everything except the font has been dropped, and the emulator itself (the CPU and the devices) has been written anew.

Features
Compatible ROMs built in
A simple BIOS and a public-domain font are built into the firmware. It boots from a blank microSD card — no ROM from real hardware is needed. The so-called NEC protection is not supported. To use NEC's MS-DOS or games that include it, dump the BIOS from a real machine and use that. N88(86)-BASIC is not included for copyright reasons.

USB keyboard and mouse
ESP-IDF does not support it, so a USB keyboard and a USB mouse cannot be used at the same time.

Bluetooth keyboard and mouse
BLE only. Devices that require a passcode to pair are not supported.

Touch panel as a mouse
The touch panel acts as a mouse.

Screenshots
Saves a hard copy of the screen to the microSD card as a PNG.

SD Card Reader mode
Mounts the microSD card in the Tab5 as a folder on a PC. The transfer rate is about 0.6MB/s, which is very slow. Bluetooth is off while this mode runs; tap the screen to leave it.

Disk Image Reader mode
Mounts a mounted disk image as a folder on a PC: the HDD, or the floppy image in FDD1 / FDD2 (.NFD .D88 .HDM .FDI). The transfer rate is about 0.6MB/s, which is very slow. Bluetooth is off while this mode runs; tap the screen to leave it.

Simple support for 386 instructions
With CPU: 80286 + 386 Instructions in the menu (the default), some real-mode software that uses 386 instructions runs. Protected mode is not supported. The machine identifies itself as a 286."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"================================================================
  CAM VIEW  ——  M5 Cardputer 摄像头观看器  固件 v2.0
================================================================
  适用硬件：M5Stack Cardputer ADV（ESP32-S3 / 8MB Flash / 240x135 屏）
  配套软件：电脑端「摄像头局域网直播」包（另一个压缩包）
================================================================


【一、这是什么】

把 Cardputer 变成一个随身监视器：
开机连上 WiFi → 用键盘敲电脑的 IP → 屏幕直接显示电脑摄像头的画面。

它看的是电脑端 8090 端口的 MJPEG 流：
  480x270 JPEG、10 帧/秒、每帧约 7 KB、延迟约 0.3 秒

手机 / 平板那边不受影响，还是扫码看 8889 端口的网页，两条通道同时工作。


【二、装入固件（只需一次）】

包里已经带好编译好的整片固件：固件\camview-v2.0-8MB.bin
下面三种方法选一种，推荐方法 A。

─────────────────────────────────────────────
方法 A：图形工具烧录（最简单）
─────────────────────────────────────────────
  1. 下载乐鑫官方工具 ESP32 Flash Download Tool
     （搜 "flash_download_tool"，官网 dl.espressif.com
       或 GitHub espressif/esptool 的 releases 里也有）
  2. 打开工具 → ChipType 选 ESP32-S3 → WorkMode 选 Develop → OK
  3. 按下面填：
       文件：固件\camview-v2.0-8MB.bin
       地址：0x0          （注意是 0x0，不是 0x1000）
       勾选那一行的复选框
       SPI SPEED：80MHz
       SPI MODE ：DIO
       FLASH SIZE：8MB
  4. 选好 COM 口（设备连上 USB-C 后会出现，Windows 10/11 免驱）
  5. 点 START，等进度条走完（约 40 秒），出现 FINISH 即成功
  6. 拔掉 USB 重新上电

─────────────────────────────────────────────
方法 B：命令行（已装 esptool 的话）
─────────────────────────────────────────────
  esptool.exe --chip esp32s3 -p COM3 -b 460800 write_flash 0x0 camview-v2.0-8MB.bin

  COM3 换成你实际的串口号。Windows 上设备管理器 → 端口 里能看到。

─────────────────────────────────────────────
方法 C：源码编译（想自己改的话）
─────────────────────────────────────────────
  源码在 源码\camview\ 目录，用 Arduino IDE 打开 camview.ino。

  依赖库（版本要一致，否则可能编不过）：
    M5Cardputer    1.1.1
    M5Unified      0.2.29
    M5GFX          0.2.36
    JPEGDEC        1.8.5
    esp32 core     3.3.12
    qrcodegen      已随源码附带（qrcodegen.c / qrcodegen.h，不用另外装）

  arduino-cli 安装依赖：
    arduino-cli lib install "M5Cardputer@1.1.1"
    arduino-cli lib install "JPEGDEC@1.8.5"
    arduino-cli core install esp32:esp32@3.3.12

  开发板设置（必须一致，否则内存不够）：
    开发板      ESP32S3 Dev Module
    Flash Size  8MB (64Mb)
    分区方案    Huge APP (3MB No OTA/1MB SPIFFS)
    USB CDC On Boot  Default（固件不依赖串口输出）

  编译上传后约占用 Flash 37%。


【三、第一次使用：配 WiFi（只需一次）】

1. 开机后屏幕显示 "Setup Mode"，说明还没配过网
2. 用手机连一个名叫  Cardputer-Cam  的 WiFi（无密码，屏幕上也有二维码）
3. 手机浏览器打开  http://192.168.4.1
4. 填写你家的 WiFi 名称和密码 → 保存，设备会自动重启
5. 重启后自动连网，进入地址输入界面


【四、日常使用】

屏幕出现「Enter PC address」时：

  1. 用键盘输入电脑的 IP，例如  192.168.1.100
     · 端口不用输，固件自动补 8090
     · 上次输过的会自动记住，下次开机会带出来
  2. 按 Enter → 显示 Connecting → 约 2 秒后出现画面
     右上角绿色数字是实时帧率（稳定 10 fps）
  3. 按 Esc 退出画面，回到输入界面

按键速查（输入界面）
  Enter      开始观看
  Del        退格
  Esc        清空重输
  Ctrl+Del   恢复出厂（清掉 WiFi 和地址，全部重配）

按键速查（观看界面）
  Esc        退出观看
  C          切换色彩模式（画面偏色时用，设置会记住）

  90 秒不碰键盘自动熄屏，按任意键点亮。看画面时不熄屏。


【五、断线和自愈】

· 电脑端关掉推流：右上角显示 reconnect #n，一直在重试
· 电脑端重新推流：约 3 秒内自动恢复画面，不用重启设备
· 连续失败 10 次：自动重连 WiFi
· 连续失败 40 次：整机自动重启（卡死也能自己救回来）


【六、常见问题】

Q  画面颜色不对（花屏、偏色、发紫）
A  按 C 键切换色彩模式，按一次看一次，会自动记住。
   正常机器出厂就是对的，一般用不到。

Q  一直 Connecting 或显示 no stream
A  ① 电脑端推流没开：双击「启动推流.vbs」
   ② IP 输错了：以电脑端弹窗里的地址为准
   ③ 电脑和 Cardputer 不在同一个 WiFi

Q  有画面但定格不动，帧率一直 0
A  点一下键盘任意键唤醒（可能是熄屏了）。
   还不行就 Esc 退出再 Enter 重进。

Q  改了 WiFi 密码 / 换了路由器
A  输入界面按 Ctrl+Del 恢复出厂，重新走第三部分配网。

Q  屏幕上画面有黑边 / 比例不对
A  正常。480x270 的流按比例缩到 240x135，差异极小。

Q  能看多久
A  一直开着就行，功耗很低。USB 供电时不会休眠（屏幕除外）。


【七、技术参数】

  主控        ESP32-S3（M5Stack Cardputer ADV）
  屏幕        240x135 ST7789
  固件框架    Arduino + M5Cardputer 1.1.1 + JPEGDEC 1.8.5
  视频来源    电脑端 ffmpeg 从直播流抽帧 → 480x270 JPEG
  解码        硬件级 JPEG 解码 → 直接写屏幕，RGB565
  帧率        稳定 10 帧/秒（电脑端限速）
  延迟        约 0.3 秒
  带宽        约 70 KB/s
  存储        WiFi 和地址存在 NVS，断电不丢

================================================================
  文件说明

  固件\camview-v2.0-8MB.bin    整片固件，烧到 0x0
  源码\camview\camview.ino      主程序
  源码\camview\qrcodegen.c/.h   二维码库（配网页面用）
  README.md                     项目说明与许可
  使用说明.txt / .html          本文件


【第三方组件与许可】

  qrcodegen by Project Nayuki
    MIT License
    https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
    源码内保留原始版权声明

  M5Cardputer / M5Unified / M5GFX
    MIT License
    https://github.com/m5stack

  JPEGDEC by Larry Bank
    Apache License 2.0
    https://github.com/bitbank2/JPEGDEC

本固件源码可自由使用、修改、再分发，请保留上述第三方版权声明。

================================================================"}

{"format":"html","content":"

A Kindle-style e-reader for the M5Stack PaperDIY. Reads EPUB and TXT books from the SD card with crisp anti-aliased text, saves your place in every book and resumes where you left off.


Features

  • Library home screen: cover grid (covers pulled from your EPUBs) with a progress bar per book; sort by recent, title or author
  • Beautiful text: Literata or Atkinson Hyperlegible, 5 sizes, adjustable spacing and margins with live preview; accented letters, Greek and real typographic quotes
  • Navigation: table of contents, bookmarks, go to %, "pages left in chapter"
  • Fast page turns: only the parts of the screen that change are refreshed (~0.2 s), with an automatic clean-up refresh every few pages
  • Sleep screens: your book's cover, five 16-grey generative designs, your own pictures, or random
  • Wi-Fi & files (radio is only on while this screen is open):
    • Join the reader's own PaperDIY-XXXXXX network (QR code on screen), or set up your home Wi-Fi and use http://reader.local
    • Upload books, manage the SD card (folders, rename, move, delete, download)
    • Turn any photo into a screensaver: cropped and dithered to the panel's 16 greys right in your browser
  • Extras: Conway's Game of Life and a sleep-screen gallery


Controls

Top keyBottom key
Click (reading)next pageprevious page
Click (menus)updown
Holdopen / select / menuback / library menu

Hold both keys 1.5 s to sleep. Power button: click to wake.


Getting started

  1. Put .epub / .txt files in a books folder on a microSD card (or upload them over Wi-Fi later).
  2. Flash, insert the card, and pick a book.

Flashing this image resets the reader's settings; books on the SD card are kept.


Open source (MIT): https://github.com/malonestar/paperdiy-reader

"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"### 中文

FORM Gaussian Avatar 是 M5Stack StopWatch 上的可定制高斯点云角色演示。最多保存 16 个角色，可通过 USB 从 FORM Avatar Studio 传入最多 5,000 点的角色。KeyA 切换角色，KeyB 或轻点屏幕切换表情；中间滑动转身，右侧区域上下滑动缩放，长按打开设置。默认循环播放动作与表情，采用局部屏幕刷新。

### English

A customizable Gaussian-splat avatar demo for M5Stack StopWatch. Store up to 16 avatars and transfer models of up to 5,000 points from FORM Avatar Studio over USB. Key A switches avatars, Key B changes expressions, horizontal swipe rotates, and the right edge controls zoom. Actions and expressions play automatically. This software renderer uses partial screen updates.

### 日本語

FORM Gaussian Avatar は M5Stack StopWatch 向けのカスタマイズ可能なガウシアンスプラットのアバターデモです。最大16体のアバターを保存でき、FORM Avatar Studio から USB 経由で最大5,000点のモデルを転送できます。KeyA でアバターを切り替え、KeyB または画面タップで表情を変更します。画面中央のスワイプで回転、右側の上下スワイプで拡大・縮小、長押しで設定を開きます。動作と表情は自動で繰り返し再生され、画面は部分更新されます。"}

FORM Gaussian Avatar 是 M5Stack CoreS3 上的可定制高斯点云角色演示。最多保存 16 个角色，可通过 USB 从 FORM Avatar Studio 传入最多 5,000 点的角色。触摸屏支持切换表情、转身和缩放；长按可打开设置并切换角色。动作和表情默认循环播放。

A customizable Gaussian-splat avatar demo for M5Stack CoreS3. Store up to 16 avatars and transfer models of up to 5,000 points from FORM Avatar Studio over USB. Touch interaction supports changing expressions, rotating the avatar and adjusting its size. Actions and expressions play automatically.

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"# Tab5OS

**Tab5OS** transforms the **M5Stack Tab5** into a versatile portable workspace for writing, drawing, reading, media, maps, software development and communication.

Work directly on the touchscreen or connect a **USB keyboard, mouse or compatible gamepad**. Alongside its built-in tools, Tab5OS supports **11 ready-to-run ELF applications**, MicroPython programs and expandable software libraries, with access to microSD and USB storage.

## Writing and reading

A versatile **Markdown and code editor** for everyday writing, structured documents and software development. Work across multiple documents and organised project groups, with syntax highlighting, search, and navigation through document outlines, hyperlinks and references to other files or specific text sections. An integrated Python console and serial communication tools extend the editor beyond conventional text editing.

Read **EPUB ebooks** with bookmarks, or explore Wikipedia through its dedicated application, with support for online content and compatible **offline ZIM archives**, including hyperlinks, tables and optional images.

## Drawing and image editing

A complete drawing and image-editing workspace with **brushes, shapes, text, layers, selections and transformations**. Create illustrations, edit imported images and refine details using colour adjustments, gradients, patterns, feathering and local deformation tools.

Rectangular, elliptical and freehand selections, a magic wand, and undo/redo provide additional editing flexibility. Preserve editable compositions in the native **T5I layered format**, or export finished images as **BMP and JPEG**.

## Files, sharing and security

A graphical **SD/USB file explorer** provides hierarchical folder navigation, search, multiple selection and contextual **Open with** actions for working with different file types and applications.

Transfer, browse and manage files from a computer's web browser through a local network or direct Wi-Fi connection, without requiring dedicated desktop software.

Protect sensitive information with **file encryption** and a **PIN-controlled vault** for passwords, encryption keys and authentication tokens. Print documents through compatible **network IPP and IPP-over-USB printers**.

## Development and network tools

Tab5OS provides an integrated environment for **MicroPython development**, from editing and executing programs to managing projects, importing modules, maintaining libraries and downloading compatible packages.

Built-in **Git integration** supports practical version-control workflows, including repository cloning, change tracking, staging, commits, history, and synchronisation with remote repositories through fetch, pull and push.

The **interactive command-line terminal** goes beyond basic file management, allowing elaborate commands and multi-step workflows through **command pipelines, redirections, variables and scripts**. Its utilities cover text processing, file operations, searching, SHA-256 verification and network diagnostics.

Additional networking capabilities include DNS queries, ping, TCP connections, port checks and HTTP requests. Run **remote SSH commands**, transfer files through **SFTP**, and communicate with external devices over **USB-C serial or RS485** connections.

## Maps, media and everyday tools

Explore **online and offline maps**, search for places, save locations and download map data for use without an internet connection.

Enjoy local audio and supported video playback, internet radio and audio recording. Everyday utilities include a calculator with history and unit conversions, alarm clock, system diagnostics, and extensive personalisation with **customisable themes, fonts, shortcut controls and 14 interface languages**.

Compatible external hardware extends the system with **RTL-SDR radio reception** and **Meshtastic messaging**, including connected node positions displayed directly on maps.

## Included ELF applications

Tab5OS includes **11 ready-to-run ELF applications**, covering network diagnostics, utilities, games and retro emulation:

**Pentest** network diagnostics, **hash\_file** file-fingerprint example, **Doom**, **Maze3D**, and emulators for **Game Boy, Game Boy Color, NES, Sega 8-bit, Game Boy Advance, SNES and Mega Drive**.

These applications run as separate ELF programs, extending the system beyond its built-in firmware.

## Included Python applications

Ready-to-use **MicroPython applications** extend Tab5OS with IRC chat over TLS, Wikipedia browsing, library and project management, map and radio import tools, theme creation, SD repair and update utilities, and programming examples.

Additional compatible **ELF and MicroPython applications** can be installed on microSD or USB storage, allowing the software environment to grow independently of the main firmware.

## Installation and downloads

**For first installation:** Use the **M5Burner firmware image**, which replaces the device's internal Flash contents.

**For existing Tab5OS installations:** Use the **OTA firmware image through the Explorer** to update the system.

The complete **microSD package**, ELF and Python applications, additional resources, installation instructions and source code are available on GitHub.

**Project repository, downloads and documentation:**

**[GitHub — Belekos/Tab5OS](https://github.com/Belekos/Tab5OS)**"}

{"format":"markdown","content":"Puter is a voice assistant for the original M5Stack Cardputer, using its built-in microphone, speaker, keyboard, and display. It supports Gemini Live and ElevenLabs agents, with separately saved provider keys.

Run the voice service in your own Vercel and Supabase accounts, then enter your server address and provider key during setup. Start with the [step-by-step guide](https://github.com/ImPapaGhost/puter#set-up-from-scratch). Provider and hosting quotas apply.

This is a clean-install image: it replaces existing firmware and Launcher and clears saved Wi-Fi and provider settings.

Early release. Gemini conversation and saved-key reuse were checked on an original Cardputer. Fresh WebBurner installation, independent hosting, live ElevenLabs switching, and Launcher switching still need checking. [Validation notes](https://github.com/ImPapaGhost/puter/blob/main/docs/testing.md).

Based on ElatoAI. Source, build instructions, and component license notices are available in the public repository."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"**Sila** (صلة, "connection") is a little virtual pet that lives on your **M5StickS3** keychain.

- Feeds on the WiFi networks around it and notices phones nearby
- Hears you: looks at you when you clap, comes when you **double clap**, dances to music
- Feels you: giggles when you poke it, screams when it falls, "wheee!" when you catch it
- Eats electricity: plugging in USB feeds it, it gets sleepy on low battery
- Counts your steps, falls asleep when you rock it, face stays level as you turn it
- **Catch**: a tilt mini-game with a saved best score

Controls: A = menu / select, hold A = pat it, B = next, hold B = back.

⚠️ **Burning with M5Burner erases the whole flash, so an existing pet starts over as an egg.** Great for a first install. To **update and keep your pet**, flash `Sila.bin` from the GitHub releases at address **0x0** with https://espressif.github.io/esptool-js/ and don't tick "erase flash" - Sila keeps a backup that survives that.

Source, changelog and details: https://github.com/mohanad747/Sila (MIT, grew out of TamaFi by CiferTech)."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"# PandaOS — Cardputer ADV

Standalone firmware by PandaDev LLC, designed specifically for the
M5Stack Cardputer ADV.

## Features
- AI Chat using your own OpenRouter API key
- Ten free, on-device games with local SD scores
- Wi-Fi toolkit and local captive portal training tools
- Bluetooth Low Energy tools
- LoRa messaging and raw packet tools
- GNSS tools with compatible hardware
- Voice recording and SD WAV/MP3 playback
- Internet radio
- Local notifications and SD storage


## Requirements
- M5Stack Cardputer ADV; original Cardputer is not supported
- Compatible microSD card for file storage and audio
- Compatible LoRa/GNSS hardware for those functions
- Wi-Fi and a personal OpenRouter key for AI Chat

## Installation
Factory installation resets internal settings, including saved Wi-Fi.
The SD card is not formatted; PandaOS creates and maintains its own files.

Original PandaOS source is proprietary to PandaDev LLC.
Third-party components retain their respective licenses."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"**Turn your M5StickS3 into a motion-controlled fishing rod** for the free 8-bit browser game *Pixel Fishing*.
Flick to cast, jerk to hook, twist your wrist to reel in, and blow into the mic to light a campfire at night.

▶ **Play:** [arturockpk.github.io/imuFishingGame/web/fishing](https://arturockpk.github.io/imuFishingGame/web/fishing/)
📦 **Source:** [github.com/ArtuRockPK/imuFishingGame](https://github.com/ArtuRockPK/imuFishingGame)

---

## ✨ Features

- 🧠 **Hardware gesture recognition** — uses the BMI270's built-in Bosch feature engine (taps, high-g, low-g, orientation, motion)
- 🌀 **Reel mode** — measures how fast you spin the stick with your wrist (gyroscope), any direction
- 🎤 **Blow detection** — the microphone recognizes when you blow into the stick, with adaptive background-noise tracking
- 📡 **Bluetooth LE** — appears as **`StickS3-Rod`**, connects straight from Chrome / Edge (no app needed)
- 🔋 **Battery-friendly** — 80 MHz CPU, gyro and mic run only when the game asks for them, screen turns off after 10 s
- 📺 **Live event display** — every gesture lights up its own tile on the screen

## 🎮 Gestures

| Gesture | Event | In the game |
|---|---|---|
| Double tap | `TAP x2` | Pick a spot / confirm |
| Sharp jerk | `HIGH-G` | Cast, hook a fish, swat a mosquito |
| Quick drop | `LOW-G` | Drop the fish into the bucket |
| Wrist twist | `REEL` | Reel in the fish, turn the spit |
| Blow into the mic | `BLOW` | Fan the campfire |
| Lay flat / stay still | `FLAT`, `NO MOT` | The fisherman sits down and waits |

## 🔘 Buttons

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Any button | Wake the screen for 10 s |
| **A** (front), hold 2 s | Power off |

## 🚀 Getting started

1. Flash the firmware (merged `.bin` at offset `0x0`).

currentVersion.versionDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"SETUP
1. Flash this file (it starts at address 0x0). Put a microSD card in the Tab5 and start it. The screen says
   "Connect Tab5 to Spotify" and the app copies the login tool onto the card (folder spotify/login).
   If you put the card in later, tap "Restart".
2. Get your own Client ID (free, one time):
   - open developer.spotify.com/dashboard and sign in,
   - click "Create app"; any name and description, e.g. "Tab5",
   - under "Redirect URIs" type exactly http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback and click "Add",
   - tick "Web API", accept the terms and click "Save",
   - open "Settings" and copy the "Client ID".
3. Put the SD card in your computer and open the folder spotify/login on it.
   - Windows: double-click LOGIN_SPOTIFY.cmd. If it says Python is missing, install Python 3 from python.org
     (tick "Add python.exe to PATH") and double-click it again.
   - macOS / Linux: open a terminal in that folder and type: python3 spotify_login.py --lang en
4. Paste your Client ID when the tool asks. When it asks where to save, press Enter (this SD card). Your browser
   opens the Spotify sign-in: sign in and click "Agree" (you type your password only on Spotify's page). The tool
   saves spotify/config.json on the card and, if you want, your Wi-Fi network too.
5. Eject the card, put it back in the Tab5 and tap "Restart". If no known Wi-Fi is in range, pick your network
   on the screen.

GOOD TO KNOW
- The Client ID's owner needs Spotify Premium. In development mode a Client ID works for up to 5 Spotify
  accounts: add the other accounts under "User Management" in your app on the dashboard.
- Spotify ends the sign-in after 6 months. The Tab5 then asks you to sign in again: repeat steps 3 to 5.
- Keep config.json private: it gives access to your Spotify account.
- Flashing at 0x0 replaces everything on the Tab5 (the app runs on its own, no launcher needed).
- Settings include an option to boost the Tab5 with a Raspberry Pi Zero 2W on the USB-A port (faster internet
  and covers, the Tab5 speaker over Bluetooth). The Pi software will be published later."}

firmwares.firmwareName: LORA Tunnel — Cardputer ADV + Cap LoRa-1262
firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"## LORA Tunnel

A standalone wardriving recorder for **M5Stack Cardputer ADV + Cap LoRa-1262 (U214)**. Observe 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, BLE advertisements and receive-only LoRa traffic, attach available receiver time and GNSS location, and save original sessions to microSD. A separate passive Recon mode groups supported Wi-Fi/BLE indicators with optional audible alerts.

Requires Cardputer ADV, the U214 cap with its antennas, and a FAT32 microSD card. This listing is not for the original Cardputer, U201 or Heltec.

### Version 0.5.0

The features below describe **0.5.0**. Check the selected version: older releases remain available and new submissions may await M5Stack review. The current release is also available through the [web installer](https://valleytech-lora-tunnel.pages.dev/) and [GitHub downloads](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/releases/tag/v0.5.0).

- Choose Meshtastic, MeshCore or Both / slow scan. One selected profile per protocol, with a default 30-second dwell.
- Decode supported Meshtastic node information, positions, ordinary text and battery/voltage telemetry using public/default or privately configured channel keys.
- Parse MeshCore public announcements and verify their Ed25519 signatures. Encrypted group/direct chat remains unsupported.
- Preserve raw packets, RSSI/SNR and receive settings in native logs. Receiver location remains separate from mesh-advertised positions.
- Use keyboard navigation, region selection, physical credential entry, Stop + Save and confirmed software sleep.
- Optional WiGLE, Wardrift and WDGWars CSV uploads run only while capture is stopped and saved. Automatic uploads are off by default.

The SX1262 receives one modem configuration at a time. Combined mode cannot hear every frequency or preset simultaneously. Recon indicators are clues, not proof of device identity or recording; randomized BLE addresses are temporary.

### Install and configure

The M5Burner package is the merged **FACTORY image for address 0x0**. It replaces the current firmware, including Launcher. Preserve a recovery copy and private SD settings first. To keep Bmorcelli Launcher, use the separate [LAUNCHER-APP.bin](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/releases/download/v0.5.0/LORA-Tunnel-0.5.0-Cardputer-ADV-LoRa1262-LAUNCHER-APP.bin) through Launchers SD menu; never write it at address zero.

Copy the release SD starter to the card and rename config.example.json to config.json inside /lora-tunnel/. Keep existing private configuration when updating. First boot leaves LoRa off until you select a supported region or Skip LoRa. While stopped, Settings → LoRa cycles receive modes. Match the MeshCore profile to your local network.

Use Stop + Save and wait before removing power or storage. Software sleep does not disconnect the battery or cut power to the cap GNSS receiver. Keep credentials and private channel keys on your own SD card; never publish them.

[Controls, hardware and recovery](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/blob/v0.5.0/docs/CARDPUTER_ADV.md) · [Configuration and uploads](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/blob/v0.5.0/docs/UPLOADS.md) · [Official U214 hardware](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/cap/Cap_LoRa-1262)

![Synthetic Cardputer Home preview](https://valleytech-lora-tunnel.pages.dev/assets/ui/cardputer/home.png)

![Synthetic combined-mode Settings preview](https://valleytech-lora-tunnel.pages.dev/assets/ui/cardputer/settings-combined.png)

These are source-rendered interface examples with synthetic values, not device photos or capture evidence.

### Validation and limits

Both firmware builds and host checks passed. The final Cardputer application passed independent USB flash verification, startup, a user screen/navigation check and a short combined capture with GNSS fix and completed Stop + Save. It reported queue drops under Wi-Fi/BLE load, with zero errors or allocation failures. Known-source MeshCore reception, browser/Launcher installation and return, sustained drives, independent saved-geotag checks and live upload receipts remain unverified. WDGWars mesh ingestion is separate from CSV uploads. [Full release evidence](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/blob/v0.5.0/docs/RELEASE_0_5_0.md).

Original LORA Tunnel code is **MIT licensed**. LoRaPipe and Kismet inspired the capture/profile approach; Meshtastic and MeshCore informed protocol research. RadioLib, Arduino-ESP32, NimBLE, TinyGPSPlus, ArduinoJson, M5Stack libraries, Crypto, the Dragon Detector subset and its inherited notices, OpenDroneID and ESP Web Tools retain their licenses and required credits. [Attributions](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/blob/v0.5.0/docs/THIRD_PARTY.md). Exact source, dependency/relink archives, SD starter and checksums accompany the release."}

currentVersion.versionDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"LORA Tunnel 0.5.0 adds Meshtastic, MeshCore and Both / slow scan modes to Cardputer ADV + U214 Cap LoRa-1262.

- Local Meshtastic decoding for supported node information, positions, ordinary text and device battery/voltage telemetry. Public/default-key decoding and private channel-key configuration are supported.
- MeshCore public-announcement parsing and Ed25519 signature verification. Encrypted group/direct chat is not decoded.
- Combined reception alternates one profile per protocol, with a default 30-second dwell. The SX1262 receives one configuration at a time.
- Raw packets, receive settings, RSSI/SNR and supported decoded fields remain in native SD logs. Receiver and advertised node positions stay separate.
- Existing Wardriver, passive Recon, GNSS, keyboard controls, region selection and optional idle-only uploads remain available.

This is the standalone FACTORY image for address 0x0. It replaces existing firmware, including Launcher. To retain Bmorcelli Launcher, use the separate LAUNCHER-APP.bin from the release and install through Launcher's SD menu. Requires Cardputer ADV, U214 and microSD; not for original Cardputer, U201 or Heltec.

Validation: both firmware targets and host checks passed; this Cardputer application passed independent USB flash verification, startup and an on-device screen/navigation check. firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"# MonoSuite

MonoSuite bundles five small apps and an e-book reader into a single firmware
image, with a shared header, save system, sleep screen, and RTC clock.

## Features

### Apps

| App | Description |
|---|---|
| **Reversi** | Othello against a heuristic AI with undo and pass detection |
| **2048** | Classic tile-merging puzzle with best-score persistence |
| **Minesweeper** | 12×14 grid with flag mode and flood-fill reveal |
| **Sokoban** | XSB level loader with deadlock detection and single-step undo |
| **Reader** | Plain-text and EPUB reader with pagination, resume, and adjustable font size |"}

currentVersion.versionDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"### Shared

- **Sleep mode** — idle timeout or manual entry via A+B chord. Shows a clock, updates on the minute, wakes on A+B.
- **RTC clock** — syncs from host over USB serial at boot.
- **Header bar** — back button, centered clock, battery indicator, info modal.
- **Save system** — per-app progress saved to SD or LittleFS, restored on next boot.
- **Confirmation dialogs** — destructive actions (quit, restart) require a tap.

The `platformio.ini` uses `board = esp32-s3-devkitm-1` with M5Unified's Paper
Mono board fallback. See the hardware reference block at the top of
`src/main.cpp` for the SD pin map.

## SD card layout

The firmware reads everything from a mounted microSD card. Create the
following structure before first boot:

```
/books/                          # Reader: .txt and .epub files
/fonts/NotoSansTC-Subset.ttf     # Reader: required TTF for CJK and Latin
/sleep/*.bmp                     # Optional; shown on the sleep screen randomly
/sokoban/*.xsb                   # Sokoban: one or more XSB level files
```

If the SD card is absent or fails to mount, the firmware falls back to
LittleFS on the ESP32's internal flash — but save files and books will not
persist across reboots, and the reader will be unable to find the font.

### Font

The reader requires `/fonts/NotoSansTC-Subset.ttf`. Any TTF with the glyphs
you want to read will work; the name is only a convention. A subsetted
Noto Sans TC covers Traditional Chinese, Japanese Kana, and Latin. Place
the file on the SD card before first use.

### Level files

Sokoban reads `.xsb` files from `/sokoban/`. The XSB format is a
plain-text convention used by the Sokoban community; many public level
sets exist. Place one or more `.xsb` files in the directory and they
will be loaded in filename order."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"RC airplane control-surface deflection measurement tool

 Splash screen: app title + "by Planet-Soaring.com" for 5 seconds.

 Orientation page (shown after the splash, before the setup page):
   VERTICAL   -> pitch: elevation of the long axis X (toward the USB end)
   HORIZONTAL -> roll : elevation of the short axis Y
   B: toggle selection, A: confirm and continue to the setup page

 Boot setup screen:
   MODE  angle / chord (mm)
   CHORD 20..999 mm, 1 mm steps (chord mode only)
   B (side): change mode / chord (tap = +1, hold = continuous)
   A (front): next / start; hold A: back to MODE

 Measurement screen (always relative to a captured zero, no absolute mode):
   angle mode: live angle in degrees, with MAX/MIN peaks
   chord mode: live deflection in mm = chord * sin(angle), same MAX/MIN
   on entry the zero is captured automatically from a full 1 s window
   BtnA: re-zero here and reset peaks
   BtnB: back to the mode selection page

 The measured axis follows the orientation page:
   VERTICAL   (pitch): elevation of X, the long axis, positive when the                        USB end is raised.
   HORIZONTAL (roll) : elevation of Y, the short axis. Held in landscape the
                       long axis X lies across the screen, so tipping the
                       display rotates around it and the short axis is the
                       one that swings.

The angle is computed from a 1-second moving average of the
acceleration vector, which removes most hand shake and sensor noise.

Official StickS3 IMU axes: +X toward the USB-C end, +Y toward the
viewer's left when the USB end is up and the screen faces the viewer,
 +Z out of the screen."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
{"format":"markdown","content":"**Sticker Level** turns your M5StickS3 into a precise digital spirit level. It reads the built-in BMI270 IMU and switches between two modes on its own, depending on how you hold the device. No menus, no button press.

## Two modes, chosen automatically

**FLAT: check horizontal surfaces**
Lay the StickS3 flat with the screen up. A bubble-circle shows **pitch** (front/back) and **roll** (left/right) together, with live angles in degrees. The bubble turns **green** when the surface is level and **red** when it's tilted.

**VERTICAL: check plumb, like a torpedo level**
Stand the StickS3 on its edge with the screen facing you, against a wall, post, door frame or picture frame. The display switches to a horizontal tube with a sliding bubble. It shows the **lean** angle and a **PLUMB / TILTED** status.

A small hysteresis band stops the screen flickering between modes while you move the device.

## Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| **Left**, short press | Change tolerance: ±0.5° → ±1° → ±2° → ±5° |
| **Left**, long press | **Tare**: set the current position as zero (until reboot) |
| **Right**, short press | Clear the tare |
| **Right**, long press | **Calibrate**: save a permanent zero to flash (~6 s) |

FLAT and VERTICAL each keep their own tare and calibration. Calibrating one never changes the other.

## First use: calibrate once

Every MEMS accelerometer has a small factory offset, so an uncalibrated unit can be off by up to about 1°.
1. Place the StickS3 on a surface you **know** is level (for FLAT) or plumb (for VERTICAL).
2. Hold the **Right** button until "Calibrating..." appears, then keep the device still for about 6 seconds.
3. The offset is saved and loaded again on every boot.

**VERTICAL mode must be calibrated once before you use it.** Until then it has no reliable reference for plumb.

## Accuracy
After calibration, expect accuracy within a few tenths of a degree. Each reading averages 8 samples, and calibration averages 600. If readings drift over time or with temperature, recalibrate.

## Hardware
M5StickS3 (ESP32-S3, BMI270 IMU, 135×240 display). Built with Arduino, M5Unified and M5PM1 on PlatformIO."}

{"format":"markdown","content":"13 种角色、11 种颜色、12 种随机轮换表情的独立离线演示。触摸控制头部和视线，IMU 支持相对姿态跟随，无需网络或账号。

## 操作
- 左键 A 单击：切换角色（约 320 ms 延迟，用于区分双击）。
- 右键 B 单击：切换颜色。
- 双击 A：将当前姿态设为 IMU 中立位置，提示期间保持片刻静止。
- 同时按住 A+B 一秒：也可重新校准。
- 触摸或拖动：头和眼睛跟随手指，触摸优先于 IMU。

## 0.3.0
运行时角色正立，关闭明显的拉长、压扁；心形底部更圆，四角星凹口更浅。三角角色采用圆锥曲面，眼睛沿曲面转动并在侧面自然遮挡。IMU 融合陀螺仪与重力方向，支持竖直持握时的左右转动。相对航向可能缓慢漂移，可双击 A 归零。

466×466 原分辨率、轮廓绘制和局部刷屏。0.3.0 已在白色 TriviaPOD TP-01-A（32 MB Flash / 8 MB PSRAM）烧录并完整回读验证，默认水滴脸稳定阶段约 27–30 FPS，中位数 29.8 FPS。其他角色帧率未逐一测量；物理 IMU 跟随方向和手感仍待试用确认。StopWatch C152 使用相同板级驱动，本轮未在 C152 实物上验证。

这是纯表情演示，说话和聆听是动画状态，不含语音识别、TTS 或联网功能。重启后角色与颜色回到默认值。

将合并 BIN 烧录到 **0x0**。镜像使用 16 MB Flash 布局，会替换覆盖范围内的引导、分区、配置和应用，请先备份需要保留的原固件与配置。

## English
Offline procedural avatar demo: 13 shapes, 11 colors, 12 shuffled expressions, touch-driven head/eye tracking, six-axis IMU tracking and double-A recentering. Version 0.3.0 uses upright runtime poses, fixed proportions, a rounder heart, a softer four-point star and conical eye wrapping. Full 466×466 output with partial updates. Tested on a white TriviaPOD TP-01-A; a physical StopWatch C152 was not tested in this round. This is a silent visual demo. Flash the merged BIN at 0x0 after backing up the device.

## 致谢 / Thanks
感谢 [Grok Bot 网页参考实现](https://grokbot.yin.wiki/index.html) 提供的交互与视觉参考，感谢 [xAI Grok Bot](https://x.ai/bot) 的角色设计启发。

Special thanks to https://grokbot.yin.wiki/index.html for the visual and interaction reference. This is an independent community demo, not an official xAI product. Geometry is generated within this project; no original web player or animation assets are bundled.

Built with ESP-IDF 5.5.1, M5Unified 0.2.29 and M5GFX 0.2.35."}

firmwares.firmwareDescription:
肥鱼 OS：跑在 Cardputer Adv 上的 AI 小操作系统，无需宿主机——不用连电脑、不用树莓派，连上 Wi-Fi 后录音、识别、执行都由设备自己完成。

按住 Enter 说一句话，大肥鱼（DeepSeek）调度设备能力：位置天气路线、联网搜索、红外遥控、屏幕显示、SSH 连主机；还能把几件事组合成小程序，定时或开机自动运行。

设置可以用手机：设置页选「手机设置（扫码）」，手机扫码连上设备热点，自动弹出设置页，Wi-Fi 和各种 Key 都在手机上填，不用在小键盘上敲。

常用按键
· 按住 Enter：说话，松开发送
· Y / N / A：执行 / 取消 / 本任务后续都执行
· ; 和 .：在时间线上下移动；/ 打开详情；, 回到最新
· `（Esc）：取消当前任务
· Btn0：切换 Agent / SSH
· Fn+W：设置（Wi-Fi、Key、SSH 主机、手机扫码设置）
· Fn+H：帮助
· Fn+Del：清空对话记忆

须知：只支持 Cardputer Adv。固件不含任何 Key，首次开机自动进入设置页，填写 Wi-Fi（仅 2.4 GHz）、语音识别 Key（通义千问）和 DeepSeek Key。右下角吉祥物：把 GitHub Release 里的 mascot.bin 放到 TF 卡 /vat/assets/。
